title: Take-home Exercise 2: Geospatial Analytics for Peace课后作业二：面向和平的地理空间分析
text:
Abstract摘要

Myanmar’s military seized power on 1 February 2021, and the protests that followed turned within months into a nationwide armed conflict. This report analyses 53,805 armed-conflict events recorded by ACLED between January 2021 and September 2025 (battles, explosions and remote violence, and violence against civilians), aggregated to 329 townships of the MIMU v9.4 boundaries and to 19 quarters.
Local Moran’s I and Getis-Ord Gi* locate one dominant cluster of high conflict, the Dry Zone where Sagaing, Magway and Mandalay meet, a second belt along the south-east from Kayin through Mon to Tanintharyi, and a broad cold zone over the Ayeyarwady delta, Yangon and the eastern Shan hills. Violence against civilians is confined almost entirely to the Dry Zone; explosions and remote violence also light up the south-east. No township is a significant high-low outlier over the whole period: violence does not appear as an isolated island in a calm region. Year by year, the Dry Zone cluster held through 2023 and then thinned out; by 2025 the High-High townships were split between the Kayin border, the uplands where Mandalay meets northern Shan, and a remnant of the old core.
The emerging hot spot analysis is where the methodological work of the report lies. Applied as distributed, emerging_hotspot_analysis() in sfdep gives each township’s result to another township whenever the geometry is not sorted by location identifier; its permutation null draws neighbours from every quarter of the cube, so that a national trend is read as local significance; and one of its class rules ignores the sign of Gi*. All three defects are demonstrated on these data and corrected. With a period-conditional null the oscillating hot spots of the uncorrected output fall from 40 to 2, and the classification shows a chronic core in the Dry Zone, new hot spots on its southern and eastern edges, and cold spots in the eastern Shan hills and, since 2022, in Yangon. A null simulation shows that the commonest class, the sporadic hot spot, is barely more frequent than chance would make it, so townships are read by how many quarters they spent hot rather than by label alone.
A spatial Markov chain, offered as value-added analysis, shows that a quiet township is about twice as likely to see conflict the next quarter when its neighbours are in intense conflict, and the effect survives township and quarter fixed effects. The first onset of sustained conflict, by contrast, is no more clustered than random timing would produce: the 2021 uprising broke out nationwide at once, and contagion governs escalation afterwards.


2021 年 2 月 1 日,缅甸军方夺取政权,随后的抗议在数月之内演变为全国性的武装冲突。 本报告分析 ACLED 在 2021 年 1 月至 2025 年 9 月间记录的 53,805 起武装冲突 事件(战斗、爆炸与远程暴力、针对平民的暴力),将其汇总到 MIMU v9.4 边界的 329 个镇区和 19 个季度。
局部 Moran’s I 与 Getis-Ord Gi* 识别出一个占主导的高冲突聚集区,即实皆、马圭与 曼德勒交界的干燥带;第二条聚集带沿东南方向从克伦经孟邦延伸到德林达依; 伊洛瓦底三角洲、仰光和掸邦东部山地则构成大片冷区。针对平民的暴力几乎完全局限 在干燥带;爆炸与远程暴力则在东南方向同样显著。就整个研究期而言,没有任何镇区是 显著的高-低异常值:暴力并不以「平静区域中孤立的岛」的形式出现。逐年来看,干燥带 聚集在 2023 年之前保持稳定,此后逐渐稀疏;到 2025 年,「高-高」镇区分散在克伦边境、 曼德勒–掸邦北部交界山地,以及老核心的残余三处。
新兴热点分析是本报告方法工作的重心。按原样使用 sfdep 的 emerging_hotspot_analysis() 时,只要几何对象没有按地点编号排序,每个镇区的结果 就会被贴到另一个镇区上;它的置换零模型从整个立方体的所有季度中抽取邻居,于是 全国性的趋势被误读为局部显著性;它的一条分类规则还忽略了 Gi* 的符号。本报告用这批 数据证明并修正了这三个缺陷。改用按期条件化的零模型之后,未修正输出中的振荡热点 从 40 个降到 2 个,分类结果呈现出干燥带的长期 核心、其南缘与东缘的新热点,以及掸邦东部山地与(2022 年以来)仰光的冷点。零模型模拟 表明,最常见的类别「零星热点」只比偶然所能产生的略多,因此本研究依据镇区处于热点 状态的季度数,而不只是标签来解读。
作为附加价值分析的空间马尔可夫链表明:当邻居处于高强度冲突时,一个平静镇区在 下一季度出现冲突的概率约为原来的两倍,且这一效应在控制镇区与季度固定效应后依然 存在。相比之下,持续冲突的首次爆发并不比随机时间分配更聚集:2021 年的起义是 全国同时爆发的,传染机制支配的是此后的升级。

title: Take-home Exercise 2: Geospatial Analytics for Peace课后作业二：面向和平的地理空间分析
section: 1.1 A civil war that is fought township by township一场逐个镇区展开的内战
text:
1.1 A civil war that is fought township by township一场逐个镇区展开的内战

Myanmar has been at war with parts of itself since independence in 1948. For most of that time the fighting was an ethnic periphery against a Bamar centre: ethnic armed organisations in the hills of Kachin, Shan, Kayin and Rakhine against the national army, the Tatmadaw. The coup of 1 February 2021 changed the geography of the conflict. The military’s suppression of the protests that followed pushed a generation of activists into armed resistance, the National Unity Government declared a “people’s defensive war” in September 2021, and local People’s Defence Forces took up arms in the Bamar lowlands, which had been largely free of armed conflict for decades (Wikipedia contributors, 2026). In October 2023 an alliance of three ethnic armed organisations launched Operation 1027 in northern Shan, and the war moved into a phase in which the military lost territory on several fronts at once.
By late 2025 more than three million people had been displaced, and the country was divided into zones held by the military, by ethnic armed organisations and by resistance forces, with much of it contested. Fighting of this kind does not happen everywhere at once or with the same intensity. It is carried out township by township, and peace-building needs to know where it concentrates, where it is spreading, and where it is dying down.


自 1948 年独立以来,缅甸就一直与自身的一部分处于战争之中。在大部分时间里,战事 是族群边缘对抗缅族中心:克钦、掸、克伦与若开山地的民族武装组织对抗国家军队 (Tatmadaw)。2021 年 2 月 1 日的政变改变了冲突的地理格局。军方对随后抗议的镇压 把一代社会活动者推向武装抵抗;民族团结政府于 2021 年 9 月宣布「人民自卫战争」; 地方人民防卫军在缅族聚居的低地拿起武器,而这些地区此前数十年基本没有武装冲突 (Wikipedia contributors, 2026)。2023 年 10 月,三个民族武装组织结成的联盟在掸邦北部发起「1027 行动」,战争进入军方在多条战线同时失地的阶段。
到 2025 年底,流离失所人数已超过三百万,国家被分割为军方控制区、民族武装控制区与 抵抗力量控制区,其中大片地区处于争夺之中。这种性质的战争不会在所有地方同时、以 同样的强度发生。它以镇区为单位展开,而和平建设需要知道:冲突集中在哪里, 正向哪里扩散,又在哪里逐渐平息。

title: Take-home Exercise 2: Geospatial Analytics for Peace课后作业二：面向和平的地理空间分析
section: 1.2 Why local spatial statistics为什么用局部空间统计
text:
1.2 Why local spatial statistics为什么用局部空间统计

A choropleth of event counts answers the first of those questions only loosely. A dark township may be one of a cluster of dark townships or an isolated case, and the eye is poor at telling a real cluster from a chance arrangement of 329 shades. Local measures of spatial association (LMSA) formalise the comparison. Local Moran’s I (Anselin, 1995) asks whether a township resembles its neighbours more than chance would allow, and so separates clusters (high among high, low among low) from spatial outliers (high among low, low among high). Getis-Ord Gi* (Getis & Ord, 1992; Ord & Getis, 1995) asks whether the total in a township’s neighbourhood, the township included, is unusually large or small, and so marks hot and cold spots without distinguishing a cluster from an outlier.
Both statistics describe one snapshot. Emerging hot spot analysis (EHSA) extends Gi* to a space-time cube: Gi* is computed for every township in every period, and a Mann-Kendall test (Kendall, 1975; Mann, 1945) on each township’s series of Gi* values classifies the township by the trajectory of its hot-spot status, whether new, intensifying, persistent, sporadic or diminishing (Esri, 2024). The approach has been applied to gun violence (Boschan & Roman, 2024), to roadkill (Kim & Lee, 2023) and to network events (Putrenko et al., 2018), and the space-time dimensions of conflict events have been explored in this way before (Mack & Kam, 2018).


事件计数的分级设色图只能粗略地回答上面的第一个问题。一个深色镇区可能是一片深色 镇区中的一员,也可能是孤立个案;而人眼很难把真实的聚集与 329 种深浅的偶然排列 区分开来。局部空间关联指标(LMSA)把这一比较形式化。局部 Moran’s I (Anselin, 1995) 问的是:一个镇区与其邻居的相似程度是否超出偶然所能解释的范围,并 据此把聚集(高中之高、低中之低)与空间异常值(低中之高、高中之低)区分 开来。Getis-Ord Gi* (Getis & Ord, 1992; Ord & Getis, 1995) 问的是:一个镇区所在邻域(包含其自身) 的总量是否异常地大或小,据此标出热点与冷点,但不区分聚集与异常值。
这两种统计量描述的都是一个截面。新兴热点分析(EHSA)把 Gi* 扩展到时空立方体: 对每个镇区在每个时期计算 Gi*,再对每个镇区的 Gi* 序列做 Mann-Kendall 检验 (Kendall, 1975; Mann, 1945),按其热点状态的轨迹为镇区分类:新出现、增强、持续、 零星或减弱 (Esri, 2024)。这一方法已被用于枪支暴力 (Boschan & Roman, 2024)、道路动物致死 (Kim & Lee, 2023) 与网络事件 (Putrenko et al., 2018),冲突事件的时空维度此前也曾用类似方式探索过 (Mack & Kam, 2018)。

title: Take-home Exercise 2: Geospatial Analytics for Peace课后作业二：面向和平的地理空间分析
text:
1.3 Research questions研究问题

RQ1 · Where. Where are the statistically significant hot spots, cold spots and spatial outliers of armed conflict among Myanmar’s townships between January 2021 and September 2025, and do they differ between battles, remote violence, violence against civilians and fatalities?


RQ1 · 在哪里。 2021 年 1 月至 2025 年 9 月,缅甸各镇区武装冲突的统计显著热点、 冷点与空间异常值在哪里?它们在战斗、远程暴力、针对平民的暴力与死亡人数之间是否 不同?


RQ2 · How it evolves. How has the pattern changed quarter by quarter: which townships are new, intensifying, persistent, sporadic or diminishing hot and cold spots?


RQ2 · 如何演变。 这一格局如何逐季度变化:哪些镇区是新出现、增强、持续、零星或 减弱的热点与冷点?


RQ3 · How it spreads (value-added). Does armed conflict spread from a township to its neighbours, and if it does, is contagion what starts conflict in a township or what escalates it once it has started?


RQ3 · 如何扩散(附加价值分析)。 武装冲突是否会从一个镇区扩散到其邻居?如果会, 传染机制是引发一个镇区的冲突,还是在冲突开始之后使其升级?


RQ1 is answered in § 6, RQ2 in § 7 and RQ3 in § 8. Before any of them, § 3 sets out the data preparation, because several of the results depend on decisions taken there. § 4 collects the analytical assumptions in one place.


RQ1 在 § 6 回答,RQ2 在 § 7,RQ3 在 § 8。在此之前,§ 3 交代 数据准备,因为若干结果取决于在那里做出的决定;§ 4 则把分析假设集中列出。

title: Take-home Exercise 2: Geospatial Analytics for Peace课后作业二：面向和平的地理空间分析
text:
2.1 Data sources数据来源

Two datasets are combined. The conflict events come from the Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project (ACLED, Raleigh et al., 2010; Raleigh et al., 2023), as the Myanmar extract distributed for this exercise. The township polygons are the Myanmar Information Management Unit’s township boundaries, version 9.4 (Myanmar Information Management Unit, 2024), downloaded from the MIMU GeoNode as a WFS shapefile export.


本研究结合两套数据。冲突事件来自「武装冲突地点与事件数据项目」(ACLED, Raleigh et al., 2010; Raleigh et al., 2023),使用本作业分发的缅甸数据摘录。镇区多边形采用缅甸信息 管理单位(MIMU)的镇区边界 9.4 版 (Myanmar Information Management Unit, 2024),以 WFS shapefile 导出的形式从 MIMU GeoNode 下载。



Code

  Dataset = c("ACLED event data, Myanmar", "MIMU township boundaries v9.4"),
  `File` = c(audit$source_file, "mmr_polbnda_adm3_250k_mimu_1.shp"),
  Records = c(n_fmt(audit$n_raw), n_fmt(bnd$geom_report$n)),
  Coverage = c(paste(format(audit$date_range, "%d %b %Y"), collapse = " – "),
               paste0(n_fmt(bnd$area_geod_km2), " km² (geodesic)")),
  Geometry = c("Point (WGS 84 latitude / longitude)",
               "Polygon, 1:250,000, WGS 84"),
  `Key fields` = c("event_date, event_type, sub_event_type, latitude, longitude, geo_precision, admin3, fatalities",
                   "ST, DT, TS, TS_PCODE")

The ACLED file records 87,109 events in 31 fields, dated 01 January 2021 to 30 September 2025. Its latest modification timestamp is 29 September 2026, a year after the study window closes, so late reports and ACLED’s routine revisions for the final quarter should already be included. The MIMU layer holds 330 townships, and TS_PCODE is a unique, complete identifier for them.


ACLED 文件在 31 个字段中记录了 87,109 起事件,日期从 2021 年 01 月 01 日 到 2025 年 09 月 30 日。其最晚修改时间戳为 2026 年 09 月 29 日,比研究窗口结束晚了一年,因此最后 一个季度的迟到报告与 ACLED 的例行修订应当都已包含在内。MIMU 图层包含 330 个镇区,TS_PCODE 是它们唯一且完整的标识符。

title: Take-home Exercise 2: Geospatial Analytics for Peace课后作业二：面向和平的地理空间分析
section: 2.2 Study area, unit of analysis and time unit研究区、分析单元与时间单元
text:
2.2 Study area, unit of analysis and time unit研究区、分析单元与时间单元


Code
map_base(
  geom_sf(data = ts_an, fill = "#f5f5f4", colour = "#a8a29e", linewidth = 0.12),
  title = "Myanmar: 329 townships in MIMU's 18 state and region units",
  subtitle = "MIMU township boundaries v9.4, Albers equal-area projection"
) +
  geom_text(data = state_pts, aes(x, y, label = ST), size = 2.6,
            colour = "#1c1917", fontface = "bold", check_overlap = TRUE)








Figure 1: Study area. The 329 townships of the analytical frame inside the MIMU state and region boundaries. Cocokyun, the one township left out (see § 3.1.3), is the small island group in solid grey in the Andaman Sea, south-west of the delta.研究区。分析框架中的 329 个镇区,及 MIMU 的省邦边界。唯一被排除的镇区 Cocokyun(见 § 3.1.3)是三角洲西南方安达曼海中以灰色实心显示的小群岛。






The township is the spatial unit. It is the unit the brief asks for, and it is also the finest unit that ACLED’s own location coding supports across the whole dataset. Of the conflict events analysed, 45.2% carry geo_precision 2: ACLED knows the township but only places the event “near” its main town. Treating those coordinates as points would put a spurious concentration on every township seat. Aggregated to the township, they are counted in the right place.
The quarter is the primary time unit, with months kept for sensitivity analysis. A quarter gives 19 time steps, enough for a Mann-Kendall trend test, while halving the share of empty township-periods from 50.6% (months) to 31.3%. The choice is tested in § 7.6.


镇区是空间单元。这既是作业要求的单元,也是 ACLED 自身的位置编码在整个数据集上 所能支持的最细单元。在被分析的冲突事件中, 45.2% 的 geo_precision 为 2:ACLED 知道事件所在的镇区,但只能把它放在镇区主镇「附近」。 如果把这些坐标当作点,就会在每个镇区驻地制造出虚假的集中;汇总到镇区之后,它们 则被计入正确的位置。
季度是主要的时间单元,月度数据保留用于敏感性分析。季度提供 19 个时间步, 足以进行 Mann-Kendall 趋势检验,同时把空的镇区-时期占比从月度的 50.6% 降到 31.3%。这一选择在 § 7.6 中检验。

title: Take-home Exercise 2: Geospatial Analytics for Peace课后作业二：面向和平的地理空间分析
section: 2.3 The armed-conflict variables武装冲突变量
text:
2.3 The armed-conflict variables武装冲突变量

Five variables are built, each counted by township and by quarter. They are kept apart because the three event types are produced by different actors using different means, and there is no reason to assume they share a geography.


本研究构建了五个变量,均按镇区与季度计数。之所以分开处理,是因为三种事件类型由 不同的行动者以不同的手段造成,没有理由假定它们共享同一种地理分布。



Code
tibble(
  Variable = names(VARS),
  Label = unname(VARS),
  Definition = c(
    "Every event of the three types below",
    "Armed clashes between organised armed groups, and territory taken or retaken by force",
    "Air and drone strikes, shelling and artillery, remote explosives and IEDs, grenades: one side attacks without being physically present",
    "Attacks, abductions, sexual violence and other violence by an armed group against unarmed civilians",
    "Sum of ACLED's reported fatalities over the events above"),
  Total = c(n_fmt(sum(ts_tot$conflict)), n_fmt(sum(ts_tot$battles)),
            n_fmt(sum(ts_tot$erv)), n_fmt(sum(ts_tot$vac)),
            n_fmt(sum(ts_tot$fatalities))),
  `Townships with none` = c(sum(ts_tot$conflict == 0), sum(ts_tot$battles == 0),
                            sum(ts_tot$erv == 0), sum(ts_tot$vac == 0),
                            sum(ts_tot$fatalities == 0))
) |>

  cols_width(Definition ~ px(380)) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(13))

Protests, riots and strategic developments are excluded. They are recorded by ACLED but are not armed conflict: a protest is a demonstration, and a strategic development is a non-violent event such as an arrest, a troop movement or an agreement. One borderline category deserves mention: 261 events of “excessive force against protesters”, with 509 reported deaths, mostly in the first months of 2021, are filed by ACLED under protests. They describe lethal state violence, but they belong to the crackdown that preceded the armed conflict, and they are left out.


抗议、骚乱与战略性事态被排除。ACLED 记录了它们,但它们不是武装冲突:抗议是示威, 战略性事态是逮捕、部队调动或协议之类的非暴力事件。有一个边界类别值得一提: 261 起「对抗议者过度使用武力」事件,报告死亡 509 人,大多发生在 2021 年最初几个月,被 ACLED 归入抗议类别。它们描述的是致命的国家暴力,但属于武装冲突之前的镇压阶段,因此不计入。

title: Take-home Exercise 2: Geospatial Analytics for Peace课后作业二：面向和平的地理空间分析
text:
2.4 Software软件

The analysis is written in R. sf (Pebesma, 2018) handles the vector data; spdep builds neighbour lists and weights and computes local Moran’s I by conditional permutation (Bivand & Wong, 2018); sfdep (Parry, 2023) builds the space-time cube and provides Gi* and the reference EHSA implementation; Kendall (McLeod, 2022) computes the Mann-Kendall test. Maps are drawn with ggplot2. Exact versions are listed in § 12.


分析使用 R 完成。sf (Pebesma, 2018) 处理矢量数据;spdep 构建邻接列表与权重, 并以条件置换计算局部 Moran’s I (Bivand & Wong, 2018);sfdep (Parry, 2023) 构建时空立方体, 提供 Gi* 以及作为参照的 EHSA 实现;Kendall (McLeod, 2022) 计算 Mann-Kendall 检验。地图用 ggplot2 绘制。确切版本见 § 12。

title: Take-home Exercise 2: Geospatial Analytics for Peace课后作业二：面向和平的地理空间分析
text:
3.1 The township layer镇区图层

3.1.1 Import and integrity checks导入与完整性检查


Code
ts <- st_read("data/raw/mimu_adm3/mmr_polbnda_adm3_250k_mimu_1.shp", quiet = TRUE)

geom_report <- list(
  n         = nrow(ts),
  invalid   = sum(!st_is_valid(ts)),
  empty     = sum(st_is_empty(ts)),
  dup_pcode = sum(duplicated(ts$TS_PCODE)),
  na_pcode  = sum(is.na(ts$TS_PCODE) | ts$TS_PCODE == ""),
  multipart = sum(vapply(st_geometry(ts), function(g) length(g) > 1L, logical(1)))
)



Every local statistic in this report is indexed by polygon, so a duplicated or missing identifier would silently corrupt every join that follows. The layer is clean: 330 townships, 0 invalid and 0 empty geometries, 0 duplicated and 0 missing TS_PCODE. 41 townships are multipart, which is expected on an archipelagic coast and in Myanmar’s river deltas, and needs no correction.


本报告中每个局部统计量都以多边形为索引,因此一个重复或缺失的标识符会悄无声息地 破坏之后的每一次连接。该图层是干净的:330 个镇区, 0 个无效几何、0 个空几何, TS_PCODE 重复 0 个、缺失 0 个。有 41 个镇区是多部件多边形,这在多岛屿的海岸与缅甸的 河口三角洲属于正常现象,无需修正。



3.1.2 Choosing the projection by measuring it通过测量来选择投影

Myanmar spans 92.2° to 101.2° E, across UTM zones 46N and 47N, so neither zone covers the country without stretching it. Four candidate projections are scored on how far each township’s planar area departs from its ellipsoidal (geodesic) area, which is the quantity that event densities in § 6.5 depend on. The reference is computed with s2 switched off, so that sf hands the calculation to lwgeom’s ellipsoidal geodesic routines rather than to s2’s sphere.


缅甸横跨东经 92.2° 至 101.2°,跨越 UTM 46N 与 47N 两个分带,任何一个分带都无法在不拉伸的情况下覆盖全国。本研究按每个 镇区的平面面积与其椭球(测地)面积之间的偏离程度,为四个候选投影打分,因为 § 6.5 中的事件密度取决于这一量。参照值在关闭 s2 的情况下计算,使 sf 把计算 交给 lwgeom 的椭球测地算法,而不是 s2 的球面。



Code
bnd$crs_scores |>
  mutate(crs = recode(crs,
    AEA_MMR  = "Albers equal-area, centred on Myanmar (12° N, 26° N)",
    LAEA_MMR = "Lambert azimuthal equal-area, centred on Myanmar",
    `EPSG:32647` = "WGS 84 / UTM 47N (EPSG:32647)",
    `EPSG:32646` = "WGS 84 / UTM 46N (EPSG:32646)")) |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(crs = "Projection", total_err_pct = "National total error (%)",
             max_abs_err_pct = "Worst township (%)",
             med_abs_err_pct = "Median township (%)") |>
  fmt_scientific(columns = c(total_err_pct, max_abs_err_pct, med_abs_err_pct),
                 decimals = 2) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(13))

4.33 × 10−7

Table 3: Area distortion of four candidate projections against geodesic area, over all 330 townships. Ranked by the worst single township.四个候选投影相对测地面积的面积变形(覆盖全部 330 个镇区),按最差的单个镇区排序。





Both equal-area projections keep every township’s area to within a few millionths of a per cent, which is expected, since preserving area is what they are built to do. The UTM zones distort the worst township by more than 1%. The Albers projection is selected; its standard parallels at 12° N and 26° N sit inside the country’s own latitude range. Distances, which matter for the k-nearest-neighbour weights used in sensitivity analysis, are only mildly affected at this scale.


两个等积投影都把每个镇区的面积误差控制在百万分之几个百分点以内,这在意料之中, 因为保持面积正是它们的设计目的。UTM 分带对最差镇区的变形超过 1%。本研究选用 Albers 等积投影,其标准纬线 12° N 与 26° N 位于缅甸自身的纬度范围之内。对于 敏感性分析中的 k 近邻权重而言,距离在这一尺度上只受到轻微影响。



3.1.3 Townships without neighbours没有邻居的镇区

A contiguity-based local statistic is undefined for a polygon with no contiguous neighbour. With queen contiguity, 3 townships have none and the neighbour graph falls into 4 disconnected pieces. Left alone, spdep returns an empty neighbour set for each of them, which propagates as a missing value through every row-standardised weight and quietly removes them from the analysis. Each case is therefore decided on its own, by the distance to the nearest township.


对于没有任何相邻邻居的多边形,基于邻接的局部统计量没有定义。采用 queen 邻接时,有 3 个镇区没有邻居,邻接图分裂为 4 个互不连通的部分。若不处理,spdep 会为它们返回空的邻居集,这会以缺失值的形式在 每一个行标准化权重中传播,把它们悄无声息地从分析中剔除。因此本研究按每个镇区到 最近镇区的距离,逐一做出决定。



Code
bnd$nb_report$islands_dist |>
  mutate(Decision = ifelse(dist_km > 50,
                           "Excluded from the analytical frame",
                           paste0("Linked to ", nearest))) |>
  select(Township = TS, Pcode = TS_PCODE, `Nearest township` = nearest,
         `Edge-to-edge distance (km)` = dist_km, Decision) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(`Edge-to-edge distance (km)`, decimals = 1) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(13))

Table 4: The three townships with no queen-contiguous neighbour, and what was done with each.三个没有 queen 邻接邻居的镇区,以及对每个镇区的处理方式。






Code
ts_an <- ts_proj |>
  filter(!TS_PCODE %in% excluded) |>      # Cocokyun
  arrange(TS_PCODE)                        # see the note on sorting below

nb_an <- poly2nb(ts_an, queen = TRUE)
for (r in seq_len(nrow(linked))) {         # Munaung -> Ramree, Chaungzon -> Mudon
  i <- match(linked$TS_PCODE[r],      ts_an$TS_PCODE)
  j <- match(linked$nearest_pcode[r], ts_an$TS_PCODE)
  nb_an[[i]] <- sort(unique(c(setdiff(nb_an[[i]], 0L), j)))
  nb_an[[j]] <- sort(unique(c(setdiff(nb_an[[j]], 0L), i)))
}
stopifnot(all(card(nb_an) > 0), n.comp.nb(nb_an)$nc == 1L, is.symmetric.nb(nb_an))



Munaung and Chaungzon lie within a few kilometres of the mainland (Chaungzon is Bilu Island, joined to the Mawlamyine side by a bridge) and are linked to their nearest township in both directions, which keeps the graph symmetric. Cocokyun is more than 100 km out in the Andaman Sea. Any neighbour assigned to it would be invented, and it carries no ACLED record of any kind in the 57 months, so it is removed from the analytical frame and kept only as a cartographic feature. The result is 329 townships in a single connected graph with 5.23 neighbours on average and at most 11.
The frame is sorted by TS_PCODE on purpose. § 7.3 shows that sfdep’s emerging_hotspot_analysis() labels its results correctly only when the geometry is in that order.


Munaung 与 Chaungzon 距离大陆只有几公里(Chaungzon 即 Bilu 岛,通过大桥与毛淡棉 一侧相连),因此把它们与各自最近的镇区双向连接,以保持邻接图的对称性。 Cocokyun 位于安达曼海中 100 多公里之外。给它分配任何邻居都是虚构的,而且它在 57 个 月中没有任何类型的 ACLED 记录,因此把它从分析框架中移除,只作为制图要素保留。 最终得到 329 个镇区,构成单一的连通图,平均 5.23 个邻居,最多 11 个。
分析框架刻意按 TS_PCODE 排序。§ 7.3 表明,只有当几何对象按这一 顺序排列时,sfdep 的 emerging_hotspot_analysis() 才会给结果贴上正确的标签。

title: Take-home Exercise 2: Geospatial Analytics for Peace课后作业二：面向和平的地理空间分析
text:
3.2 The ACLED recordsACLED 记录

3.2.1 Import, typing and basic filters导入、类型转换与基本过滤


Code
raw <- readr::read_csv(src, show_col_types = FALSE, guess_max = 200000)
names(raw) <- tolower(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", names(raw)))

ev2 <- raw |>
  mutate(event_date = parse_event_date(event_date),
         across(c(latitude, longitude, fatalities), as.numeric)) |>
  distinct(event_id_cnty, .keep_all = TRUE) |>            # ACLED's own key
  filter(event_date >= STUDY_START, event_date <= STUDY_END,
         !is.na(latitude), !is.na(longitude)) |>
  filter(country == "Myanmar")                            # drops "Indian Ocean"



Field names are normalised once, because ACLED has shipped the same fields with different capitalisation across releases. Duplicates are removed on ACLED’s event identifier rather than on whole rows: two genuinely distinct events can share a date, a place and a type. The extract turns out to be clean on all of these counts, with 0 duplicated identifiers, 0 unparseable dates, 0 dates outside the window, 0 missing coordinates and 0 missing fatality counts. What it does contain are 6 maritime records whose country is “Indian Ocean”; they have no township and are dropped.


字段名统一规范化一次,因为 ACLED 在不同版本中以不同的大小写发布相同字段。去重依据 ACLED 的事件标识符,而不是整行:两起真实存在的不同事件可能日期、地点与类型都相同。 这份摘录在以下各项上都是干净的:重复标识符 0 个、无法解析的日期 0 个、窗口之外的日期 0 个、缺失坐标 0 个、缺失死亡人数 0 个。它确实包含 6 条 country 为「Indian Ocean」的海上记录,它们没有镇区, 因此被删除。



3.2.2 Geocoding by spatial join通过空间连接进行地理编码


Code
ev_sf <- st_as_sf(ev2, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326,
                  remove = FALSE) |>
  st_transform(WORK_CRS)

idx <- st_within(ev_sf, ts, sparse = TRUE)
hit <- lengths(idx) > 0L

# Points just outside every polygon (coastal rounding) are recovered by the
# nearest township, but only within 5 km.
nn <- st_nearest_feature(ev_sf[!hit, ], ts)
dd <- as.numeric(st_distance(ev_sf[!hit, ], ts[nn, ], by_element = TRUE))



Events are assigned to townships by point-in-polygon, not by matching ACLED’s admin3 name to MIMU’s TS. The two gazetteers romanise some names differently, and a text join would silently lose every township where they disagree. 9 points fall just outside every polygon, all on the coast, and are snapped to the nearest township; the furthest is 637 m away. No event falls in the excluded Cocokyun.
admin3 is then used as a check on the join. Where ACLED gives a township name, it agrees with the spatial join for 99.98% of events. The handful of disagreements are a spelling variant (Pangsang against MIMU’s “Pangsang (Panghkam)”) and events sitting on a township boundary.


事件通过点-面包含关系分配到镇区,而不是把 ACLED 的 admin3 名称与 MIMU 的 TS 做文本匹配。两套地名录对部分名称的罗马化方式不同,文本连接会悄无声息地丢失所有 名称不一致的镇区。有 9 个点落在所有多边形之外,全部位于 海岸,被吸附到最近的镇区;最远的一个距离 637 m。没有 任何事件落在被排除的 Cocokyun。
随后用 admin3 作为空间连接的检验。在 ACLED 给出镇区名称的事件中, 99.98% 与空间连接一致。少数不一致的是 拼写变体(Pangsang 对应 MIMU 的「Pangsang (Panghkam)」)以及恰好落在镇区边界上的 事件。



3.2.3 Two land mines in the location coding位置编码中的两颗地雷

The spatial join succeeds for every record, and that is exactly the danger. Two groups of records receive a township they do not belong to.
City-only records. 1,112 records have no admin3 at all. ACLED knows these events happened in Mandalay, in Yangon or in Nay Pyi Taw, but not in which township, and places them at a single reference point for the city. The spatial join then assigns every one of them to whichever township contains that point.


空间连接对每一条记录都成功了,而这恰恰是危险所在。有两组记录被分配到了它们并不 属于的镇区。
仅知城市的记录。 有 1,112 条记录完全没有 admin3。 ACLED 知道这些事件发生在曼德勒、仰光或内比都,但不知道具体在哪个镇区,于是把它们 放在城市的单一参考点上。空间连接随后把它们全部分配给恰好包含该点的那个镇区。



Code
audit$city_only |>
  group_by(`ACLED location` = location, `Township it would land in` = mimu_township) |>
  summarise(`All records` = sum(n), `Of which conflict` = sum(n[conflict]),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(`All records`)) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(13))











ACLED location
Township it would land in
All records
Of which conflict

Chanayethazan

Table 5: Records with no ACLED township, and the township the spatial join would have given them. All event types are shown; the conflict column counts the three armed-conflict types.没有 ACLED 镇区信息的记录,以及空间连接本会把它们分配到的镇区。表中包含全部事件类型;冲突一栏只统计三类武装冲突事件。





Kept, they would lift Chanayethazan from outside Mandalay’s top five to second place for protests, make Bahan Yangon’s most eventful township by a wide margin (313 protests against 78 in the next township), and make Za Bu Thi Ri the centre of almost every event in the capital. For the conflict variables the effect is smaller, 107 events, but the mechanism is the same.
Region-only records. ACLED’s geo_precision 3 means the event is known only to a district or a state and is coded at its capital. 88 further conflict events are in this group. Assigning them to the capital’s township manufactures the very concentration that a hot spot analysis looks for.
Both groups are removed from the township analysis, and the counts are kept in the audit. Together they are 0.36% of the conflict events, small enough that removing them cannot move a regional pattern, and concentrated enough that keeping them would plant false hot spots in a handful of city-centre townships.


如果保留它们,Chanayethazan 的抗议数会从曼德勒前五名之外升到第二位;Bahan 会以 悬殊的差距成为仰光事件最多的镇区(抗议 313 起,排名其次的镇区只有 78 起);而 Za Bu Thi Ri 会成为首都几乎所有事件的中心。对冲突变量而言,影响较小,为 107 起事件,但机制相同。
仅知区域的记录。 ACLED 的 geo_precision 3 意味着只知道事件发生在某个县或省邦, 并被编码在其首府。另有 88 起冲突事件属于这一组。把它们 分配给首府所在镇区,恰好会制造出热点分析所要寻找的那种集中。
两组记录都从镇区分析中移除,其计数保留在审计记录中。二者合计占冲突事件的 0.36%, 少到移除它们不可能改变区域格局,却又集中到保留它们就会在少数城市中心镇区埋下 虚假热点。



Code
n_conf <- audit$loc_flow$conflict_geocoded
tibble(
  Step = c("Records in the extract",
           "Not in Myanmar (\"Indian Ocean\")",
           "Geocoded to a MIMU township (incl. snapped)",
           "Of which armed-conflict event types",
           "City-only location (no admin3)",
           "Region-only location (geo_precision 3)",
           "Armed-conflict events analysed"),
  Records = c(audit$n_raw, -audit$n_not_myanmar, audit$n_geocoded, n_conf,
              -audit$loc_flow$city_only, -audit$loc_flow$region_only,
              audit$loc_flow$analysed),
  `Reported fatalities` = c(NA, NA, NA, audit$loc_flow$fatal_geocoded, NA, NA,
                            audit$loc_flow$fatal_analysed)
) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(c(Records, `Reported fatalities`), decimals = 0) |>
  sub_missing(missing_text = "") |>
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_body(rows = Step == "Armed-conflict events analysed")) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(13))

The precision split also justifies the choice of the township as unit (§ 2.2). Battles in particular are known only to the township for more than half of the events, which is consistent with clashes in rural areas reported by the township in which they occurred.


精度分布也为选择镇区作为分析单元提供了依据(§ 2.2)。尤其是战斗,超过一半的 事件只知道所在镇区,这与农村地区的交火按其所在镇区报道的情况相符。

map_base(
  geom_sf(data = ts_map, aes(fill = share_prec2), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.05),
  title = "How precisely ACLED locates conflict events",
  subtitle = "Share of a township's events placed only 'near' its main town"

  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("#f1f5f9", "#94a3b8", "#334155"),
                       limits = c(0, 1), labels = label_percent(),
                       na.value = "#d6d3d1", name = "Precision 2")








Figure 2: Share of each township’s analysed conflict events that ACLED could place only near the township’s main town (geo_precision 2). Grey: no conflict event.各镇区被分析的冲突事件中,ACLED 只能放置在镇区主镇附近(geo_precision 2)的比例。灰色:没有冲突事件。






Location precision. Where precision 2 dominates, ACLED knows the township but not the village, and the township count is the most detailed statement the data can support. Precision is highest in Yangon, where only about one event in nine is placed this loosely, and in Mandalay and the Ayeyarwady delta, where events are reported by ward or village. It is lowest in Kayin, southern Shan, Kachin and Kayah, where more than half the events are known only to the township. This is one reason the analysis stops at township level: in those areas a point pattern would show how events were reported, not where they happened.


位置精度。 在精度 2 占主导的地方,ACLED 知道镇区而不知道村庄,镇区计数就是数据 所能支持的最详细表述。仰光的精度最高,大约每九起事件中只有一起是这样粗略定位的; 曼德勒与伊洛瓦底三角洲次之,事件按街区或村庄报道。克伦、掸邦南部、克钦与克耶的 精度最低,超过一半的事件只知道所在镇区。这是分析停在镇区一级的原因之一:在那些 地区,点模式只能显示事件是如何被报道的,而不是发生在哪里。

title: Take-home Exercise 2: Geospatial Analytics for Peace课后作业二：面向和平的地理空间分析
section: 3.3 Building the space-time panels构建时空面板

title: Take-home Exercise 2: Geospatial Analytics for Peace课后作业二：面向和平的地理空间分析
section: 4.1 Why counts and not rates为什么用计数而不是比率
text:
4.1 Why counts and not rates为什么用计数而不是比率

A rate per person would be the natural measure of exposure, and it is not available. Myanmar’s last complete census was taken in 2014, and the census the military government attempted in 2024 could not be carried out across large parts of the country. Even an accurate 2014 figure would be the wrong denominator: the displacement since 2021 has emptied precisely the townships with the most conflict, so a 2014-based rate would overstate risk per remaining resident by an unknown and spatially varying factor. The counts are therefore read as what they are, a measure of where violent events happen, not of individual risk. Area-based density is used as a sensitivity check, because township area does vary by two orders of magnitude.


人均比率本应是衡量暴露程度的自然指标,但无法获得。缅甸最近一次完整的普查在 2014 年;军政府 2024 年尝试进行的普查在全国大片地区无法开展。即使有准确的 2014 年数据,它也是 错误的分母:2021 年以来的流离失所恰恰掏空了冲突最多的镇区,因此以 2014 年为基础的 比率会以一个未知且空间上变化的倍数,高估每名留守居民的风险。因此,计数就按其本来 的含义来解读:暴力事件发生在哪里,而不是个人风险。由于镇区面积相差两个数量级, 本研究以按面积计算的密度作为敏感性检验。

title: Take-home Exercise 2: Geospatial Analytics for Peace课后作业二：面向和平的地理空间分析
section: 4.2 Reporting is not occurrence被报道不等于发生
text:
4.2 Reporting is not occurrence被报道不等于发生

ACLED codes events from media, local partner organisations and other reports, and its coverage is better where reporting is denser (Raleigh et al., 2023). Event datasets of this kind are known to under-record violence in remote areas and to vary with media attention (Eck, 2012; Weidmann, 2016). In Myanmar, internet shutdowns and restrictions on journalists add to the gap. A cold spot can therefore mean an area with little violence or an area with little reporting. The analysis cannot separate the two, and the interpretation in § 7 and § 9 keeps the possibility in view, especially for the Wa and eastern Shan hills, where the cold zone is largest.


ACLED 依据媒体、地方合作机构与其他报告对事件进行编码,报道越密集的地方覆盖越好 (Raleigh et al., 2023)。已知这类事件数据集会低估偏远地区的暴力,并随媒体关注度而变化 (Eck, 2012; Weidmann, 2016)。在缅甸,断网与对记者的限制进一步扩大了这一差距。因此, 冷点可能意味着暴力少,也可能意味着报道少。分析无法区分二者,§ 7 与 § 9 的解读始终把这种可能性放在视野之内,尤其是冷区面积最大的佤邦与 掸邦东部山地。

title: Take-home Exercise 2: Geospatial Analytics for Peace课后作业二：面向和平的地理空间分析
text:
4.3 Multiple testing多重检验

A local statistic is one hypothesis test per township, so a map of 329 townships at p < 0.05 contains about 16.45 significant results even if the data have no spatial structure at all. The brief asks for maps of p < 0.05, and those are drawn. The tests are also neighbours of one another and share data, so the false discovery rate procedure of Benjamini & Hochberg (1995), as applied to local statistics by Caldas de Castro & Singer (2006), is reported alongside, and townships that survive it are outlined on the maps. A township with a coloured fill and a heavy outline is significant under both; a fill without an outline is significant only at the unadjusted level.


局部统计量对每个镇区做一次假设检验,所以即便数据完全没有空间结构,329 个镇区在 p < 0.05 下也会出现约 16.45 个显著结果。作业要求绘制 p < 0.05 的 地图,本报告照此绘制。由于这些检验彼此相邻、共享数据,本报告同时报告 Benjamini & Hochberg (1995) 提出、并由 Caldas de Castro & Singer (2006) 应用于局部统计量的错误发现率(FDR)校正, 通过校正的镇区在地图上加粗描边。有填色且粗描边的镇区在两种标准下都显著; 只有填色没有描边的镇区只在未校正水平下显著。

title: Take-home Exercise 2: Geospatial Analytics for Peace课后作业二：面向和平的地理空间分析
text:
5.1 The national trajectory全国走势


Code
nat <- panel_q |>
  group_by(period) |>
  summarise(across(c(battles, erv, vac, fatalities, airstrike), sum), .groups = "drop")

marks <- tibble(
  date = as.Date(c("2021-02-01", "2021-09-07", "2023-10-27", "2025-03-28")),
  lab  = c("Coup", "NUG declares\ndefensive war", "Operation\n1027", "Mandalay\nearthquake"))

type_cols <- c("Battles" = "#9f1239",
               "Explosions / remote violence" = "#f97316",
               "Violence against civilians" = "#475569")

p_ev <- nat |>
  select(period, Battles = battles, `Explosions / remote violence` = erv,
         `Violence against civilians` = vac) |>
  pivot_longer(-period, names_to = "type", values_to = "n") |>
  mutate(type = factor(type, levels = names(type_cols))) |>
  ggplot(aes(period + 45, n, fill = type)) +
  geom_col(width = 80, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(data = marks, aes(xintercept = date), linetype = "22",
             colour = "#1c1917", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_text(data = marks, aes(x = date, y = Inf, label = lab), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            vjust = 1.1, hjust = -0.04, size = 2.8, lineheight = 0.9, colour = "#1c1917") +
  scale_fill_manual(NULL, values = type_cols) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma(), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  labs(title = "Armed-conflict events per quarter",
       subtitle = "Explosions and remote violence have outnumbered battles in every quarter since late 2023",
       x = NULL, y = "Events") +
  theme_th(11)

p_fat <- ggplot(nat, aes(period + 45, fatalities)) +
  geom_col(width = 80, fill = "#7f1d1d") +
  geom_vline(data = marks, aes(xintercept = date), linetype = "22",
             colour = "#1c1917", linewidth = 0.35) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma(), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  labs(title = "Reported fatalities per quarter", x = NULL, y = "Fatalities") +
  theme_th(11)

p_ev / p_fat + plot_layout(heights = c(1.6, 1))








Figure 3: Armed-conflict events per quarter by type (upper panel) and reported fatalities per quarter (lower panel), Myanmar, 2021 Q1 to 2025 Q3. Vertical lines mark four reference events.按类型分列的每季度武装冲突事件数(上图)与每季度报告死亡人数(下图),缅甸,2021 年第一季度至 2025 年第三季度。竖线标出四个参照事件。






The trajectory. Recorded armed conflict rose from 398 events in the first quarter of 2021, the quarter of the coup, to a peak of 4,021 in 2023 Q4, the quarter of Operation 1027, and has stayed near 3,000 a quarter since. The composition changed as it grew. Violence against civilians peaked in 2022 and has declined since, while explosions and remote violence rose from 38.6% of events in 2022 to 46.1% in 2025. Air and drone strikes alone went from 88 in 2021 to 2,975 in 2024. Fatalities peak in the same quarters as events but are more volatile, because a handful of large battles, some with several hundred reported deaths, dominate any quarter in which they occur. The national series is not stationary, which matters for the emerging hot spot analysis in § 7.


走势。 记录在案的武装冲突从 2021 年第一季度(政变所在季度)的 398 起,上升到 2023 Q4(1027 行动所在季度)的峰值 4,021 起,此后一直维持在每季度约 3,000 起。增长过程中构成也在变化。针对平民的 暴力在 2022 年达到峰值后持续下降,而爆炸与远程暴力的占比从 2022 年的 38.6% 升到 2025 年的 46.1%。仅空袭与 无人机袭击一项,就从 2021 年的 88 起增加到 2024 年 的 2,975 起。死亡人数的峰值与事件数出现在同样的季度, 但波动更大,因为少数大规模战斗(有的报告数百人死亡)会主导它们所在的季度。 全国序列并不平稳,这一点对 § 7 的新兴热点分析很重要。

title: Take-home Exercise 2: Geospatial Analytics for Peace课后作业二：面向和平的地理空间分析
section: 5.2 Who initiates the violence暴力由谁发起
text:
5.2 Who initiates the violence暴力由谁发起


Code
act_cols <- c("State forces" = "#1e293b", "Political militia" = "#e11d48",
              "Rebel group" = "#f59e0b", "Other" = "#d6d3d1")

audit$actor_year |>
  mutate(actor_type = ifelse(actor_type %in% names(act_cols), actor_type, "Other"),
         actor_type = factor(actor_type, levels = names(act_cols)),
         event_type = recode(event_type,
                             `Explosions/Remote violence` = "Explosions / remote violence")) |>
  group_by(year, event_type, actor_type) |>
  summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop_last") |>
  mutate(share = n / sum(n)) |>
  ggplot(aes(factor(year), share, fill = actor_type)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ event_type) +
  scale_fill_manual("Initiating actor", values = act_cols) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent()) +
  labs(title = "Who initiates each kind of event",
       subtitle = "ACLED's first-actor type, share of events per year",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_th(10.5)








Figure 4: Share of each event type by the type of the first actor (ACLED inter1), by year. ‘Political militia’ in ACLED’s Myanmar coding includes the People’s Defence Forces and unidentified armed groups.按年份与第一行动者类型(ACLED inter1)划分的各类事件占比。在 ACLED 的缅甸编码中,「政治民兵」包括人民防卫军与身份不明的武装团体。






Actors. The three event types are produced by different hands, and one of them changed hands. Violence against civilians is initiated mainly by state forces in every year, and increasingly so, which is consistent with the military’s raids on villages suspected of supporting the resistance. Battles were initiated mostly by the resistance (political militias, which include the People’s Defence Forces, and ethnic armed organisations coded as rebel groups) from 2022 to 2024. Explosions and remote violence reversed: in 2021 most were the resistance’s bombs and improvised explosives, and by 2025 the large majority were initiated by state forces, as the military came to rely on air strikes, drones and artillery. This is why the three types are analysed separately: a hot spot of battles marks a front line, a hot spot of violence against civilians marks where civilians bear the cost, and the two need not coincide.


行动者。 三类事件出自不同之手,而其中一类还易手了。针对平民的暴力每年都 主要由国家武装力量发起,且占比逐年上升,这与军方对被怀疑支持抵抗力量的村庄进行 清剿相符。2022 至 2024 年间,战斗主要由抵抗力量发起(包括人民防卫军在内的政治民兵, 以及被编码为叛军团体的民族武装组织)。爆炸与远程暴力则发生了逆转:2021 年大多是 抵抗力量的炸弹与简易爆炸装置,到 2025 年绝大多数由国家武装力量发起,因为军方越来越 依赖空袭、无人机与炮击。这正是三类事件分开分析的原因:战斗热点标示前线,针对 平民的暴力热点标示平民承受代价的地方,二者未必重合。

title: Take-home Exercise 2: Geospatial Analytics for Peace课后作业二：面向和平的地理空间分析
section: 5.3 Where: the whole period在哪里:整个研究期
text:
5.3 Where: the whole period在哪里:整个研究期


Code
q_classes <- function(x, n = 5) {
  pos <- x[x > 0]
  br  <- unique(quantile(pos, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = n + 1), names = FALSE))
  lab <- paste0(n_fmt(head(br, -1) + c(0, rep(1, length(br) - 2))), "–", n_fmt(br[-1]))
  out <- as.character(cut(x, br, include.lowest = TRUE, labels = lab))
  out[x == 0] <- "0"
  factor(out, levels = c("0", lab))
}

ramp6 <- c("#f5f5f4", "#fde0dd", "#fa9fb5", "#f768a1", "#c51b8a", "#7a0177")

choro <- function(v) {
  d <- ts_map |> mutate(cls = q_classes(.data[[v]]))
  map_base(geom_sf(data = d, aes(fill = cls), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.04),
           title = VAR_TINY[[v]], state_lw = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(NULL, values = setNames(ramp6[seq_len(nlevels(d$cls))],
                                              levels(d$cls)), drop = FALSE) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2)) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.key.height = unit(0.32, "cm"),
          legend.key.width = unit(0.32, "cm"), legend.text = element_text(size = 7.5),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 10))
}

wrap_plots(lapply(names(VARS), choro), nrow = 1) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Armed conflict by township, Jan 2021 – Sep 2025",
                  subtitle = "Quantile classes of each variable; zero is a class of its own",
                  theme = theme_th(11))








Figure 5: The five conflict variables by township, summed over January 2021 to September 2025. Each map uses its own quantile classes, with zero as a class of its own, so that the maps compare where each variable is relatively high rather than absolute levels.五个冲突变量的镇区分布,汇总 2021 年 1 月至 2025 年 9 月。每幅图使用各自的分位数分级,零值单独成一级,因此这些地图比较的是各变量在哪里相对较高,而非绝对水平。






The whole period. Conflict touched almost every township: 322 of 329 recorded at least one event. But it is far from evenly spread. Sagaing, Magway and Mandalay together account for 42.6% of all events, and the darkest townships form a contiguous block where the three meet, around Monywa, Myaing, Pakokku and Shwebo. A second band of dark townships runs down the south-east, from eastern Bago through Kayin to Tanintharyi, and Hpakant in Kachin stands out on its own. The Ayeyarwady delta, Yangon and the east and south of Shan State are light on every map. The five variables share this broad geography, with two differences: battles reach further into Kachin and Kayah, and violence against civilians is the most concentrated in the Dry Zone. The ten townships with the most events account for 15.9% of the national total.


整个研究期。 冲突几乎波及每一个镇区:329 个镇区中有 322 个至少记录了一起事件。但分布远不均匀。实皆、马圭与曼德勒 合计占全部事件的 42.6%,颜色最深的镇区在三者交界处构成一个连片 区块,大致围绕蒙育瓦、敏建、木各具与瑞波。第二条深色带沿东南方向延伸,从勃固东部 经克伦到德林达依;克钦的帕敢则单独突出。伊洛瓦底三角洲、仰光以及掸邦东部与南部 在每幅图上都很浅。五个变量共享这一大致格局,只有两处不同:战斗更深入克钦与克耶, 针对平民的暴力则最集中于干燥带。事件最多的十个镇区占全国总数的 15.9%。

title: Take-home Exercise 2: Geospatial Analytics for Peace课后作业二：面向和平的地理空间分析
section: 5.4 Where: year by year在哪里:逐年
text:
5.4 Where: year by year在哪里:逐年


Code
yr <- panel_y |>
  mutate(per_month = conflict / months) |>
  left_join(ts_an |> select(TS_PCODE), by = "TS_PCODE") |>
  st_as_sf() |>
  mutate(cls = cut(per_month, c(-Inf, 0, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, Inf),
                   labels = c("0", "< 0.5", "0.5–1", "1–2", "2–5", "> 5")))

map_base(geom_sf(data = yr, aes(fill = cls), colour = NA),
         title = "Conflict events per month, by year",
         subtitle = "Same classes in every panel; 2025 is January–September",
         state_lw = 0.18) +
  facet_wrap(~ year, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual("Events / month", values = ramp6) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text = element_text(size = 10))








Figure 6: Conflict events per month by township, each calendar year. 2025 covers January to September, so it is shown per month like every other year and the classes are common to all five maps.各镇区每月冲突事件数,按日历年。2025 年只覆盖 1 月至 9 月,因此与其他年份一样按月显示,五幅图使用共同分级。






Year by year. In 2021 the map is mostly pale: the resistance was forming, and the heaviest violence was in Sagaing, in Kachin and Chin, and in Yangon, where the urban resistance’s bombings and the crackdown kept conflict high until 2022. In 2022 and 2023 the Dry Zone fills in, with Sagaing at 321 events a month. In 2024 the map changes shape: Rakhine rises from 26 to 152 events a month as the Arakan Army offensive took the state’s north and centre, and Mandalay reaches its peak. In 2025 Sagaing is at less than half its 2022 level, while Kayin, western Bago and even the Ayeyarwady delta record more conflict per month than in any earlier year. The number of townships averaging two or more events a month rose from 102 in 2021 to 136 at its highest. The picture is less one front moving than several fronts opening at different times.


逐年。 2021 年地图大多较浅:抵抗力量尚在形成,最严重的暴力出现在实皆、克钦与 钦邦,以及仰光,那里城市抵抗力量的爆炸袭击与镇压使冲突一直维持在高位,直到 2022 年。 2022 与 2023 年,干燥带被逐渐填满,实皆达到每月 321 起。2024 年地图的形状发生变化:随着若开军攻势夺取该邦北部与中部,若开的冲突从每月 26 起升至 152 起,曼德勒也达到峰值。2025 年,实皆不到其 2022 年水平的一半,而克伦、勃固西部乃至 伊洛瓦底三角洲的月均冲突都高于此前任何一年。月均两起及以上事件的镇区数从 2021 年的 102 个增加到最高时的 136 个。 与其说是一条前线在移动,不如说是几条前线在不同时间相继打开。

title: Take-home Exercise 2: Geospatial Analytics for Peace课后作业二：面向和平的地理空间分析
section: 5.5 The space-time cube, unfolded展开的时空立方体
text:
5.5 The space-time cube, unfolded展开的时空立方体


Code
st_order <- ts_map |> st_drop_geometry() |>
  group_by(ST) |> summarise(n = sum(conflict)) |> arrange(desc(n)) |> pull(ST)

cube_df <- panel_q |>
  left_join(st_drop_geometry(ts_map)[, c("TS_PCODE", "TS", "ST", "conflict")] |>
              rename(total = conflict), by = "TS_PCODE") |>
  mutate(ST = factor(ST, levels = st_order),
         cls = cut(conflict, c(-Inf, 0, 3, 14, 29, 59, Inf),
                   labels = c("0", "1–3", "4–14", "15–29", "30–59", "60+")))

ggplot(cube_df, aes(period, reorder(TS_PCODE, total), fill = cls)) +
  geom_tile() +
  facet_grid(ST ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  scale_fill_manual("Events in quarter", values = ramp6) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y", expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(title = "Every township, every quarter",
       subtitle = "Rows grouped by state and region, most conflict-affected states first",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_th(9.5) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(),
        strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1, size = 7.5),
        strip.placement = "outside", panel.spacing.y = unit(1.2, "pt"))








Figure 7: The space-time cube as a heat strip: one row per township, one column per quarter, coloured by conflict events. Townships are grouped by state and region, and ordered within each by their total.以热力条带展示的时空立方体:每行一个镇区,每列一个季度,颜色表示冲突事件数。镇区按省邦分组,组内按总量排序。






The cube. Each row is a township’s history. Three features stand out. First, the Dry Zone states at the top turn dark early, in the second half of 2021, and most of their townships stay active to the end, so persistence is the norm there. Second, Rakhine shows a sharp break: rows that were pale until late 2023 turn dark within a quarter or two, the signature of an offensive rather than gradual spread; northern Shan shows the same thing as a single dark column in late 2023, Operation 1027, and another in mid-2024. Third, the bottom of the figure (Ayeyarwady, Nay Pyi Taw and eastern Shan) stays largely pale, apart from a late rise in the delta in 2025, and Yangon fades after 2022. These are the patterns the emerging hot spot analysis has to recover, and the figure is a check on whether its classes are plausible.


立方体。 每一行是一个镇区的历史。有三个特征值得注意。第一,排在顶部的干燥带 各省早在 2021 年下半年就转深,其中大多数镇区一直活跃到最后,持续是那里的常态。 第二,若开呈现陡然断裂:直到 2023 年底还很浅的行,在一两个季度内迅速转深,这是 攻势而非渐进扩散的特征;掸邦北部则在 2023 年底(1027 行动)和 2024 年中各出现一整列 深色。第三,图的底部(伊洛瓦底、内比都与掸邦东部)大体保持较浅,只是三角洲在 2025 年有所上升;仰光则在 2022 年后逐渐变浅。这些正是新兴热点分析需要还原的格局, 因此该图也是检验其分类是否合理的参照。

title: Take-home Exercise 2: Geospatial Analytics for Peace课后作业二：面向和平的地理空间分析
section: 6.1 Is there structure to localise?是否存在可供局部化的结构?
text:
6.1 Is there structure to localise?是否存在可供局部化的结构?

A local statistic decomposes a global one (Anselin, 1995), so the first check is whether global Moran’s I indicates spatial autocorrelation at all. It is computed with the same row-standardised queen weights and 999 permutations, against a one-sided alternative of positive association.


局部统计量是对全局统计量的分解 (Anselin, 1995),所以第一步是检验全局 Moran’s I 是否表明存在空间自相关。计算使用同样的行标准化 queen 权重与 999 次置换,备择假设 为单侧正相关。



Code
lw_q <- nb2listw(nb_an, style = "W")
glob <- lapply(names(VARS), function(v) {
  set.seed(1234)
  m <- moran.mc(ts[[v]], lw_q, nsim = 999, alternative = "greater")
  data.frame(var = v, I = unname(m$statistic), p = m$p.value)
}) |> bind_rows()




Code
g1 <- LM$glob |>
  mutate(lab = VAR_SHORT[var], lab = fct_reorder(lab, I)) |>
  ggplot(aes(I, lab)) +
  geom_col(fill = PAL$conflict, width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", I)), hjust = -0.15, size = 3.2) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.65), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(title = "Whole period, by variable", x = "Moran's I", y = NULL) +
  theme_th(10.5)

g2 <- LM$glob_year |>
  ggplot(aes(year, I)) +
  geom_line(colour = PAL$conflict, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(colour = PAL$conflict, size = 2.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", I)), vjust = -1, size = 3.1) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.65)) +
  labs(title = "All conflict, by year", x = NULL, y = "Moran's I") +
  theme_th(10.5)

g1 | g2








Figure 8: Global Moran’s I. Left: whole-period totals of each variable. Right: all conflict events, by calendar year. Every value has a permutation p-value of 0.001, the smallest 999 permutations can give.全局 Moran’s I。左:各变量的整期总量。右:全部冲突事件的逐年值。每个值的置换 p 值都是 0.001,即 999 次置换所能给出的最小值。






Global association. All five variables are strongly and positively autocorrelated, with Moran’s I between 0.45 and 0.56: townships with much conflict tend to border townships with much conflict. Fatalities are the most clustered, which is consistent with the deadliest fighting concentrating on a few fronts. The yearly series adds a time dimension the totals hide. Association rose from 0.31 in 2021 to 0.54 in 2022–2023 and fell to 0.25 in 2025. Conflict became more clustered as the Dry Zone front consolidated, and less clustered as new fronts opened in Rakhine, northern Shan and the south-east, which are far from each other. Local analysis is warranted for every variable and every year.


全局关联。 五个变量都呈现强烈的正自相关,Moran’s I 介于 0.45 与 0.56 之间:冲突 多的镇区往往与冲突多的镇区相邻。死亡人数的聚集程度最高,这与最致命的战斗集中在 少数几条前线相符。逐年序列补充了总量所掩盖的时间维度:关联度从 2021 年的 0.31 升至 2022–2023 年的 0.54, 再降至 2025 年的 0.25。随着干燥带前线的巩固, 冲突变得更聚集;随着若开、掸邦北部与东南方向这些彼此相距甚远的新前线打开,聚集度 又随之下降。对每个变量和每一年做局部分析都是有依据的。

title: Take-home Exercise 2: Geospatial Analytics for Peace课后作业二：面向和平的地理空间分析
section: 6.2 Local Moran’s I: clusters and outliers局部 Moran’s I:聚集与异常值
text:
6.2 Local Moran’s I: clusters and outliers局部 Moran’s I:聚集与异常值


Code
local_moran_tbl <- function(x, lw, nsim = 999, seed = 1234) {
  set.seed(seed)
  lm <- localmoran_perm(x, lw, nsim = nsim, alternative = "two.sided")
  lag_x <- lag.listw(lw, x)
  tibble(ii = lm[, "Ii"], p_ii_sim = lm[, "Pr(z != E(Ii)) Sim"], lag = lag_x,
         quad     = lisa_quadrant(x, lag_x, lm[, "Pr(z != E(Ii)) Sim"]),
         quad_fdr = lisa_quadrant(x, lag_x, lm[, "Pr(z != E(Ii)) Sim"],
                                  method = "fdr"))
}



localmoran_perm() holds each township’s value fixed and redraws its neighbours 999 times from the other 328 townships. Two details matter. The p-value carried forward is the two-sided simulated one, Pr(z != E(Ii)) Sim; the folded p-value spdep also reports is one-sided and would halve every p-value. And the quadrant label is built by lisa_quadrant() (in R/utils.R) from the signs of the centred value and its centred spatial lag, so that “High-High” means above the mean in a neighbourhood above the mean, whatever implementation produced the statistic.


localmoran_perm() 固定每个镇区自身的值,从其余 328 个镇区中重抽其邻居 999 次。 有两个细节很重要。沿用的 p 值是双侧模拟 p 值 Pr(z != E(Ii)) Sim;spdep 同时报告的 折叠 p 值是单侧的,会使每个 p 值减半。象限标签由 lisa_quadrant()(见 R/utils.R)依据中心化取值与其中心化空间滞后的符号构造,因此不论统计量由哪种实现 计算,「高-高」都意味着「自身高于均值,且邻域也高于均值」。



Code
ggplot(lc, aes(x, lag)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(lc$lag), colour = "#a8a29e", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean(lc$x), colour = "#a8a29e", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "#1c1917", linewidth = 0.5,
              linetype = "22") +
  geom_point(aes(colour = quad), size = 1.8, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text_repel(data = lc |> filter(quad != "Insignificant") |> slice_max(x, n = 6),
                  aes(label = TS), size = 2.8, min.segment.length = 0) +
  geom_text_repel(data = lc |> filter(quad == "Low-High"),
                  aes(label = TS), size = 2.8, min.segment.length = 0,
                  colour = PAL_LISA[["Low-High"]]) +
  scale_colour_manual("LISA class", values = c(PAL_LISA[1:4], Insignificant = "#d6d3d1")) +
  labs(title = "Moran scatterplot, all conflict events",
       subtitle = sprintf("Slope = Moran's I = %.3f", LM$glob$I[LM$glob$var == "conflict"]),
       x = "Township total, Jan 2021 – Sep 2025",
       y = "Average of neighbours (spatial lag)") +
  theme_th(10.5)








Figure 9: Moran scatterplot of all conflict events: each township’s total against the average of its neighbours. Colour shows the significant LISA class (two-sided p < 0.05).全部冲突事件的 Moran 散点图:每个镇区的总量与其邻居平均值的关系。颜色表示显著的 LISA 类别(双侧 p < 0.05)。






Reading the scatterplot. The slope of the dashed line is Moran’s I. The significant High-High townships (upper right) are not simply the largest totals: Hpakant, among the highest counts in the country, is not significant, because its neighbours in Kachin are quiet by comparison. Significance requires a high value and a high neighbourhood. Low-Low townships crowd the lower left, where many townships have few events and so do their neighbours. Three townships are significant Low-High outliers, quieter places surrounded by conflict: Hlaingbwe, Tonzang, Pyinoolwin. No township is a significant High-Low outlier.


如何读散点图。 虚线的斜率就是 Moran’s I。显著的「高-高」镇区(右上)并不只是 总量最大的那些:帕敢的计数位居全国前列,却不显著,因为它在克钦的邻居相对平静。 显著性要求自身高、邻域也高。「低-低」镇区挤在左下,那里许多镇区事件很少, 它们的邻居也一样。有三个镇区是显著的「低-高」异常值,即被冲突包围的较平静地方: Hlaingbwe、Tonzang、Pyinoolwin。没有任何镇区是显著的 「高-低」异常值。



Code
lisa_map <- function(v, title = VAR_TINY[[v]], col = "quad", col_fdr = "quad_fdr") {
  d <- lisa_sf |> filter(var == v)
  map_base(
    list(
      geom_sf(data = d, aes(fill = .data[[col]]), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.04,
              show.legend = TRUE),
      geom_sf(data = d |> filter(.data[[col_fdr]] != "Insignificant"),
              fill = NA, colour = "#1c1917", linewidth = 0.42)),
    title = title, state_lw = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual("LISA class (p < 0.05)", values = PAL_LISA, drop = FALSE) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10))
}

wrap_plots(lapply(names(VARS), lisa_map), nrow = 1) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(title = "Local Moran's I: clusters and outliers, Jan 2021 – Sep 2025",
                  subtitle = "Heavy outline: also significant after FDR correction",
                  theme = theme_th(11)) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")








Figure 10: Local Moran’s I cluster maps for the five variables, whole period. Only townships with two-sided permutation p < 0.05 are coloured; a heavy outline marks those that also survive the false discovery rate correction.五个变量的局部 Moran’s I 聚集图(整个研究期)。只有双侧置换 p < 0.05 的镇区被着色;粗描边标出同时通过错误发现率校正的镇区。

Table 9: Townships in each LISA class at p < 0.05, and the number that survive FDR correction.p < 0.05 下各 LISA 类别的镇区数,以及通过 FDR 校正的镇区数。





Clusters. For all conflict events, 35 townships form High-High clusters, led by Sagaing (17), Mandalay (7), Magway (5). They make one contiguous block across the Dry Zone where Sagaing, Magway and Mandalay meet, and a second, looser chain in the south-east through Kayin to Tanintharyi. 52 townships form Low-Low clusters, led by Ayeyarwady (13), Yangon (12), Shan (East) (10): the delta and Yangon, and the eastern Shan hills along the Chinese and Thai borders, including the Wa self-administered area, where the United Wa State Army has kept out of the war. The variables differ at the margins. Violence against civilians has the tightest High-High cluster: all but 4 of its townships are in the Dry Zone. Explosions and remote violence add a strong band from eastern Bago through Kayin to Mon, where shelling and air strikes accompany the fighting along the Thai border. Battles extend furthest, with High-High townships as far as Kachin, Kayah and Tanintharyi. 53 of the 90 significant townships for all conflict survive FDR correction. Every High-High township that survives is in the Dry Zone; the south-eastern chain does not survive the correction, and is the less certain of the two clusters.


聚集。 就全部冲突事件而言,有 35 个镇区构成 「高-高」聚集,居前的是 Sagaing (17), Mandalay (7), Magway (5)。它们在实皆、 马圭与曼德勒交界的干燥带形成一个连片区块,并在东南方向形成一条经克伦延伸至 德林达依的较松散链条。52 个镇区构成「低-低」聚集,居前 的是 Ayeyarwady (13), Yangon (12), Shan (East) (10):即三角洲与仰光,以及沿中国与泰国 边境的掸邦东部山地,包括佤自治区,佤联军一直置身战争之外。各变量在边缘处有所不同。 针对平民的暴力「高-高」聚集最紧凑:除 4 个镇区外,全部位于干燥带。爆炸与远程暴力在从勃固 东部经克伦到孟邦的地带额外形成一条强聚集带,那里沿泰国边境的战斗伴随着炮击与空袭。 战斗的分布最广,「高-高」镇区远及克钦、克耶与德林达依。全部冲突事件的 90 个显著镇区中,有 53 个通过 FDR 校正。通过校正的「高-高」镇区全部位于干燥带;东南链条没有通过校正,是两个聚集 中较不确定的一个。

section: 6.3 Getis-Ord Gi*: hot and cold spotsGetis-Ord Gi*:热点与冷点
text:
6.3 Getis-Ord Gi*: hot and cold spotsGetis-Ord Gi*:热点与冷点


Code
nb_self <- include_self(nb_an)          # Gi* counts the township itself
wt_self <- st_weights(nb_self)
set.seed(1234)
g <- local_gstar_perm(ts$conflict, nb_self, wt_self, nsim = 999)
gi_class(g$gi_star, g$p_sim)            # sign of Gi* where p_sim < 0.05




Code
gi_map <- function(v) {
  d <- lisa_sf |> filter(var == v)
  map_base(
    list(
      geom_sf(data = d, aes(fill = gi_class), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.04,
              show.legend = TRUE),
      geom_sf(data = d |> filter(gi_class_fdr != "Insignificant"),
              fill = NA, colour = "#1c1917", linewidth = 0.42)),
    title = VAR_TINY[[v]], state_lw = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual("Gi* (p < 0.05)", values = PAL_GI, drop = FALSE) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10))
}

wrap_plots(lapply(names(VARS), gi_map), nrow = 1) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(title = "Getis-Ord Gi*: hot and cold spots, Jan 2021 – Sep 2025",
                  subtitle = "Heavy outline: also significant after FDR correction",
                  theme = theme_th(11)) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")








Figure 11: Getis-Ord Gi* hot and cold spots for the five variables, whole period, two-sided permutation p < 0.05. Heavy outline: survives FDR correction.五个变量的 Getis-Ord Gi* 热点与冷点(整个研究期,双侧置换 p < 0.05)。粗描边:通过 FDR 校正。






Hot and cold spots. Gi* reproduces the LISA geography closely. For all conflict events the two statistics put 318 of 329 townships on the same side (hot, cold or neither). They disagree where they are built to disagree. Gi* includes the township in its own neighbourhood and does not ask whether the township resembles its neighbours, so a quiet township surrounded by conflict can be a hot spot: 5 townships are Gi* hot spots without being LISA High-High, among them Hlaingbwe, Tonzang, Kanbalu, Yebyu. For peace-building this is useful: those are the townships inside a zone of violence, whatever their own count. Gi* cannot see outliers, which is why both statistics are reported. After FDR correction the hot spots that remain are in the Dry Zone core, and the cold spots that remain are in the delta and the eastern Shan hills.


热点与冷点。 Gi* 与 LISA 的地理格局高度吻合。就全部冲突事件而言,两种统计量 把 329 个镇区中的 318 个放在同一侧(热、冷或都不是)。它们只在其设计上 就会不一致的地方出现分歧。Gi* 把镇区本身纳入其邻域,并不追问该镇区是否与邻居相似, 所以一个被冲突包围的平静镇区也可能是热点:有 5 个镇区是 Gi* 热点但不是 LISA「高-高」,其中包括 Hlaingbwe、Tonzang、Kanbalu、Yebyu。 这对和平建设很有用:它们是位于暴力区域之内的镇区,不论自身计数如何。Gi* 看不到 异常值,这正是同时报告两种统计量的原因。经 FDR 校正后,保留下来的热点位于干燥带 核心,保留下来的冷点位于三角洲与掸邦东部山地。

title: Take-home Exercise 2: Geospatial Analytics for Peace课后作业二：面向和平的地理空间分析
text:
6.4 Year by year逐年分析


Code
ly <- ts_an |> select(TS_PCODE) |> right_join(LM$lisa_year, by = "TS_PCODE")
map_base(
  list(geom_sf(data = ly, aes(fill = quad), colour = NA, show.legend = TRUE),
       geom_sf(data = ly |> filter(quad_fdr != "Insignificant"),
               fill = NA, colour = "#1c1917", linewidth = 0.3)),
  title = "Local Moran's I, all conflict events, by year",
  state_lw = 0.15) +
  facet_wrap(~ year, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual("LISA class (p < 0.05)", values = PAL_LISA, drop = FALSE) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text = element_text(size = 10))








Figure 12: Local Moran’s I cluster maps of all conflict events, by calendar year (2025: January to September). Two-sided p < 0.05; heavy outline: survives FDR correction.全部冲突事件的局部 Moran’s I 聚集图,按日历年(2025 年:1 月至 9 月)。双侧 p < 0.05;粗描边:通过 FDR 校正。






Year by year. The Dry Zone cluster is the constant of the first three years: 15 High-High townships in the three Dry Zone regions in 2021, 25 in 2022 and 26 in 2023. From 2024 it thins: 19 in 2024 and 7 in 2025. Of those, three are what is left of the old core (Pakokku, Yesagyo and Salingyi), and four lie in the north of Mandalay towards its border with northern Shan (Madaya, Singu, Thabeikkyin and Mogoke, joined by Nawnghkio across the border). Fighting in the Dry Zone did not stop; Fig. 6 shows Sagaing still among the most violent areas. What changed is that its townships became less distinct from the rest of the country as Rakhine (High-High in 2024), northern Shan and the south-east caught up. In 2025 the 14 High-High townships are split between that northern group, the remnant of the core, and the Kayin border, where 4 townships around Myawaddy and Hpa-An form a cluster of their own. The Low-Low cluster of the eastern Shan hills is present in every year, the most stable feature of the conflict map.


逐年。 前三年里,干燥带聚集是不变的常量:干燥带三个省份的「高-高」镇区在 2021 年有 15 个,2022 年 25 个,2023 年 26 个。从 2024 年起它逐渐稀疏:2024 年 19 个, 2025 年 7 个。其中三个是老核心的残余(木各具、耶沙久与沙林基), 另外四个位于曼德勒北部、靠近掸邦北部边界(Madaya、Singu、Thabeikkyin 与 Mogoke, 以及边界另一侧的 Nawnghkio)。干燥带的战斗并未停止;Fig. 6 显示实皆仍是暴力最 严重的地区之一。改变的是,随着若开(2024 年出现「高-高」)、掸邦北部与东南地区追赶 上来,干燥带镇区与全国其余地区的差别缩小了。2025 年的 14 个「高-高」镇区 分为三部分:上述北部一组、老核心的残余,以及克伦边境一组,后者在妙瓦底与帕安周围有 4 个镇区自成一个聚集。掸邦东部山地的 「低-低」聚集每年都存在,是冲突地图上最稳定的特征。

Code
ss <- ts_an |> select(TS_PCODE) |> right_join(LM$sens, by = "TS_PCODE") |>
  mutate(spec = factor(spec, levels = levels(LM$sens_summary$spec)))
map_base(geom_sf(data = ss, aes(fill = quad), colour = NA, show.legend = TRUE),
         title = "Local Moran's I, all conflict events, four specifications",
         state_lw = 0.15) +
  facet_wrap(~ spec, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual("LISA class (p < 0.05)", values = PAL_LISA, drop = FALSE) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text = element_text(size = 9))








Figure 13: The LISA cluster map of all conflict events under the four specifications.四种设定下全部冲突事件的 LISA 聚集图。






Robustness. The core of the map is robust and the margins are not. Switching to six nearest neighbours keeps 27 of the 35 High-High townships and enlarges the Low-Low zone, because large hill townships now borrow neighbours across state lines. Taking logarithms keeps 34 High-High townships and adds more at the edges of the clusters, since the transformation shrinks the gap between the most violent townships and their merely violent neighbours; it shrinks the Low-Low zone for the same reason. Dividing by area is the one change that redraws the map, keeping none of the High-High townships: per square kilometre, the small downtown townships of Yangon, most under 10 km², become the “hottest” places, and the large rural townships of the Dry Zone drop out. That variant answers a different question, how concentrated events are on the ground, and confirms that the count-based hot spots are not an artefact of township size: they are large townships with a great deal of conflict, not large townships with average conflict.


稳健性。 地图的核心是稳健的,边缘则不然。改用六个最近邻时, 35 个「高-高」镇区中保留了 27 个,「低-低」区域扩大,因为大面积的山地 镇区如今会跨越省邦边界借用邻居。取对数后保留了 34 个 「高-高」镇区,并在聚集边缘增加了更多,因为这种变换缩小了最暴力镇区与其「只是暴力」 的邻居之间的差距;出于同样原因,「低-低」区域缩小。按面积相除是唯一重新绘制地图的 改变,原有「高-高」镇区一个都没有保留:按每平方公里计算,仰光市中心那些大多不足 10 km² 的小镇区成为「最热」的地方,干燥带的大面积农村镇区则退出。这一变体回答的是另一个 问题,即事件在地面上有多集中;它也证实了基于计数的热点并非镇区面积造成的假象: 它们是冲突极多的大镇区,而不是冲突一般的大镇区。

Code
geo <- ts_an |> select(TS_PCODE)
geo$nb <- include_self(nb_an)      # assigned directly: dplyr >= 1.2 will not
geo$wt <- st_weights(geo$nb)       # accept an `nb` object inside mutate()

cube_q <- spacetime(as.data.frame(panel_q), geo,
                    .loc_col = "TS_PCODE", .time_col = "period")
is_spacetime_cube(cube_q)



spacetime() binds the township-by-quarter panel to the geometry without merging them, and is_spacetime_cube() confirms the cube is complete: every one of the 329 townships appears exactly once in each of the 19 quarters, 6,251 bins in all. The neighbour list is attached to the geometry as a column, with each township included in its own neighbourhood, as Gi* requires. Two practicalities are worth recording. dplyr 1.2 refuses an object of class nb inside mutate(), so the column is assigned directly. And the geometry is sorted by TS_PCODE, for the reason shown in § 7.3.


spacetime() 把镇区-季度面板与几何对象绑定在一起而不合并它们,is_spacetime_cube() 则确认立方体是完整的:329 个镇区中的每一个在 19 个季度里都恰好出现一次,共 6,251 个格元。邻居列表作为一列 附在几何对象上,每个镇区都包含在自己的邻域中,这是 Gi* 的要求。有两个实际问题值得 记录:dplyr 1.2 不接受 mutate() 中类为 nb 的对象,所以这一列是直接赋值的;几何 对象按 TS_PCODE 排序,原因见 § 7.3。

title: Take-home Exercise 2: Geospatial Analytics for Peace课后作业二：面向和平的地理空间分析
section: 7.2 Space-time Gi* and the Mann-Kendall test时空 Gi* 与 Mann-Kendall 检验
text:
7.2 Space-time Gi* and the Mann-Kendall test时空 Gi* 与 Mann-Kendall 检验

For township \(i\) in quarter \(t\), the space-time Gi* pools the township and its queen neighbours in quarter \(t\) and, with a time lag of \(k = 1\), the same set in quarter \(t-1\). Weights are row-standardised within each quarter’s copy. The statistic is standardised against the mean \(\bar x_t\) and variance \(s_t^2\) of quarter \(t\) alone:
\[
G^*_{it} = \frac{\sum_{s=t-k}^{t}\sum_j w_{ij} x_{js} \;-\; W_i \bar x_t}
{s_t \sqrt{\left(n S_{1i} - W_i^2\right)/(n-1)}},
\qquad W_i = \sum_{s,j} w_{ij}, \quad S_{1i} = \sum_{s,j} w_{ij}^2 .
\]
A township is a hot spot in a quarter if its neighbourhood total is significantly larger than the neighbourhood totals of randomly chosen townships in the same quarter. The standardisation by quarter is deliberate: a national surge raises every township at once and does not, by itself, make any township a hot spot.
Each township then has a series of 19 Gi* values, and the Mann-Kendall test (Kendall, 1975; Mann, 1945) asks whether the series trends up or down. The classification combines the two: which quarters were significant hot or cold spots, in what sequence, and whether the trend is significant. Tbl. 11 summarises the rules, which follow Esri’s definitions (Esri, 2024) as implemented in sfdep.


对于第 \(t\) 季度的镇区 \(i\),时空 Gi* 汇集该镇区及其 queen 邻居在第 \(t\) 季度的值, 并在时间滞后 \(k = 1\) 时,汇集同一组镇区在第 \(t-1\) 季度的值。权重在每个季度的副本中 分别行标准化。统计量只以第 \(t\) 季度自身的均值 \(\bar x_t\) 与方差 \(s_t^2\) 进行标准化 (公式见上)。
一个镇区在某季度为热点,意味着它的邻域总量显著大于同一季度随机选取的镇区的邻域 总量。按季度标准化是刻意为之:全国性的激增会同时抬高每一个镇区,其本身并不会使任何 镇区成为热点。
于是每个镇区有一条由 19 个 Gi* 值组成的序列,Mann-Kendall 检验 (Kendall, 1975; Mann, 1945) 判断该序列是否有上升或下降趋势。分类综合两者:哪些 季度是显著的热点或冷点、出现的顺序如何、趋势是否显著。Tbl. 11 概括了这些规则, 它们遵循 Esri 的定义 (Esri, 2024),并按 sfdep 中的实现执行。



Code
tribble(
  ~Class, ~`Rule (hot version)`,
  "New",          "Significant hot in the final quarter only, never before",
  "Consecutive",  "An unbroken run of significant hot quarters at the end of the series, no significant hot quarter before it, and fewer than 90% of quarters hot",
  "Intensifying", "Significant hot in at least 90% of quarters including the last, with a significant upward trend",
  "Persistent",   "Significant hot in at least 90% of quarters, no significant trend",
  "Diminishing",  "Significant hot in at least 90% of quarters including the last, with a significant downward trend",
  "Sporadic",     "Significant hot in some quarters, fewer than 90%, never a significant cold spot",
  "Oscillating",  "Significant hot in the final quarter, significant cold in at least one earlier quarter",
  "Historical",   "Significant hot in at least 90% of quarters, but not hot in the last",
  "No pattern detected", "None of the above, typically never significant"
) |>
  gt() |>
  cols_width(Class ~ px(150)) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(13))

title: Take-home Exercise 2: Geospatial Analytics for Peace课后作业二：面向和平的地理空间分析
section: 7.3 Checking the tool before trusting it在信任工具之前先检验它
text:
7.3 Checking the tool before trusting it在信任工具之前先检验它

emerging_hotspot_analysis() in sfdep (Parry, 2023) runs the whole procedure in one call. Before its output was interpreted, its space-time Gi* was reimplemented independently (gi_spt() in R/ehsa.R) and the two compared value by value. The deterministic part agrees: the largest difference between the two sets of 6,251 Gi* values is 1.8e-15, rounding error. The comparison nonetheless exposed three defects in how the function uses that statistic, and a fourth issue in how its output is usually read.


sfdep 的 emerging_hotspot_analysis() (Parry, 2023) 一次调用就完成全部流程。在解读其 输出之前,本研究独立重新实现了它的时空 Gi*(R/ehsa.R 中的 gi_spt()),并逐值 比较二者。确定性部分是一致的:两组 6,251 个 Gi* 值之间的 最大差异是 1.8e-15,只是舍入误差。尽管如此, 这一比较还是揭示了该函数在使用这一统计量时的三个缺陷,以及其输出在通常解读方式 上的第四个问题。


7.3.1 Defect 1: results attached to the wrong township缺陷一:结果被贴到错误的镇区上

The function computes each township’s classification by splitting the results by location, which orders them alphabetically by location identifier, and then labels the rows with the locations in the order of the geometry. When the two orders differ, every result is attached to some other township. The cube was built twice, identical except for the order of the polygons: once sorted by TS_PCODE, once in the order MIMU delivers them. The Mann-Kendall tau that the function reports was then compared with tau computed directly from each township’s own Gi* series.


该函数在计算每个镇区的分类时,先按地点拆分结果,这会使结果按地点标识符的字母顺序 排列;然后又按几何对象的顺序给各行贴上地点标签。只要两种顺序不同,每个结果就会被 贴到另一个镇区上。本研究构建了两次立方体,除多边形顺序外完全相同:一次按 TS_PCODE 排序,一次按 MIMU 交付时的顺序。然后把函数报告的 Mann-Kendall tau 与直接由每个镇区 自身 Gi* 序列计算的 tau 相比较。



Code
tau_true <- tibble(location = EH$locs,
                   tau_me = apply(EH$results$conflict$G, 1,
                                  function(g) Kendall::MannKendall(g)$tau))
lb <- bind_rows(
  tau_true |> mutate(tau_sf = tau_me, panel = "Geometry sorted by TS_PCODE"),
  EH$validation$tau_mimu |> mutate(panel = "Geometry in MIMU's order")
) |>
  mutate(panel = factor(panel, levels = c("Geometry sorted by TS_PCODE",
                                          "Geometry in MIMU's order")))
ggplot(lb, aes(tau_me, tau_sf)) +
  geom_abline(colour = "#a8a29e", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(size = 1.2, alpha = 0.6, colour = PAL$conflict) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(title = "Same data, same statistic, different polygon order",
       x = "tau from the township's own Gi* series",
       y = "tau reported by emerging_hotspot_analysis()") +
  theme_th(10.5)








Figure 14: Mann-Kendall tau reported by sfdep’s emerging_hotspot_analysis() against tau computed from each township’s own Gi* series. Left: geometry sorted by location identifier. Right: geometry in MIMU’s delivered order.sfdep 的 emerging_hotspot_analysis() 报告的 Mann-Kendall tau,与由各镇区自身 Gi* 序列计算的 tau 对比。左:几何对象按地点标识符排序。右:几何对象按 MIMU 交付时的顺序。






Label defect. With sorted geometry the reported tau is exactly right for every township (largest difference 0). With MIMU’s order, 99.4% of townships receive another township’s tau, and the correlation between reported and true values is 0.12. Relabelling the rows in alphabetical order of location recovers the right answer exactly, which pins the cause on the labelling step. 260 of 329 classifications change. Nothing in the output signals the problem: every township gets a plausible class, and the map looks like a map. The same pattern, a tau unrelated to a hand computation, is what one would see on any dataset whose polygons are not stored in sorted order. This analysis avoids it by sorting the frame (§ 3.1.3) and by checking the labels.


标签缺陷。 几何对象排序时,报告的 tau 对每个镇区都完全正确(最大差异 0)。按 MIMU 的顺序时, 99.4% 的镇区得到的是另一个镇区的 tau,报告值 与真实值的相关系数为 0.12。把各行按地点的 字母顺序重新贴标签,就能完全恢复正确答案,这把原因锁定在贴标签这一步。329 个 分类中有 260 个发生变化。输出中没有任何迹象提示这个 问题:每个镇区都得到一个看似合理的类别,地图看起来也像一张正常的地图。任何多边形 不是按排序存储的数据集,都会出现同样的现象,即 tau 与手工计算毫无关系。本分析通过对 分析框架排序(§ 3.1.3)并核对标签来避免它。



7.3.2 Defect 2: a null model that pools every quarter缺陷二:把所有季度混在一起的零模型

The function judges significance by conditional permutation, but the pseudo-neighbours are drawn from every bin of the cube: any township, in any quarter, including the township’s own slot. Gi* is standardised by the quarter’s own mean and variance, so when the national level trends, the draws for a quiet quarter come mostly from busier quarters, and almost every township in it looks unusually low. In a busy quarter the reverse happens. The replacement, gi_spt_perm() in R/ehsa.R, holds the township’s own values fixed and replaces its neighbours with a random set of other townships, read in the same quarters as the real neighbours. Everything else (statistic, threshold, classification rules apart from the one in Defect 3) is left exactly as in sfdep; feeding sfdep’s own p-values through the replacement classifier with sfdep’s rules unchanged reproduces sfdep’s classes exactly (TRUE).


该函数以条件置换判断显著性,但伪邻居是从立方体的每一个格元中抽取的:任何镇区、 任何季度,甚至包括该镇区自身的位置。Gi* 是按该季度自身的均值与方差标准化的,所以当 全国水平存在趋势时,为一个平静季度抽取的样本大多来自更繁忙的季度,于是该季度几乎 每个镇区都显得异常地低;繁忙季度则恰好相反。替代方案 R/ehsa.R 中的 gi_spt_perm() 固定镇区自身的值,用一组随机的其他镇区替换其邻居,并在与真实邻居相同的季度读取 它们的值。其余一切(统计量、阈值,以及除缺陷三所涉规则之外的分类规则)都与 sfdep 完全相同;把 sfdep 自己的 p 值输入替代分类器、并保持 sfdep 规则不变,可以完全复现 sfdep 的分类(TRUE)。



Code
# Inside gi_spt_perm(): for quarter t and township i
S   <- rowSums(X[, max(1, t - k):t, drop = FALSE])    # same quarters as the real neighbours
obs <- sum(S[nb_self[[i]]])                           # own value + real neighbours
r   <- matrix(replicate(nsim, sample.int(n - 1L, ci)), nrow = ci)
idx <- r + (r >= i)                                    # any township except i itself
sim <- S[i] + colSums(matrix(S[idx], nrow = ci))       # own value fixed + random neighbours
p_fold[i, t] <- min((sum(obs >= sim) + 1) / (nsim + 1),
                    (sum(obs <= sim) + 1) / (nsim + 1))




Code
bn <- EH$bins_by_null |>
  pivot_longer(c(hot, cold), names_to = "side", values_to = "n") |>
  mutate(side = recode(side, hot = "Hot spots", cold = "Cold spots"))
sc <- max(bn$n) / max(bn$national)
ggplot(bn, aes(period + 45)) +
  geom_col(data = distinct(bn, period, national), aes(y = national * sc),
           fill = "#e7e5e4", width = 80) +
  geom_line(aes(y = n, colour = null), linewidth = 0.85) +
  geom_point(aes(y = n, colour = null), size = 1.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ side) +
  scale_colour_manual(NULL, values = c("sfdep: pooled over all quarters" = "#a8a29e",
                                       "Period-conditional" = PAL$conflict)) +
  scale_y_continuous("Significant townships",
                     sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / sc, name = "National events",
                                         labels = label_comma())) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  labs(title = "Under the pooled null, significance follows the national trend",
       x = NULL) +
  theme_th(10.5)








Figure 15: Townships that are significant hot or cold spots in each quarter, all conflict events, under sfdep’s pooled null and under the period-conditional null. Grey bars: national conflict events in the quarter (right axis).每个季度显著热点与冷点的镇区数(全部冲突事件),分别基于 sfdep 的混合零模型与按期条件化的零模型。灰色柱:该季度全国冲突事件数(右轴)。






Null defect. In the first quarter of 2021, when only 398 conflict events were recorded nationally, the pooled null marks 193 of 329 townships as significant cold spots. The period-conditional null marks 8. Under the pooled null the number of hot spots swings from 5 to 96 across the quarters and tracks the national total closely (correlation 0.85); under the period-conditional null it stays between 23 and 50, moving with how clustered the conflict is in a quarter rather than with how much of it there is. The pooled null therefore converts the national escalation into local significance: early quarters are full of spurious cold spots and later quarters of extra hot spots. That sequence, cold first and hot later, is precisely the definition of an oscillating hot spot, which is why the uncorrected output is full of them.


零模型缺陷。 2021 年第一季度,全国只记录到 398 起冲突事件, 而混合零模型把 329 个镇区中的 193 个标为显著冷点;按期条件化的零模型 只标出 8 个。在混合零模型下,各季度的热点数在 5 到 96 之间大幅摆动,并紧随全国总量(相关系数 0.85);在 按期条件化的零模型下,它保持在 23 到 50 之间,随的是该季度冲突 的聚集程度,而不是冲突的多少。因此混合零模型把全国性的升级转化成了局部显著性:早期 季度充满虚假冷点,后期季度则多出热点。「先冷后热」这个序列,恰恰就是振荡热点的 定义,这正是未修正输出中振荡热点泛滥的原因。



Code
cmp_tbl <- bind_rows(
  EH$sfdep_all |> mutate(null = "sfdep") |> select(var, null, cls = classification),
  map_dfr(names(VARS), function(v) tibble(var = v, null = "corrected",
                                          cls = cls_of(v)))
) |>
  mutate(var = VAR_SHORT[var]) |>
  count(var, null, cls) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(var, null), values_from = n, values_fill = 0,
              names_sep = "|") |>
  arrange(cls) |>
  mutate(cls = as.character(cls))

col_order <- as.vector(t(outer(unname(VAR_SHORT), c("sfdep", "corrected"),
                               function(a, b) paste(a, b, sep = "|"))))
cmp_tbl |>
  select(cls, any_of(col_order)) |>
  gt(rowname_col = "cls") |>
  tab_spanner_delim(delim = "|") |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(12))
