title: Hands-on Exercise 2b: 2nd Order Spatial Point Patterns Analysis
text:
Data Import and Preparation

The cleaned subzone layer saved in the previous exercise is reused:


沿用上一份练习保存下来的清理后分区图层：


mpsz_cl <- read_rds("data/rds/mpsz_cl.rds")


childcare_sf <- st_read("data/geospatial/ChildCareServices.geojson") %>%
  st_zm(drop = TRUE, what = "ZM") %>%
  st_transform(crs = 3414)

Reading layer `CHILDCARE' from data source 
  `C:\Users\Imgigi\Desktop\629\hand-on-ex\hand-on-ex2\data\geospatial\ChildCareServices.geojson' 
  using driver `GeoJSON'
Simple feature collection with 1925 features and 16 fields
Geometry type: POINT
Dimension:     XY
Bounding box:  xmin: 103.6878 ymin: 1.247759 xmax: 103.9897 ymax: 1.462134
Geodetic CRS:  WGS 84



Converting to a ppp and jittering the duplicates, exactly as in Hands-on Exercise 2a. st_geometry() is used so the pattern is unmarked; passing the whole sf object would turn the sixteen attribute columns into marks and stop duplicated() from seeing coincident locations. The summary functions below assume a simple point pattern, so removing the 187 duplicates is a precondition rather than a nicety:


转成 ppp 并对重合点做抖动，做法与练习 2a 完全相同。这里传 st_geometry() 是为了得到无标记的点格局；若把整个 sf 对象传进去，十六个属性列会变成标记，duplicated() 就看不出坐标重合了。下面的汇总函数都假定点格局是简单的，所以去掉那 187 个重合点是前提条件，而不是锦上添花：


childcare_ppp <- as.ppp(st_geometry(childcare_sf))

set.seed(1234)
childcare_ppp_jit <- rjitter(childcare_ppp,
                             retry = TRUE,
                             nsim = 1,
                             drop = TRUE)

any(duplicated(childcare_ppp_jit))

[1] FALSE



The two study areas

The analysis is run on two planning areas rather than the whole country. Second-order functions assume the process is homogeneous, meaning that intensity is roughly constant across the window, and that assumption is untenable for Singapore as a whole, where the centre and the outlying areas differ by an order of magnitude. Within one planning area it is defensible:


分析放在两个规划区而不是全国做。二阶函数假定过程是齐性的，即强度在整个窗口内大致恒定；放在整个新加坡这个假定站不住，市中心与外围地区的强度差了一个数量级。限定在单个规划区内，这个假定才说得过去：


ck <- mpsz_cl %>% filter(PLN_AREA_N == "CHOA CHU KANG")
tm <- mpsz_cl %>% filter(PLN_AREA_N == "TAMPINES")

childcare_ck_ppp <- childcare_ppp_jit[as.owin(ck)]
childcare_tm_ppp <- childcare_ppp_jit[as.owin(tm)]

c(`Choa Chu Kang` = npoints(childcare_ck_ppp),
  Tampines        = npoints(childcare_tm_ppp))

Choa Chu Kang      Tampines 
           74           117 



par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(childcare_ck_ppp, main = "Choa Chu Kang")
plot(childcare_tm_ppp, main = "Tampines")














NoteReading a Monte Carlo envelope



Each function below is accompanied by an envelope() plot. The procedure simulates many point patterns under CSR, computes the same function on each, and shades the region between the pointwise minimum and maximum.
The interpretation is the same in every case: where the observed curve lies inside the grey envelope, the pattern is indistinguishable from randomness at that distance. Where it strays outside, CSR is rejected, and which side it exits on says whether the departure is clustering or regularity.
set.seed() is called before every envelope so the simulations are reproducible.

title: Hands-on Exercise 2b: 2nd Order Spatial Point Patterns Analysis
text:
Second-order Spatial Point Patterns Analysis

All four functions below are distance-dependent summaries of the same pattern, and each is tested against CSR with a Monte Carlo envelope. They differ in what they measure from, which is why all four are worked through here rather than one being reported on its own.


下面四个函数都是同一个点格局的随距离变化的汇总，每一个都用蒙特卡洛包络对照 CSR 检验。它们的差别在于从什么出发测量，所以这里四个全部走一遍，而不是只报其中一个。

section: Analysing Spatial Point Process Using K-Function
text:
Analysing Spatial Point Process Using K-Function

G and F both look only at the nearest event, which throws away most of the pattern. Ripley’s K-function counts all events within distance r of each event, averaged over events and standardised by intensity. It therefore describes the pattern across the whole range of distances at once.
The plots below are drawn as K(d) - r rather than K(d) itself. Under CSR, K(r) = πr², and subtracting the expectation flattens that curve onto the horizontal axis, which makes departures far easier to see than a comparison of two rising curves.


G 和 F 都只看最近的那一个事件，把格局的大部分信息丢掉了。Ripley 的 K 函数统计每个事件在距离 r 以内的所有事件，对全部事件取平均并按强度标准化，因此能一次性描述整个距离范围上的格局。
下面的图画的是 K(d) - r 而不是 K(d) 本身。CSR 下 K(r) = πr²，减去期望值可把该曲线压平到横轴上，比起对比两条上升曲线，偏离要容易看得多。


Choa Chu Kang planning area

K_ck <- Kest(childcare_ck_ppp, correction = "Ripley")
plot(K_ck, . - r ~ r, ylab = "K(d)-r", xlab = "d(m)")









set.seed(1234)
K_ck.csr <- envelope(childcare_ck_ppp, Kest,
                     nsim = 99, rank = 1, glocal = TRUE)

plot(K_ck.csr, . - r ~ r, xlab = "d", ylab = "K(d)-r")










Tampines planning area

K_tm <- Kest(childcare_tm_ppp, correction = "Ripley")
plot(K_tm, . - r ~ r, ylab = "K(d)-r", xlab = "d(m)", xlim = c(0, 1000))

plot(K_tm.csr, . - r ~ r, xlab = "d", ylab = "K(d)-r", xlim = c(0, 500))














NoteWhy glocal = TRUE and only 99 simulations



glocal = TRUE requests a global envelope. A pointwise envelope is a separate test at every distance, so with hundreds of distances some will fall outside by chance alone and the apparent significance is inflated. A global envelope has the stated coverage across the whole curve simultaneously, which is what a claim about the pattern actually requires.
The simulation count drops to 99 because K is far more expensive to compute than G, since it counts every pair of events at every distance rather than one distance per event. With rank = 1 and 99 simulations the envelope is the pointwise extreme of those runs, giving a test at the 0.01 level.

title: Hands-on Exercise 2b: 2nd Order Spatial Point Patterns Analysis
section: Analysing Spatial Point Process Using L-Function
text:
Analysing Spatial Point Process Using L-Function

K(r) grows as r², so its variance grows with distance too, and the envelope fans out at larger r even when nothing is happening. The L-function is the square-root transformation that removes this:


K(r) 随 r² 增长，它的方差也随距离增长，所以即便什么都没发生，包络在 r 较大处也会张开。L 函数就是消除这一点的平方根变换：

\[L(r) = \sqrt{\frac{K(r)}{\pi}}\]

Under CSR, L(r) = r, so plotting L(d) - r again flattens the expectation onto the horizontal axis, but now with roughly constant variance across the whole range, which makes the envelope width comparable at every distance. This is why L is normally the function reported.


CSR 下 L(r) = r，所以画 L(d) - r 同样把期望压平到横轴，但此时整个范围上的方差大致恒定，包络宽度在各距离上可比。这就是通常以 L 作为上报函数的原因。


Choa Chu Kang planning area

L_ck <- Lest(childcare_ck_ppp, correction = "Ripley")
plot(L_ck, . - r ~ r, ylab = "L(d)-r", xlab = "d(m)")

title: Hands-on Exercise 2b: 2nd Order Spatial Point Patterns Analysis
text:
Summary








Function
Measures from
Clustering shows as




G
each event to its nearest event
curve above the envelope


F
arbitrary locations to the nearest event
curve below the envelope


K
each event to all events within r
curve above the envelope


L
as K, variance-stabilised
curve above the envelope




The direction reverses for F because it measures empty space rather than proximity: a clustered pattern leaves larger gaps, so a randomly chosen location is further from the nearest event than CSR predicts. Reading F in the same direction as G therefore inverts the conclusion.


F 的方向之所以反过来，是因为它量的是空白而不是邻近：聚集的格局留下更大的空隙，于是随机取到的位置到最近事件的距离比 CSR 预期的更远。把 F 按 G 的方向去读，结论会正好读反。


All four are global statistics: they characterise the pattern as a whole and cannot say where any clustering sits. That question requires local methods, so none of the four supports a claim about a particular part of the map.


这四个都是全局统计量：它们刻画的是整体格局，说不出聚集究竟在哪里。那个问题要靠局部方法，所以四者都不足以支撑关于地图上某一具体部位的论断。

title: Hands-on Exercise 1b: Thematic Mapping and GeoVisualisation with R
text:
Thematic mapping uses map symbols to visualise selected properties of geographic features that are not naturally visible, such as population, temperature, crime rate, and property prices.
Geovisualisation combines cartography, computer science, and information visualisation to explore, analyse, and communicate geospatial data, enhancing spatial understanding and knowledge discovery.
In this hands-on exercise, I learn how to plot functional and truthful choropleth maps using the tmap package in R.


专题制图用地图符号把地理要素上那些本来看不见的属性画出来，例如人口、气温、犯罪率、房价。
地理可视化把地图学、计算机科学和信息可视化结合起来，用于探索、分析和传达地理空间数据，从而增进对空间的理解、促成新的发现。
本次练习学习用 R 的 tmap 包绘制既实用又如实的分级统计地图。

Getting Started

tmap for thematic map creation

title: Hands-on Exercise 1b: Thematic Mapping and GeoVisualisation with R
text:
Importing Data into R

The Data

Two datasets are used:

Master Plan 2019 Subzone Boundary (No Sea) (GeoJSON) from data.gov.sg, the geospatial data providing Singapore’s planning subzone boundaries based on URA Master Plan 2019.
Singapore Residents by Planning Area / Subzone, Age Group, Sex and Type of Dwelling, June 2024 (respopagesextod2024.csv) from Department of Statistics, Singapore, the aspatial data whose PA and SZ fields georeference it to the subzone boundaries.



使用两个数据集：

Master Plan 2019 Subzone Boundary (No Sea)（GeoJSON），来自 data.gov.sg，是依据 URA 2019 总体规划的新加坡规划分区边界；
Singapore Residents by Planning Area / Subzone, Age Group, Sex and Type of Dwelling, June 2024（respopagesextod2024.csv），来自新加坡统计局，是非空间数据，靠 PA 与 SZ 两个字段与分区边界对应起来。




Importing Geospatial Data into R

st_read() is used to import the GeoJSON file, and the data is immediately transformed to the SVY21 projected coordinate system (EPSG: 3414). Unlike KML, the GeoJSON format already encodes attribute fields as proper columns, so no additional parsing is needed.


st_read() 读入 GeoJSON，随即转换到 SVY21 投影坐标系统（EPSG: 3414）。GeoJSON 已经把属性字段存成规整的列，不像 KML 那样需要额外解析。


mpsz <- st_read("data/geospatial/MasterPlan2019SubzoneBoundaryNoSea.geojson") %>%
  st_transform(crs = 3414)

Reading layer `URA_MP19_SUBZONE_NO_SEA_PL' from data source

Examining the mpsz data frame:


查看 mpsz 数据框：

Only the first ten records are displayed by default because mpsz is a simple feature (sf) data frame, and sf objects print a limited number of rows to keep output manageable.


默认只显示前十条记录，因为 mpsz 是简单要素（sf）数据框，sf 对象为控制输出长度只打印有限行数。



Importing Attribute Data into R

The population CSV file is imported using read_csv():


用 read_csv() 导入人口 csv 文件：


popdata <- read_csv("data/aspatial/respopagesextod2024.csv")



Data Preparation

A data table with 2024 values is prepared with the variables: PA, SZ, YOUNG, ECONOMY ACTIVE, AGED, TOTAL, and DEPENDENCY.

YOUNG: age groups 0–4 to 20–24
ECONOMY ACTIVE: age groups 25–29 to 60–64
AGED: age group 65 and above
TOTAL: all age groups
DEPENDENCY: ratio of (YOUNG + AGED) to ECONOMY ACTIVE



整理出一张 2024 年的数据表，含 PA、SZ、YOUNG、ECONOMY ACTIVE、AGED、TOTAL、DEPENDENCY 七个变量。

YOUNG：0–4 岁到 20–24 岁各组之和；
ECONOMY ACTIVE：25–29 岁到 60–64 岁各组之和；
AGED：65 岁及以上；
TOTAL：全部年龄组之和；
DEPENDENCY：（YOUNG + AGED）与 ECONOMY ACTIVE 之比。



Data wrangling

pivot_wider() from tidyr and mutate(), filter(), group_by(), select() from dplyr are used. Column names are referenced explicitly in rowSums() instead of positional indices, as pivot_wider() sorts age group columns alphabetically (causing 5_to_9 to appear after 55_to_59), which makes positional indexing unreliable:


用到 tidyr 的 pivot_wider() 和 dplyr 的 mutate()、filter()、group_by()、select()。rowSums() 里按列名引用而不是按位置，因为 pivot_wider() 会把年龄组列按字母序排列（5_to_9 会排到 55_to_59 后面），按位置取列并不可靠：


popdata2024 <- popdata %>%
  group_by(PA, SZ, AG) %>%
  summarise(`POP` = sum(`Pop`)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = AG,
              values_from = POP) %>%
  mutate(YOUNG = rowSums(select(., `0_to_4`, `5_to_9`, `10_to_14`,
                                   `15_to_19`, `20_to_24`),
                         na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(`ECONOMY ACTIVE` = rowSums(select(., `25_to_29`, `30_to_34`,
                                              `35_to_39`, `40_to_44`,
                                              `45_to_49`, `50_to_54`,
                                              `55_to_59`, `60_to_64`),
                                    na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(`AGED` = rowSums(select(., `65_to_69`, `70_to_74`, `75_to_79`,
                                    `80_to_84`, `85_to_89`, `90_and_over`),
                          na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(`TOTAL` = rowSums(select(., `0_to_4`:`90_and_over`),
                           na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(`DEPENDENCY` = (`YOUNG` + `AGED`) / `ECONOMY ACTIVE`) %>%
  select(`PA`, `SZ`, `YOUNG`, `ECONOMY ACTIVE`, `AGED`, `TOTAL`, `DEPENDENCY`)



Joining attribute data and geospatial data

The PA and SZ values are converted to uppercase to match SUBZONE_N and PLN_AREA_N, and rows with no economy active population are removed:


把 PA 与 SZ 转成大写以便与 SUBZONE_N、PLN_AREA_N 匹配，并剔除经济活动人口为零的行：


popdata2024 <- popdata2024 %>%
  mutate_at(.vars = vars(PA, SZ),
            .funs = list(toupper)) %>%
  filter(`ECONOMY ACTIVE` > 0)


left_join() joins the geospatial and attribute data using SUBZONE_N and SZ as the common identifier. Using mpsz as the left table ensures the output remains a simple feature data frame:


left_join() 以 SUBZONE_N 和 SZ 为共同标识把空间数据与属性数据连接起来。把 mpsz 放在左表，结果才仍是简单要素数据框：


mpsz_pop2024 <- left_join(mpsz, popdata2024,
                           by = c("SUBZONE_N" = "SZ"))


Saving the joined data frame as an RDS file for future use:


把连接后的数据框存成 RDS 文件备用：


dir.create("data/rds/", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write_rds(mpsz_pop2024, "data/rds/mpsz_pop2024.rds")

title: Hands-on Exercise 1b: Thematic Mapping and GeoVisualisation with R
text:
Choropleth Mapping with tmap

Two approaches are available for creating choropleth maps in tmap:

Quick plot using qtm()
Fully customisable map using tmap layer elements



在 tmap 里绘制分级统计地图有两条路：

用 qtm() 快速出图；
用 tmap 的图层元素完全自定义。



Quick choropleth map with qtm()

qtm() provides a concise way to produce a standard choropleth map. tmap_mode("plot") sets the output to a static map:


qtm() 是画一张标准分级统计地图最省事的写法。tmap_mode("plot") 把输出设为静态地图：


tmap_mode("plot")
qtm(shp = mpsz_pop2024,
    fill = "DEPENDENCY")










Customisable choropleth map using tmap elements

For finer control over cartographic quality, tmap’s individual drawing elements are used:


若要对制图质量有更细的控制，就改用 tmap 的各个绘图元素：


tm_shape(mpsz_pop2024) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "DEPENDENCY",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 5,
                values = "brewer.blues"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(
                title = "Dependency ratio")) +
  tm_title("Distribution of Dependency Ratio by planning subzone") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
  tm_borders(fill_alpha = 0.5) +
  tm_compass(type = "8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2) +
  tm_credits("Source: Planning Sub-zone boundary from Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA)\n and Population data from Department of Statistics DOS",
             position = c("left", "bottom"))









Drawing a base map

tm_shape() defines the input data, and tm_polygons() draws the polygon layer with default styling (light gray fill, dark gray borders):


tm_shape() 指定输入数据，tm_polygons() 以默认样式绘制多边形图层（浅灰填充、深灰边界）：


tm_shape(mpsz_pop2024) +
  tm_polygons()










Choropleth map using tm_polygons()

Assigning a variable to fill within tm_polygons() produces a choropleth map. The default classification method is pretty and the default colour scheme is blues3:


在 tm_polygons() 里把变量赋给 fill 就得到分级统计地图。默认分级方法是 pretty，默认配色是 blues3：


tm_shape(mpsz_pop2024) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "DEPENDENCY")










Using tm_fill() and tm_borders()

tm_polygons() is a wrapper of tm_fill() and tm_borders(). Using them separately provides more control. tm_fill() alone (no borders):


tm_polygons() 其实是 tm_fill() 与 tm_borders() 的封装，分开用控制力更强。只用 tm_fill()（不画边界）：


tm_shape(mpsz_pop2024) +
  tm_fill("DEPENDENCY")









Adding borders with tm_borders():


用 tm_borders() 加上边界：


tm_shape(mpsz_pop2024) +
  tm_fill("DEPENDENCY") +
  tm_borders()









Customising border appearance with col, lwd, and lty:


用 col、lwd、lty 调整边界外观：


tm_shape(mpsz_pop2024) +
  tm_fill("DEPENDENCY") +
  tm_borders(col = "grey60",
             lwd = 0.1,
             lty = "dashed")











Data Classification Methods

tmap supports ten classification methods: fixed, sd, equal, pretty (default), quantile, kmeans, hclust, bclust, fisher, and jenks. The style argument in tm_scale_intervals() is used to specify the method.


tmap 支持十种分级方法：fixed、sd、equal、pretty（默认）、quantile、kmeans、hclust、bclust、fisher、jenks。用 tm_scale_intervals() 的 style 参数指定。


Quantile classification (5 classes)

tm_shape(mpsz_pop2024) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "DEPENDENCY",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 5)) +
  tm_borders(fill_alpha = 0.5)










Equal interval classification (5 classes)

tm_shape(mpsz_pop2024) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "DEPENDENCY",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "equal",
                n = 5)) +
  tm_borders(fill_alpha = 0.5)









The quantile method produces more evenly distributed class sizes compared to equal interval, which can be skewed by data distribution.


分位数法各类的要素个数较为均匀；等间距法则会被数据本身的分布带偏。



Custom break points

Descriptive statistics are checked first to inform break point choices:


先看描述统计，据此决定断点：


summary(mpsz_pop2024$DEPENDENCY)

   Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max.    NA's 
 0.0000  0.6750  0.7283  0.7563  0.8140 10.0000      94 



Custom breaks are set at 0.60, 0.70, 0.80, and 0.90, with minimum 0 and maximum 1.00:


自定义断点设在 0.60、0.70、0.80、0.90，下限 0、上限 1.00：


tm_shape(mpsz_pop2024) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "DEPENDENCY",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                breaks = c(0, 0.60, 0.70, 0.80, 0.90, 1.00))) +
  tm_borders(fill_alpha = 0.5)











Colour Scheme

Using ColourBrewer palette

The values argument in tm_scale_intervals() accepts ColourBrewer palette names:


tm_scale_intervals() 的 values 参数接受 ColourBrewer 配色名：


tm_shape(mpsz_pop2024) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "DEPENDENCY",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 5,
                values = "brewer.greens")) +
  tm_borders(fill_alpha = 0.5)









To reverse the colour direction, prefix the palette name with -:


在配色名前加 - 可以反转色序：


tm_shape(mpsz_pop2024) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "DEPENDENCY",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 5,
                values = "-brewer.greens")) +
  tm_borders(fill_alpha = 0.5)










Cartographic furniture

tm_compass(), tm_scalebar(), tm_grid(), and tm_credits() add map furniture:


tm_compass()、tm_scalebar()、tm_grid()、tm_credits() 用来添加指北针、比例尺、经纬网和图注：


tm_shape(mpsz_pop2024) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "DEPENDENCY",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 5)) +
  tm_borders(fill_alpha = 0.5) +
  tm_compass(type = "8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(lwd = 0.1, alpha = 0.2) +
  tm_credits("Source: data.gov.sg & singstat",
             position = c("left", "bottom"))











Map Layout

Map legend

fill.legend and tm_legend() customise the legend position and title:


fill.legend 配合 tm_legend() 调整图例的位置与标题：


tm_shape(mpsz_pop2024) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "DEPENDENCY",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 5),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(
                title = "Dependency ratio")) +
  tm_pos_auto_in() +
  tm_borders(fill_alpha = 0.5) +
  tm_compass(type = "8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(lwd = 0.1, alpha = 0.2) +
  tm_credits("Source: data.gov.sg & singstat",
             position = c("left", "bottom"))










Map style

tmap_style() applies predefined layout themes. The natural style is used below:


tmap_style() 套用预设的版面主题，下面用的是 natural：


tm_shape(mpsz_pop2024) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "DEPENDENCY",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 5,
                values = "-brewer.greens")) +
  tm_borders(fill_alpha = 0.5) +
  tmap_style("natural")









Resetting to the default white style:


改回默认的 white 样式：


tmap_style("white")

title: Hands-on Exercise 1b: Thematic Mapping and GeoVisualisation with R
text:
Small Multiple Choropleth Maps

Small multiple maps (facet maps) place many maps side-by-side to show how spatial patterns change with respect to another variable. In tmap, they can be created three ways.


小多图（分面地图）把多幅地图并排放置，用来呈现空间格局如何随另一个变量变化。在 tmap 里有三种做法。


By assigning multiple values to an aesthetic argument

Assigning two variables to fill generates side-by-side choropleth maps:


把两个变量同时赋给 fill，就会并排生成两幅分级统计地图：


tm_shape(mpsz_pop2024) +
  tm_polygons(
    fill = c("YOUNG", "AGED"),
    fill.legend = tm_legend(
      position = tm_pos_in("right", "bottom")),
    fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
      style = "equal",
      n = 5,
      values = "brewer.blues")) +
  tm_borders(fill_alpha = 0.5) +
  tmap_style("natural")










By arranging maps in a grid layout with tmap_arrange()

Individual maps are created separately and then arranged:


先分别做好各幅地图，再排版：


youngmap <- tm_shape(mpsz_pop2024) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "YOUNG",
              fill.legend = tm_legend(
                position = tm_pos_in("right", "bottom"),
                item.height = 0.8),
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                values = "brewer.blues")) +
  tm_borders(fill_alpha = 0.5) +
  tm_title("Distribution of young population")

agedmap <- tm_shape(mpsz_pop2024) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "AGED",
              fill.legend = tm_legend(
                position = tm_pos_in("right", "bottom"),
                item.height = 0.8),
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                values = "brewer.blues")) +
  tm_borders(fill_alpha = 0.5) +
  tm_title("Distribution of aged population")

tmap_arrange(youngmap, agedmap, asp = 1, ncol = 2)










By defining a group-by variable in tm_facets()

tm_facets() splits the map by a categorical variable:


tm_facets() 按某个分类变量把地图拆开：


tm_shape(mpsz_pop2024) +
  tm_fill(fill = "DEPENDENCY",
          fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
            style = "quantile",
            values = "brewer.blues")) +
  tm_facets(by = "REGION_N",
            nrow = 2,
            ncol = 3,
            free.coords = TRUE,
            drop.units = TRUE) +
  tm_layout(legend.show = TRUE,
            title.position = c("center", "center"),
            title.size = 20) +
  tm_borders(fill_alpha = 0.5)

title: Hands-on Exercise 1b: Thematic Mapping and GeoVisualisation with R
section: Mapping Spatial Object Meeting a Selection Criterion
text:
Mapping Spatial Object Meeting a Selection Criterion

filter() from dplyr is used to focus the choropleth map on a specific region:


用 dplyr 的 filter() 把分级统计地图聚焦到某一个区域：


mpsz_pop2024 %>%
  filter(REGION_N == "CENTRAL REGION") %>%
  tm_shape() +
  tm_polygons(fill = "DEPENDENCY",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                values = "brewer.greens"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend()) +
  tm_borders(fill_alpha = 0.5)

title: Hands-on Exercise 1b: Thematic Mapping and GeoVisualisation with R
section: Complementing Thematic Map with Statistical Chart
text:
Complementing Thematic Map with Statistical Chart

Maps and statistical charts complement each other: maps show spatial patterns while charts display numerical distributions. tmap supports embedding statistical charts directly into map visualisations using the fill.chart argument.
Adding a box plot to the Central Region dependency map:


地图与统计图互为补充：地图显示空间格局，统计图显示数值分布。tmap 支持用 fill.chart 参数把统计图直接嵌进地图里。
给中部地区的抚养比地图加上箱线图：


mpsz_pop2024 %>%
  filter(REGION_N == "CENTRAL REGION") %>%
  tm_shape() +
  tm_polygons(fill = "DEPENDENCY",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                values = "brewer.greens"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(),
              fill.chart = tm_chart_box()) +
  tm_borders() +
  tm_layout(asp = 0.8)









Outliers in the dependency distribution are highlighted on the choropleth map using red borders and subzone labels:


把抚养比分布中的离群分区在地图上用红色边界和分区名标出来：


mpsz_selected <- mpsz_pop2024 %>%
  filter(REGION_N == "CENTRAL REGION")

stats <- boxplot.stats(mpsz_selected$DEPENDENCY)
outlier_vals <- stats$out
outlier_sf <- mpsz_selected[mpsz_selected$DEPENDENCY %in% outlier_vals, ]

tm_shape(mpsz_selected) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "DEPENDENCY",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                values = "brewer.blues"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(),
              fill.chart = tm_chart_box()) +
  tm_borders(fill_alpha = 0.5) +
  tm_shape(outlier_sf) +
  tm_borders(col = "red", lwd = 2) +
  tm_text("SUBZONE_N", col = "red", size = 0.7) +
  tm_layout(asp = 0.8)

title: Hands-on Exercise 1b: Thematic Mapping and GeoVisualisation with R
text:
Creating Interactive Maps

tmap_mode("view") switches to interactive mode, allowing users to zoom, pan, and click on features for popup information.
Basic interactive map of the Central Region:


tmap_mode("view") 切换到交互模式，可以缩放、平移，点击要素还能弹出信息。
中部地区的基础交互地图：


region_selected <- mpsz_pop2024 %>%
  filter(REGION_N == "CENTRAL REGION")
region_bbox <- st_bbox(region_selected)

stats <- boxplot.stats(region_selected$DEPENDENCY)
outlier_vals <- stats$out
outlier_sf <- region_selected[region_selected$DEPENDENCY %in% outlier_vals, ]

tmap_mode("view")
tm_shape(region_selected,
         bbox = region_bbox) +
  tm_fill("DEPENDENCY",
          id = "SUBZONE_N",
          popup.vars = c(
            "Name"       = "SUBZONE_N",
            "Dependency" = "DEPENDENCY")) +
  tm_borders() +
  tm_shape(outlier_sf) +
  tm_borders(col = "red", lwd = 2)





tmap_mode("plot")


To prevent users from zooming too far out of the study area, set_zoom_limits restricts the zoom range:


为避免缩得太小而离开研究区，用 set_zoom_limits 限制缩放范围：


tmap_mode("view")
tm_shape(region_selected,
         bbox = region_bbox) +
  tm_fill("DEPENDENCY",
          id = "SUBZONE_N",
          popup.vars = c(
            "Name"       = "SUBZONE_N",
            "Dependency" = "DEPENDENCY")) +
  tm_borders() +
  tm_shape(outlier_sf) +
  tm_borders(col = "red", lwd = 2) +
  tm_view(set_zoom_limits = c(12, 14))





tmap_mode("plot")


Setting set_zoom_limits = c(12, 14) restricts how far users can zoom in (level 14) and out (level 12), keeping the focus on the Central Region throughout exploration.


设 set_zoom_limits = c(12, 14) 之后，最大放大到第 14 级、最小缩到第 12 级，浏览过程始终锁定在中部地区。

title: Ji Guofang
text:
About this portfolio关于本作品集
      Ji Guofang
      
        Master of IT in Business candidate at the School of Computing and Information
        Systems, Singapore Management University. This site collects the work produced
        for ISSS626 Geospatial Analytics and Applications, covering every exercise, the
        code behind it, and what the results actually showed.新加坡管理大学计算与信息系统学院信息技术（商业）硕士在读。本站汇集
        ISSS626 地理空间分析与应用课程的作业成果，涵盖每一次练习、
        背后的代码，以及结果实际说明了什么。
      

      
        
          ✉
          guofang.ji.2024@mitb.smu.edu.sg
        
        
          ◧
          github.com/imgigi/626
        
      
    

    
      
        
          541
          code chunks个代码块
        
      
      sf
      tmap
      terra
      spatstat
    
  

  The toolkit工具箱

  

    
      
        sf
        Vector
      
      sf
      Reading GeoJSON and shapefiles, assigning and transforming coordinate
      systems, buffering, spatial joins and point-in-polygon counting.读取 GeoJSON 与 shapefile，指定并转换坐标系统，缓冲区、空间连接，以及点在多边形内的计数。
      Used in all fifteen exercises十五份练习全部用到
    

    
      
        tm
        Cartography
      
      tmap 4.x
      Choropleths, classification methods, colour schemes, small multiples,
      raster layers and interactive maps, written against the v4 API.分级统计图、分级方法、配色方案、小多图、栅格图层与交互地图，全部按 v4 的 API 编写。
      Used in fourteen exercises用于 十四 份练习
    

    
      
        sp
        Point patterns
      
      spatstat
      Kernel density estimation, bandwidth selection, the Clark-Evans test and
      the G, F, K and L summary functions with Monte Carlo envelopes.核密度估计、带宽选择、Clark-Evans 检验，以及带蒙特卡洛包络的 G、F、K、L 汇总函数。
      Used in three exercises用于 三 份练习
    

    
      
        tr
        Raster
      
      terra
      The raster data model: building grids, rasterising point layers, and
      converting density surfaces for cartographic output.栅格数据模型：建立格网、把点图层栅格化，以及把密度面转换成可供制图输出的形式。
      Used in two exercises用于 两 份练习
    

    
      
        gg
        Statistics
      
      ggstatsplot
      Charts that carry their own confirmatory test, turning a visual impression
      into a reportable correlation with a confidence interval.图里自带确认性检验，把视觉印象变成可报告的相关系数及其置信区间。
      Used in three exercises用于 三 份练习
    

    
      
        ◉
        Weights
      
      spdep
      Contiguity and distance neighbour lists, row-standardised and binary weights, spatially lagged variables, Moran's I, Geary's C, spatial correlograms and SKATER.邻接与距离邻居列表、行标准化与二值权重、空间滞后变量，以及 Moran's I、Geary's C、空间相关图与 SKATER。
      Used in three exercises用于 三 份练习
    

    
      
        ◈
        Local stats
      
      sfdep
      The same computations carried as list columns of an sf table: local Moran's I, Getis-Ord Gi*, distance bands and the emerging hot spot space-time cube.同一套计算以 sf 表的列表列承载：局部 Moran's I、Getis-Ord Gi*、距离带，以及新兴热点分析的时空立方体。
      Used in two exercises用于 两 份练习
    

    
      
        ◐
        GW models
      
      GWmodel
      Kernel-weighted local statistics and geographically weighted regression, with bandwidth chosen by cross-validation or AIC, fixed or adaptive.核加权的局部统计量与地理加权回归，带宽由交叉验证或 AIC 选定，可取固定或自适应。
      Used in one exercise用于 一 份练习
    

    
      
        ◎
        Accessibility
      
      SpatialAcc
      Potential and floating catchment accessibility measures from a demand vector, a capacity vector and a distance matrix: Hansen, KD2SFCA and SAM.由需求向量、容量向量与距离矩阵计算潜能模型与移动搜寻域类可达性测度：Hansen、KD2SFCA 与 SAM。
      Used in two exercises用于 两 份练习
    

    
      
        ⊚
        Accessibility
      
      catchment
      The whole floating catchment family through one function: 2SFCA, E2SFCA, a Gaussian KD2SFCA, 3SFCA and M2SFCA, plus the weight functions behind them.用一个函数覆盖整个移动搜寻域家族：2SFCA、E2SFCA、高斯核 KD2SFCA、3SFCA 与 M2SFCA，以及它们背后的权重函数。
      Used in one exercise用于 一 份练习
    

    
      
        H
        Market area
      
      MCI
      Huff patronage probabilities from an interaction matrix of origins, stores, attractiveness and distance, and their totals as expected customers per store.由起点、门店、吸引力与距离构成的交互矩阵计算 Huff 光顾概率，并汇总为各门店的预期顾客数。
      Used in one exercise用于 一 份练习
    

    
      
        tv
        Wrangling
      
      tidyverse
      Import, reshape and join with readr, dplyr, tidyr,
      ggplot2 and purrr throughout.全程用 readr、dplyr、tidyr、ggplot2、purrr 做导入、整形与连接。
      Used in all fifteen exercises十五份练习全部用到
    

  

  Course progress课程进度

  

    
      
      
        
          Lesson 1 · Geospatial data models and mapping第 1 讲 · 地理空间数据模型与制图
          3 exercises
        
        Vector and raster data models, geographic versus projected coordinate
        systems, and thematic mapping principles. Produced the first choropleths of
        Singapore's planning subzones, then went beyond the built-in classification
        methods to percentile and box maps whose breaks come from the data
        distribution itself.矢量与栅格数据模型、地理坐标系与投影坐标系的区别，以及专题制图的原则。先做出新加坡规划分区的首批分级统计图，再越过内置分级方法，改用断点直接取自数据分布本身的百分位图与箱式图。
      
    

    
      
      
        
          Lesson 2 · Spatial point patterns analysis第 2 讲 · 空间点格局分析
          2 exercises
        
        First-order methods describing where events are dense, and second-order
        methods describing whether events attract or repel one another and at what
        distance. The headline result: Singapore's 1,925 childcare centres are
        strongly clustered, R = 0.552, and the pattern survives every test
        applied to it.一阶方法描述事件在哪里稠密，二阶方法描述事件之间是相互吸引还是排斥、且在什么距离上如此。主要结论是：新加坡 1,925 家托儿中心呈强聚集，R = 0.552，而且这一格局通过了所施加的每一项检验。
      
    

    
      
      
        
          Lesson 3 · Spatio-temporal point patterns第 3 讲 · 时空点格局
          1 exercise
        
        Adding time to the point pattern: spatio-temporal kernel density
        estimation and space-time K-functions, applied to forest fire detections in
        Kepulauan Bangka Belitung, Indonesia.给点格局加上时间维：时空核密度估计与时空 K 函数，应用于印度尼西亚邦加勿里洞群岛的森林火点探测数据。
      
    

    
      
      
        
          Lessons 4 – 5 · Spatial weights and autocorrelation第 4 – 5 讲 · 空间权重与自相关
          4 exercises
        
        Four ways of deciding which areas count as neighbours, then the global and
        local statistics built on that decision: Moran's I and Geary's C against both
        an analytical and a permutation null, LISA cluster maps, and Getis-Ord Gi*
        hot and cold spots across Hunan's 88 counties.四种判定「谁是邻居」的方式，以及建立在这一判定之上的全局与局部统计量：Moran's I 与 Geary's C 同时对照解析零分布与置换零分布，LISA 聚类图，以及湖南 88 个县上的 Getis-Ord Gi* 热点与冷点。
      
    

    
      
      
        
          Lesson 6 · Spatially constrained clustering第 6 讲 · 带空间约束的聚类
          2 exercises
        
        Regionalisation with Ward, SKATER and ClustGeo, and the price of requiring
        contiguity measured rather than argued: 26 percentage points of attribute
        homogeneity on the Shan State data. Emerging hot spot analysis over a
        seventeen-year space-time cube.用 Ward、SKATER 与 ClustGeo 做区域化，并把「要求连片」的代价测出来而不是争论出来：在掸邦数据上是 26 个百分点的属性同质性。另有十七年时空立方体上的新兴热点分析。
      
    

    
      
      
        
          Lesson 7 · Modelling geographical accessibility第 7 讲 · 地理可达性建模
          2 exercises
        
        Hansen, KD2SFCA and SAM applied to the same 3,125 × 120 road-network
        distance matrix. The three rank the island almost identically, at a rank
        correlation between 0.905 and 0.986; what moves the answer is the decay
        exponent and the 5 km catchment, which leaves 41 per cent of the grid at
        exactly zero. The in-class follow-up runs five floating catchment variants on the same matrix and finds 159 hexagons whose distance to all 120 centres is one copied value, among them the cell that tops the 2SFCA map.把 Hansen、KD2SFCA 与 SAM 用在同一个 3,125 × 120 的路网距离矩阵上。三者对全岛的排序几乎一致，秩相关在 0.905 到 0.986 之间；真正改变答案的是衰减指数，以及 5 km 的搜寻域——它让 41% 的网格取值恰为零。课堂练习在同一矩阵上跑了五种移动搜寻域变体，并发现有 159 个六边形到全部 120 个中心的距离是同一个被复制的值，2SFCA 地图上的最高点就是其中之一。
      
    

    
      
      
        
          Lesson 8 · Market area analysis第 8 讲 · 商圈分析
          1 exercise
        
        Huff trade areas for 28 fast-food stores across 617 Taichung villages. With
        every store given the same size, each village's most probable store is simply its
        nearest, and expected customers track actual sales at r = 0.58, rising to 0.66
        under a gentler distance decay.在台中 617 个村里上为 28 家快餐门店划定 Huff 商圈。各店规模设为相同时，每个村里最可能光顾的门店就是离它最近的那家；预期顾客数与实际销售额的相关为 r = 0.58，改用较平缓的距离衰减后升到 0.66。
      
    

    
      
      
        
          Lessons 9 – 10第 9 – 10 讲
          Ahead
        
        Geographically weighted explanatory and predictive models.地理加权解释模型与预测模型。
      
    

  

  How this site is built本站是怎么搭的

  

    
      
        Q
      
      Quarto
      Every page is a .qmd document. Code, output and commentary live
      in one file, so nothing shown here was pasted in by hand. The figures are
      rendered from the code above them.每一页都是一个 .qmd 文档。代码、输出与说明同处一个文件，所以这里展示的任何东西都不是手工粘贴进来的，图都由其上方的代码渲染而成。
    

    
      
        R
      
      R 4.5.2
      All analysis runs locally and is frozen with freeze: auto, so a
      published result is reproducible from the exact code beside it.全部分析在本地运行，并以 freeze: auto 冻结，因此发布出来的结果都能由紧邻它的那段代码复现。
    

    
      
        ▲
      
      Vercel
      The rendered site is committed and deployed on push, from
      github.com/imgigi/626.渲染好的站点随提交推送部署，源自 github.com/imgigi/626。

title: Hands-on Exercise 1: Geospatial Data Science with R
text:
In this hands-on exercise, I learn how to handle geospatial data in R using the sf package. Geospatial Data Science involves importing, wrangling, integrating, and processing geographically referenced datasets. By the end of this exercise, I am able to:

install and load sf and tidyverse packages into R environment,
import geospatial data using appropriate functions of sf package,
import aspatial data using readr package,
explore simple feature data frames using Base R and sf functions,
assign or transform coordinate systems using sf functions,
convert aspatial data into a sf data frame,
perform geoprocessing tasks using sf package,
perform data wrangling using dplyr, and
perform Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) using ggplot2.



本次练习学习用 sf 包在 R 中处理地理空间数据。地理空间数据科学所做的事，是把带有地理参照的数据集导入、整理、整合并加工。练习结束时应当能够：

在 R 环境中安装并载入 sf 与 tidyverse；
用 sf 的相应函数导入地理空间数据；
用 readr 导入非空间数据；
用 Base R 与 sf 的函数查看简单要素数据框；
用 sf 的函数指定或转换坐标系统；
把非空间数据转换成 sf 数据框；
用 sf 完成地理处理任务；
用 dplyr 做数据整理；
用 ggplot2 做探索性数据分析。

title: Hands-on Exercise 1: Geospatial Data Science with R
text:
Data Acquisition

The following datasets are used in this exercise:

Master Plan 2014 Subzone Boundary (Web) from data.gov.sg
Pre-Schools Location from data.gov.sg
Cycling Path from LTADataMall
Singapore Airbnb listing data from Inside Airbnb

The geospatial files (MP14_SUBZONE_WEB_PL, CyclingPathGazette, and PreSchoolsLocation.kml) are placed in the data/geospatial sub-folder. The aspatial file listings.csv is placed in the data/aspatial sub-folder.


本练习使用以下数据集：

Master Plan 2014 Subzone Boundary (Web)，来自 data.gov.sg
Pre-Schools Location，来自 data.gov.sg
Cycling Path，来自 LTADataMall
Singapore Airbnb listing data，来自 Inside Airbnb

三个地理空间文件（MP14_SUBZONE_WEB_PL、CyclingPathGazette、PreSchoolsLocation.kml）放在 data/geospatial 子目录下，非空间文件 listings.csv 放在 data/aspatial 子目录下。

title: Hands-on Exercise 1: Geospatial Data Science with R
text:
Getting Started

Two R packages are used in this exercise:

sf for importing, managing, and processing geospatial data
tidyverse for data science tasks including importing, wrangling, and visualising data

Within tidyverse, the following packages are specifically used: readr (importing csv), tidyr (manipulating data), dplyr (transforming data), and ggplot2 (visualising data).


本练习用到两个 R 包：

sf，负责地理空间数据的导入、管理与加工；
tidyverse，负责导入、整理、可视化等数据科学任务。

tidyverse 当中具体用到的是：readr（读 csv）、tidyr（整形）、dplyr（变换）、ggplot2（绘图）。


pacman::p_load(sf, tidyverse)


p_load() from the pacman package is used to install (if not yet installed) and load the packages into R.


pacman 包的 p_load() 会检查这些包是否已安装，未安装则先安装，然后一并载入 R。

title: Hands-on Exercise 1: Geospatial Data Science with R
text:
Importing Geospatial Data

Importing polygon feature data in shapefile format

st_read() is used to import MP14_SUBZONE_WEB_PL shapefile as a polygon feature data frame. The dsn argument specifies the data path and layer provides the shapefile name (no file extension needed).


st_read() 把 MP14_SUBZONE_WEB_PL 这个 shapefile 读成多边形要素数据框。dsn 指定数据所在路径，layer 给出图层名，不需要带扩展名。


mpsz = st_read("data/geospatial/MasterPlan2014SubzoneBoundaryNoSea.geojson") %>%
  st_transform(crs = 3414)

Reading layer `MP14_SUBZONE_NO_SEA_PL' from data source 
  `C:\Users\Imgigi\Desktop\629\hand-on-ex\hand-on-ex1\data\geospatial\MasterPlan2014SubzoneBoundaryNoSea.geojson' 
  using driver `GeoJSON'
Simple feature collection with 323 features and 13 fields
Geometry type: MULTIPOLYGON
Dimension:     XY
Bounding box:  xmin: 103.6057 ymin: 1.158699 xmax: 104.0885 ymax: 1.470775
Geodetic CRS:  WGS 84



The GeoJSON file is in wgs84 (EPSG: 4326) by default. st_transform(crs = 3414) is applied immediately upon import to reproject it to the svy21 projected coordinate system (EPSG: 3414).


这个 GeoJSON 文件默认是 wgs84（EPSG: 4326）。导入时紧接着调用 st_transform(crs = 3414)，把它投影到新加坡的 svy21 投影坐标系统（EPSG: 3414）。



Importing polyline feature data in shapefile format

cyclingpath = st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial",
                      layer = "CyclingPathGazette")

Reading layer `CyclingPathGazette' from data source 
  `C:\Users\Imgigi\Desktop\629\hand-on-ex\hand-on-ex1\data\geospatial' 
  using driver `ESRI Shapefile'
Simple feature collection with 4830 features and 7 fields
Geometry type: MULTILINESTRING
Dimension:     XY
Bounding box:  xmin: 11721.1 ymin: 27550.13 xmax: 42809.37 ymax: 49702.59
Projected CRS: SVY21



cyclingpath contains 4651 features and 19 fields, represented as multilinestring objects in svy21 projected coordinates.


cyclingpath 含 4651 个要素、19 个字段，几何类型是 multilinestring，坐标已在 svy21 投影下。



Importing GIS data in GeoJSON format

For GeoJSON files, the full file path including the .geojson extension is provided directly to st_read().


读 GeoJSON 时，直接把含 .geojson 扩展名的完整路径交给 st_read() 即可。


preschool = st_read("data/geospatial/PreSchoolsLocation.geojson")

Reading layer `PreSchoolsLocation' from data source 
  `C:\Users\Imgigi\Desktop\629\hand-on-ex\hand-on-ex1\data\geospatial\PreSchoolsLocation.geojson' 
  using driver `GeoJSON'
Simple feature collection with 2290 features and 2 fields
Geometry type: POINT
Dimension:     XYZ
Bounding box:  xmin: 103.6878 ymin: 1.247759 xmax: 103.9897 ymax: 1.462134
z_range:       zmin: 0 zmax: 0
Geodetic CRS:  WGS 84



preschool is a point feature data frame with point features and location fields. It is in wgs84 coordinate system. The projection transformation to svy21 will be performed later.


preschool 是点要素数据框，带有点几何和位置字段，坐标系统是 wgs84。投影到 svy21 的转换留到后面再做。

title: Hands-on Exercise 1: Geospatial Data Science with R
section: Checking the Content of A Simple Feature Data Frame
text:
Checking the Content of A Simple Feature Data Frame

Working with st_geometry()

st_geometry() retrieves the geometry list-column and prints basic information such as geometry type, geographic extent, and coordinate system.


st_geometry() 取出几何列表列，并打印几何类型、地理范围、坐标系统这些基本信息。


st_geometry(mpsz)

Geometry set for 323 features 
Geometry type: MULTIPOLYGON
Dimension:     XY
Bounding box:  xmin: 2667.538 ymin: 15748.72 xmax: 56396.44 ymax: 50256.33
Projected CRS: SVY21 / Singapore TM
First 5 geometries:

glimpse() from dplyr reveals the data type of each field in the data frame.


dplyr 的 glimpse() 列出数据框每个字段的数据类型。

title: Hands-on Exercise 1: Geospatial Data Science with R
text:
Plotting the Geospatial Data

plot() provides a quick way to visualise a sf object. By default, it produces a multi-plot of all attributes.


plot() 是快速查看 sf 对象的办法，默认会把所有属性各画一张，拼成多图。


plot(mpsz)









To plot only the geometry:


只画几何：


plot(st_geometry(mpsz))









To plot by a specific attribute:


按某一个属性上色：


plot(mpsz["PLN_AREA_N"])









Attempting to overlay the preschool points on the mpsz layer:


尝试把幼儿园点叠到 mpsz 图层上：


plot(st_geometry(mpsz))
plot(st_geometry(preschool), add = TRUE)














Note



The preschool points do not appear on the mpsz layer at this stage because preschool is still in wgs84 while mpsz has been transformed to svy21. The coordinate systems do not match, so the points fall outside the visible extent. The transformation will be applied in the next section.

title: Hands-on Exercise 1: Geospatial Data Science with R
text:
Working with Projection

Checking the coordinate system of a simple feature data frame

st_crs() is used to inspect the coordinate reference system of a sf object. Since mpsz was already transformed to svy21 during import, the EPSG code should be 3414:


st_crs() 用来查看 sf 对象的坐标参考系统。mpsz 在导入时已经转到 svy21，所以 EPSG 代码应当是 3414：


st_crs(mpsz)

Coordinate Reference System:
  User input: EPSG:3414 
  wkt:
PROJCRS["SVY21 / Singapore TM",
    BASEGEOGCRS["SVY21",
        DATUM["SVY21",
            ELLIPSOID["WGS 84",6378137,298.257223563,
                LENGTHUNIT["metre",1]]],
        PRIMEM["Greenwich",0,
            ANGLEUNIT["degree",0.0174532925199433]],
        ID["EPSG",4757]],
    CONVERSION["Singapore Transverse Mercator",
        METHOD["Transverse Mercator",
            ID["EPSG",9807]],
        PARAMETER["Latitude of natural origin",1.36666666666667,
            ANGLEUNIT["degree",0.0174532925199433],
            ID["EPSG",8801]],
        PARAMETER["Longitude of natural origin",103.833333333333,
            ANGLEUNIT["degree",0.0174532925199433],
            ID["EPSG",8802]],
        PARAMETER["Scale factor at natural origin",1,
            SCALEUNIT["unity",1],
            ID["EPSG",8805]],
        PARAMETER["False easting",28001.642,
            LENGTHUNIT["metre",1],
            ID["EPSG",8806]],
        PARAMETER["False northing",38744.572,
            LENGTHUNIT["metre",1],
            ID["EPSG",8807]]],
    CS[Cartesian,2],
        AXIS["northing (N)",north,
            ORDER[1],
            LENGTHUNIT["metre",1]],
        AXIS["easting (E)",east,
            ORDER[2],
            LENGTHUNIT["metre",1]],
    USAGE[
        SCOPE["Cadastre, engineering survey, topographic mapping."],
        AREA["Singapore - onshore and offshore."],
        BBOX[1.13,103.59,1.47,104.07]],
    ID["EPSG",3414]]



The output confirms mpsz is in svy21 (EPSG: 3414).


输出确认 mpsz 处于 svy21（EPSG: 3414）。







Note



In some workflows, particularly when importing shapefiles that were incorrectly labelled, the EPSG code may show as 9001 instead of 3414. In that case, st_set_crs(mpsz, 3414) can be used to assign the correct label. However, this only changes the label and does not mathematically reproject the coordinates. If the data is truly in WGS84 (as with GeoJSON files from data.gov.sg), st_transform(crs = 3414) must be used instead.




Transforming the projection of preschool from wgs84 to svy21

st_set_crs() only reassigns the label without mathematically reprojecting the coordinates. To actually reproject data from one CRS to another, st_transform() must be used:


st_set_crs() 只是改写标签，并不真正换算坐标。要把数据从一个坐标系真正投影到另一个，必须用 st_transform()：


preschool <- st_transform(preschool, crs = 3414)


Verifying the transformation:


核对转换结果：



Geometry set for 2290 features 
Geometry type: POINT
Dimension:     XYZ
Bounding box:  xmin: 11810.03 ymin: 25596.33 xmax: 45404.24 ymax: 49300.88
z_range:       zmin: 0 zmax: 0
Projected CRS: SVY21 / Singapore TM
First 5 geometries:



The preschool data is now in svy21. The bounding box values confirm this: the coordinates are well beyond the 0–360 range of decimal degrees used by geographic CRS.


幼儿园数据现在处于 svy21。边界框的数值可以印证：坐标远远超出地理坐标系十进制度数的 0–360 范围。


Now overlaying the preschool layer on mpsz works correctly:


此时再把幼儿园图层叠到 mpsz 上就正常了：


plot(st_geometry(mpsz))
plot(st_geometry(preschool), add = TRUE)









The composite map now displays as expected.


叠加后的地图显示符合预期。

text:
Importing and Converting An Aspatial Data

Importing the aspatial data

listings.csv from Inside Airbnb is imported using read_csv() from readr:


用 readr 的 read_csv() 导入 Inside Airbnb 的 listings.csv：


listings <- read_csv("data/aspatial/listings.csv")


Checking the imported data:

The listings tibble has 4252 rows and 16 columns. The latitude and longitude fields are in decimal degree format, indicating the data is likely in wgs84 Geographic Coordinate System.


listings 这个 tibble 有 4252 行、16 列。latitude 和 longitude 两个字段是十进制度数，说明数据大概处于 wgs84 地理坐标系统。



Creating a simple feature data frame from an aspatial data frame

st_as_sf() converts the tibble to a simple feature data frame. The coords argument takes the x-coordinate (longitude) first, then y-coordinate (latitude). The data is then reprojected from wgs84 (EPSG: 4326) to svy21 (EPSG: 3414):


st_as_sf() 把 tibble 转成简单要素数据框。coords 的顺序是先 x（经度）后 y（纬度）。之后再从 wgs84（EPSG: 4326）投影到 svy21（EPSG: 3414）：


listings_sf <- st_as_sf(listings,
                        coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
                        crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 3414)

title: Hands-on Exercise 1: Geospatial Data Science with R
text:
Geoprocessing with sf package

Use case 1: Land acquisition analysis

The scenario

The authority plans to upgrade existing cycling paths and needs to acquire 5 metres of reserved land on both sides of each path. The task is to determine the extent and total area of land to be acquired.


管理部门计划升级现有自行车道，需要在每条车道两侧各征收 5 米的保留地。任务是算出征地的范围和总面积。



The solution

First, st_buffer() is used to compute 5-metre buffers around cycling paths. The cycling path data is first transformed to svy21:


先用 st_buffer() 为自行车道生成 5 米缓冲区。自行车道数据先转到 svy21：


buffer_cycling <- st_buffer(cyclingpath, dist = 5, nQuadSegs = 30)


Calculating the area of each buffer using the tidyverse approach:


用 tidyverse 的写法算出每个缓冲区的面积：


buffer_cycling <- buffer_cycling %>%
  mutate(AREA = st_area(geometry))


Total land area to be acquired:


需要征收的土地总面积：


sum(buffer_cycling$AREA)

3687875 [m^2]



To visualise the buffer within a specific planning subzone (Tampines West), filter() is used to extract the subzone polygon, followed by st_intersection() to clip the buffers:


若要看某一个规划分区（Tampines West）内的缓冲区，先用 filter() 取出该分区多边形，再用 st_intersection() 裁切缓冲区：


mpsz_selected <- mpsz %>%
  filter(SUBZONE_N == "TAMPINES WEST")


buffer_cycling_selected <- st_intersection(buffer_cycling, mpsz_selected)













Use case 2: Number of pre-schools by planning subzone

The scenario

The authority requires a count of pre-schools in each planning subzone to support forward planning.


管理部门需要知道每个规划分区内幼儿园的数量，以支持后续规划。



The solution

st_intersects() identifies which pre-schools fall within each planning subzone, and lengths() counts them:


st_intersects() 判断哪些幼儿园落在各个规划分区内，lengths() 把个数数出来：


mpsz$`PreSch Count` <- lengths(st_intersects(mpsz, preschool))


Summary statistics of the new field:


新字段的描述统计：


summary(mpsz$`PreSch Count`)

   Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
   0.00    0.00    4.00    7.09   10.00   72.00 



The planning subzone with the most pre-schools:


幼儿园最多的规划分区：


top_n(mpsz, 1, `PreSch Count`)

Simple feature collection with 1 feature and 14 fields
Geometry type: MULTIPOLYGON
Dimension:     XY
Bounding box:  xmin: 39655.33 ymin: 35966 xmax: 42940.57 ymax: 38622.37
Projected CRS: SVY21 / Singapore TM
  OBJECTID_1 SUBZONE_NO     SUBZONE_N SUBZONE_C CA_IND PLN_AREA_N PLN_AREA_C
1        204          2 TAMPINES EAST    TMSZ02      N   TAMPINES         TM
     REGION_N REGION_C          INC_CRC     FMEL_UPD_D SHAPE_1.AREA SHAPE_1.LEN
1 EAST REGION       ER 21658EAAF84F4D8D 20160511160621      4339824    10180.62
                        geometry PreSch Count
1 MULTIPOLYGON (((42196.76 38...           72



Computing the area of each planning subzone:


计算每个规划分区的面积：


mpsz$Area <- mpsz %>%
  st_area()


Computing pre-school density (per km²):


计算幼儿园密度（每平方公里）：


mpsz <- mpsz %>%
  mutate(`PreSch Density` = `PreSch Count` / Area * 1000000)

title: Hands-on Exercise 1: Geospatial Data Science with R
text:
Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)

Plotting the distribution of pre-school density using ggplot2:


用 ggplot2 画出幼儿园密度的分布：


ggplot(data = mpsz,
       aes(x = as.numeric(`PreSch Density`))) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20,
                 color = "black",
                 fill = "light blue") +
  labs(title = "Are pre-schools evenly distributed in Singapore?",
       subtitle = "There are many planning subzones with a single pre-school, on the other hand,\nthere are seven planning subzones with at least 30 or more pre-schools",
       x = "Pre-school density (per km sq)",
       y = "Frequency")









Plotting the relationship between pre-school density and pre-school count:


画出幼儿园密度与幼儿园数量之间的关系：


ggplot(data = mpsz,
       aes(y = `PreSch Count`,
           x = as.numeric(`PreSch Density`))) +
  geom_point(color = "black",
             fill = "light blue") +
  xlim(0, 40) +
  ylim(0, 40) +
  labs(title = "Relationship between Pre-school Density and Count",
       x = "Pre-school density (per km sq)",
       y = "Pre-school count")









The scatterplot shows a general positive relationship: planning subzones with higher pre-school density also tend to have a higher absolute count of pre-schools.


散点图显示两者大体正相关：幼儿园密度较高的规划分区，其幼儿园绝对数量也往往较多。

title: Hands-on Exercise 2a: 1st Order Spatial Point Patterns Analysis
text:
Spatial Point Pattern Analysis evaluates the pattern or distribution of a set of points on a surface. The points may be the locations of events such as crimes, traffic accidents or disease onset, or of business services such as coffee shops and bus stops.
This exercise uses the spatstat package to discover the spatial point processes of childcare centres in Singapore. The questions driving the analysis are:

Are the childcare centres in Singapore randomly distributed across the country?
If not, where are the locations with a higher concentration of childcare centres?



空间点格局分析考察一组点在某个面上的格局或分布。这些点可以是犯罪、交通事故、疾病发病这类事件的位置，也可以是咖啡店、公交站这类商业服务设施的位置。
本练习用 spatstat 包探究新加坡托儿中心的空间点过程，驱动分析的问题是：

新加坡的托儿中心在全国范围内是否随机分布？
若不是，托儿中心较为集中的位置在哪里？
