title: In-class Exercise 4: Geographically Weighted Summary Statistics
text:
From sf to sp
GWmodel predates the simple features standard and its functions expect a Spatial*DataFrame from the older sp class system. as_Spatial() performs the conversion:

hunan_sp <- hunan_sf %>%
  as_Spatial()

Two objects now describe the same 88 counties. hunan_sp is the input for GWmodel, and hunan_sf remains the object tmap is given at the end. Results come back from gwss() in the order of the rows that went in, which is what makes the cbind() in the mapping sections legitimate. That join is positional rather than by key, so nothing between here and there may reorder or filter either object.

title: In-class Exercise 4: Geographically Weighted Summary Statistics
text:
Determining the Bandwidth
The bandwidth is the one parameter that decides how local “local” is, and it is chosen by optimisation rather than by hand. bw.gwr() searches for the value that minimises a chosen criterion. CV is leave-one-out cross-validation, scoring how well each location is predicted from its neighbours; AIC penalises model complexity instead.
The search is run against the intercept-only model GDPPC ~ 1, since what is wanted is a bandwidth for describing GDPPC locally, not for regressing it on anything.

Adaptive bandwidth
An adaptive bandwidth holds the number of neighbours constant and lets the radius stretch or contract, so the kernel covers as many counties in the sparse west as in the dense north-east:

bw_CV_adaptive <- bw.gwr(GDPPC ~ 1,
                         data = hunan_sp,
                         approach = "CV",
                         adaptive = TRUE,
                         kernel = "bisquare",
                         longlat = TRUE)

bw_AIC_adaptive <- bw.gwr(GDPPC ~ 1,
                          data = hunan_sp,
                          approach = "AIC",
                          adaptive = TRUE,
                          kernel = "bisquare",
                          longlat = TRUE)



Fixed bandwidth
A fixed bandwidth holds the radius constant instead, and the neighbour count varies with local density:

bw_CV_fixed <- bw.gwr(GDPPC ~ 1,
                      data = hunan_sp,
                      approach = "CV",
                      adaptive = FALSE,
                      kernel = "bisquare",
                      longlat = TRUE)

bw_AIC_fixed <- bw.gwr(GDPPC ~ 1,
                       data = hunan_sp,
                       approach = "AIC",
                       adaptive = FALSE,
                       kernel = "bisquare",
                       longlat = TRUE)


tibble(Bandwidth = c("Adaptive", "Adaptive", "Fixed", "Fixed"),
       Criterion = c("CV", "AIC", "CV", "AIC"),
       Value = c(bw_CV_adaptive, bw_AIC_adaptive,
                 bw_CV_fixed, bw_AIC_fixed),
       Unit = c("nearest neighbours", "nearest neighbours", "km", "km")) %>%
  kable(digits = 2)




Bandwidth
Criterion
Value
Unit




Adaptive
CV
22.00
nearest neighbours


Adaptive
AIC
22.00
nearest neighbours


Fixed
CV
76.29
km


Fixed
AIC
160.55
km





The two criteria behave differently depending on which kind of bandwidth they are searching over.
On the adaptive side, CV and AIC both settle on 22 nearest neighbours. Agreement between two criteria that optimise different things is the strongest evidence available here that 22 is a feature of the data rather than an artefact of the search. It amounts to a quarter of the province, which is a defensible reading of “local”.
On the fixed side, CV returns 76.3 km and AIC returns 160.6 km, more than double. That disagreement is diagnostic rather than a failure of either method. Hunan’s counties vary greatly in area, so a single radius means a different sample size everywhere it is placed. CV, scored point by point, chases the radius that fits the densest parts, while AIC tolerates a much broader kernel for the province as a whole. When a fixed bandwidth makes the two criteria disagree this sharply and an adaptive one makes them agree exactly, the adaptive specification is the one the data supports.

title: In-class Exercise 4: Geographically Weighted Summary Statistics
text:
Geographically Weighted Summary Statistics
gwss() computes the summary statistics at every location, each one weighted by the kernel. Setting quantile = TRUE adds the robust family, meaning the local median, interquartile range and quantile imbalance, alongside the moment-based statistics:

gwstat <- gwss(data = hunan_sp,
               vars = "GDPPC",
               bw = bw_AIC_adaptive,
               kernel = "bisquare",
               quantile = TRUE,
               adaptive = TRUE,
               longlat = TRUE)


names(as.data.frame(gwstat$SDF))

[1] "GDPPC_LM"     "GDPPC_LSD"    "GDPPC_LVar"   "GDPPC_LSKe"   "GDPPC_LCV"   
[6] "GDPPC_Median" "GDPPC_IQR"    "GDPPC_QI"    


Eight surfaces for a single variable: local mean, standard deviation, variance, skewness and coefficient of variation from the moment-based side, then median, IQR and quantile imbalance from the robust side. Each is a vector of 88 values, one per county, rather than a single number.

Preparing the output
gwss() returns its results in the SDF slot as a Spatial*DataFrame. Extracting the data table and binding it column-wise to hunan_sf restores a mappable sf object:

gwstat_df <- as.data.frame(gwstat$SDF)

hunan_gstat <- cbind(hunan_sf, gwstat_df)



Visualising the geographically weighted mean

tm_shape(hunan_gstat) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "GDPPC_LM",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 5,
                values = "brewer.blues"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(
                title = "Local mean")) +
  tm_borders(col = "grey70", lwd = 0.4) +
  tm_title("Geographically weighted mean of GDPPC, 22 nearest neighbours",
           size = 1.1)










The local mean against the global one

tibble(Statistic = c("Global mean", "Local mean, minimum", "Local mean, maximum",
                     "Global median", "Local median, minimum", "Local median, maximum"),
       GDPPC = c(mean(hunan_sf$GDPPC),
                 min(hunan_gstat$GDPPC_LM), max(hunan_gstat$GDPPC_LM),
                 median(hunan_sf$GDPPC),
                 min(hunan_gstat$GDPPC_Median), max(hunan_gstat$GDPPC_Median))) %>%
  kable(digits = 0, format.args = list(big.mark = ","))




Statistic
GDPPC




Global mean
24,405


Local mean, minimum
13,689


Local mean, maximum
49,006


Global median
20,433


Local median, minimum
11,580


Local median, maximum
41,491





Conventional analysis would report one number for Hunan, a mean GDPPC of 24,405 yuan. The geographically weighted mean replaces it with 88, running from 13,689 around Wugang in Shaoyang to 49,006 at Changsha, a 3.6-fold spread the single figure conceals entirely. This is spatial non-stationarity made measurable: the provincial average describes nowhere in particular, because the north-east corridor and the south-western uplands are not samples from the same population.
The smoothing is substantial and deliberate. Raw GDPPC ranges from 8,497 to 88,656, so the local mean surface compresses a 10-fold spread into a 3.6-fold one. What survives that compression is the regional signal, and what is removed is the county-level idiosyncrasy a spatial lag would have retained.


Robust statistics: local mean against local median
The moment-based and robust families are computed from the same kernel, so comparing them isolates the effect of the outliers rather than the effect of location:

lm_map <- tm_shape(hunan_gstat) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "GDPPC_LM",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile", n = 5, values = "brewer.blues"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Local mean")) +
  tm_borders(col = "grey70", lwd = 0.4) +
  tm_title("Local mean", size = 1.0)

med_map <- tm_shape(hunan_gstat) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "GDPPC_Median",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile", n = 5, values = "brewer.blues"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Local median")) +
  tm_borders(col = "grey70", lwd = 0.4) +
  tm_title("Local median", size = 1.0)

tmap_arrange(lm_map, med_map, asp = 1, ncol = 2)









summary(hunan_gstat$GDPPC_LM / hunan_gstat$GDPPC_Median)

   Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
 0.9186  1.0918  1.1473  1.1737  1.2298  1.6355 


The two maps share a pattern but not a level. The ratio of local mean to local median exceeds 1 almost everywhere, reaching 1.64. In the neighbourhoods around Changsha the weighted mean sits 64% above the weighted median, because a handful of very rich counties pull it upward while the median ignores them by construction.
That gap is itself the finding. Where mean and median agree, the local distribution is symmetric and either statistic describes the neighbourhood honestly. Where they diverge this far, the neighbourhood contains counties unlike their surroundings, and the mean surface is reporting their influence rather than the typical county. The robust surface is the more defensible description of the north-east, and the divergence between the two is more informative than either alone.

title: In-class Exercise 4: Geographically Weighted Summary Statistics
text:
The Effect of the Bandwidth
Repeating the computation under the fixed bandwidth shows what the choice made in the previous section actually bought:

gwstat_fixed <- gwss(data = hunan_sp,
                     vars = "GDPPC",
                     bw = bw_AIC_fixed,
                     kernel = "bisquare",
                     adaptive = FALSE,
                     quantile = FALSE,
                     longlat = TRUE)

hunan_gstat_fixed <- cbind(hunan_sf, as.data.frame(gwstat_fixed$SDF))


adaptive_map <- tm_shape(hunan_gstat) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "GDPPC_LM",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile", n = 5, values = "brewer.blues"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Local mean")) +
  tm_borders(col = "grey70", lwd = 0.4) +
  tm_title("Adaptive, 22 neighbours", size = 1.0)

fixed_map <- tm_shape(hunan_gstat_fixed) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "GDPPC_LM",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile", n = 5, values = "brewer.blues"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Local mean")) +
  tm_borders(col = "grey70", lwd = 0.4) +
  tm_title("Fixed, 160.6 km", size = 1.0)

tmap_arrange(adaptive_map, fixed_map, asp = 1, ncol = 2)








The 160.6 km fixed kernel produces a local mean surface spanning 14,259 to 47,833, close to the adaptive result but reached for a different reason. A fixed radius over Hunan’s uneven county sizes draws on roughly thirty counties in the compact north-east and barely a dozen in the large western ones, so the western estimates rest on fewest observations exactly where the counties are largest. The CV bandwidth of 76.3 km makes this visible: at that radius the local mean runs from 10,135 to 72,045, a surface so close to the raw data that it has stopped summarising anything.
The adaptive kernel removes that dependence by construction, which is why it is the appropriate specification for administrative areas of unequal size, the usual case.

title: In-class Exercise 4: Geographically Weighted Summary Statistics
text:
Geographically Weighted Correlation
The same kernel machinery applies to a statistic computed from two variables. The question is whether the relationship between GDP per capita and gross industrial output holds with equal strength across the province.

The conventional analysis first
ggscatterstats() gives the global answer, one coefficient for all 88 counties, with its test:

ggscatterstats(data = hunan_sf %>% st_drop_geometry(),
               x = GIO,
               y = GDPPC,
               xlab = "Gross Industrial Output",
               ylab = "GDP per capita",
               label.var = County,
               label.expression = GIO > 20000 & GDPPC > 50000,
               point.label.args = list(alpha = 0.7, size = 4, color = "grey50"),
               xfill = "#CC79A7",
               yfill = "#009E73",
               title = "Relationship between GDP per capita and Gross Industrial Output")








Pearson’s r = 0.77 and clearly significant, a strong positive relationship, and the analysis would conventionally stop there.


Determining the bandwidth
The bandwidth for a two-variable statistic is selected from the corresponding regression, so the formula now carries GIO on the right-hand side:

bw_corr <- bw.gwr(GDPPC ~ GIO,
                  data = hunan_sp,
                  approach = "AICc",
                  adaptive = TRUE)


bw_corr

[1] 84




Computing the correlation surface

gwstats_corr <- gwss(hunan_sp,
                     vars = c("GDPPC", "GIO"),
                     bw = bw_corr,
                     kernel = "bisquare",
                     adaptive = TRUE,
                     longlat = TRUE)

Two variables produce the five univariate surfaces twice over, followed by three bivariate ones. They are selected by name rather than by column position, so that a change of quantile or of vars cannot silently shift the wrong columns into the map:

gwcorr_df <- as.data.frame(gwstats_corr$SDF) %>%
  select(gwCorr = Corr_GDPPC.GIO,
         gwSpearman = Spearman_rho_GDPPC.GIO)

hunan_corr <- cbind(hunan_sf, gwcorr_df)



Visualising the local Spearman coefficient

tm_shape(hunan_corr) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "gwSpearman",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 5,
                values = "brewer.blues"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(
                title = "Local Spearman's rho")) +
  tm_borders(col = "grey70", lwd = 0.4) +
  tm_title("Geographically weighted correlation, GDPPC and GIO", size = 1.1)









tibble(Coefficient = c("Pearson", "Spearman"),
       Global = c(cor(hunan_sf$GDPPC, hunan_sf$GIO),
                  cor(hunan_sf$GDPPC, hunan_sf$GIO, method = "spearman")),
       `Local minimum` = c(min(hunan_corr$gwCorr), min(hunan_corr$gwSpearman)),
       `Local maximum` = c(max(hunan_corr$gwCorr), max(hunan_corr$gwSpearman))) %>%
  kable(digits = 3)




Coefficient
Global
Local minimum
Local maximum




Pearson
0.765
0.682
0.761


Spearman
0.732
0.579
0.733











WarningThe bandwidth has flattened the surface



The selected bandwidth is 84 of 88 counties. Every local correlation is therefore computed from almost the entire province, and the result is what that implies: local Pearson spans 0.682 to 0.761 around a global 0.765, and local Spearman 0.579 to 0.733 around a global 0.732. The map above is close to a constant.
This is not a null finding about Hunan. It is a consequence of where the bandwidth came from. bw.gwr() selected 84 as the bandwidth at which a regression of GDPPC on GIO is best supported, and a near-global bandwidth is the correct answer to that question when the relationship is genuinely strong everywhere. But the statistic being mapped is not that regression, and a criterion chosen for one is not automatically valid for the other.


Recomputing on the bandwidth the data itself supported earlier, the 22 neighbours on which CV and AIC agreed, asks the intended question:

gwstats_local <- gwss(hunan_sp,
                      vars = c("GDPPC", "GIO"),
                      bw = bw_AIC_adaptive,
                      kernel = "bisquare",
                      adaptive = TRUE,
                      longlat = TRUE)

hunan_corr22 <- cbind(hunan_sf,
                      as.data.frame(gwstats_local$SDF) %>%
                        select(gwCorr = Corr_GDPPC.GIO,
                               gwSpearman = Spearman_rho_GDPPC.GIO))


corr84 <- tm_shape(hunan_corr) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "gwCorr",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "fixed",
                breaks = c(0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1),
                values = "brewer.blues"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Local r")) +
  tm_borders(col = "grey70", lwd = 0.4) +
  tm_title("bw = 84 neighbours", size = 1.0)

corr22 <- tm_shape(hunan_corr22) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "gwCorr",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "fixed",
                breaks = c(0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1),
                values = "brewer.blues"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Local r")) +
  tm_borders(col = "grey70", lwd = 0.4) +
  tm_title("bw = 22 neighbours", size = 1.0)

tmap_arrange(corr84, corr22, asp = 1, ncol = 2)









summary(hunan_corr22$gwCorr)

   Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
 0.1768  0.5631  0.6583  0.6351  0.7507  0.8744 


On the same colour scale the left map is one shade and the right map is four. At 22 neighbours the local Pearson correlation runs from 0.18 to 0.87, and local Spearman from 0.12 to 0.92. The relationship the global coefficient reports as uniformly strong is strong in some parts of Hunan and close to absent in others.
Both maps are correct at their own bandwidth, and they answer different questions. The left one asks whether industrial output predicts GDP per capita across Hunan, and the answer is yes, consistently. The right one asks whether a county’s prosperity tracks its industry among its own neighbours, and the answer is that it depends where the county is. In the industrial north-east the two move together closely, while in the west a county’s GDP per capita owes comparatively little to its industrial output.
The conclusion concerns method rather than Hunan. Bandwidth is not a nuisance parameter to be delegated to a selection routine. It declares the scale at which a question is being asked, and a bandwidth optimised for one statistic can suppress precisely the variation another statistic exists to reveal.

title: In-class Exercise 7: Floating Catchment Methods for Accessibility
text:
Hands-on Exercise 7 modelled accessibility to 120 eldercare centres from a 3,125-cell hexagon grid, using a pre-computed road-network distance matrix and three measures from SpatialAcc: the Hansen potential model, KD2SFCA and SAM. The data import, the reprojection to SVY21, the reshaping of the 375,000-row origin-destination table into a 3,125 × 120 matrix, and all three of those measures are assumed here and are not taught again.
What the hands-on exercise did not cover is the floating catchment family as a family. KD2SFCA appeared there as one formula among three. Lesson 7 presents it as one member of a sequence of refinements to the two-step floating catchment area method, each answering a criticism of the one before. This exercise works through that sequence with the catchment package:

the plain 2SFCA, with a hard 5 km catchment and no distance decay inside it,
the enhanced 2SFCA (E2SFCA), which replaces the flat catchment with stepped distance bands,
the kernel density 2SFCA (KD2SFCA), which replaces the steps with a continuous Gaussian kernel,
the three-step FCA (3SFCA), which adds a selection weight so that demand is not counted in full at every centre it can reach, and
the modified 2SFCA (M2SFCA), which applies distance decay a second time so that a centre that is reachable only from far away does not hand out its whole capacity.

Before any of them, the simplest measure of all is computed with the accessibility package: the road distance from each hexagon to its nearest centre. It is the baseline that every ratio measure below is read against.


Hands-on 练习 7 以 3,125 个六边形网格为需求、120 个乐龄中心为供给，借助一份预先算好的路网距离矩阵，用 SpatialAcc 的三种测度建模可达性：Hansen 潜能模型、KD2SFCA 与 SAM。数据导入、重投影到 SVY21、把 375,000 行起讫表整形为 3,125 × 120 的矩阵，以及这三种测度本身，在此都视为已知，不再重复讲解。
Hands-on 练习没有涉及的，是把移动搜寻域方法当作一个「家族」来看。KD2SFCA 在那里只是三个公式之一；第 7 讲则把它放在两步移动搜寻域法的一连串改进之中，每一步都回应前一步受到的批评。本练习用 catchment 包把这串改进逐一走一遍：

基础的 2SFCA：5 km 的硬性搜寻域，域内不做距离衰减；
增强型 2SFCA（E2SFCA）：把平坦的搜寻域换成分段的距离带；
核密度 2SFCA（KD2SFCA）：把分段换成连续的高斯核；
三步移动搜寻域法（3SFCA）：加入选择权重，使需求不会在它能到达的每一个中心都被全额计数；
修正型 2SFCA（M2SFCA）：再施加一次距离衰减，使一个只能从远处到达的中心不会把全部容量分发出去。

在这些之前，先用 accessibility 包计算最简单的测度：每个六边形到最近中心的路网距离。下文所有比值型测度都以它为参照来解读。

text:
Getting Started

catchment is not on CRAN and is installed from GitHub. The chunk is shown but not run when the page is rendered, since installing a package is a one-off step rather than part of the analysis:


catchment 不在 CRAN 上，需要从 GitHub 安装。这一代码块只展示、渲染时不执行，因为安装包是一次性的步骤，不属于分析本身：


remotes::install_github("uva-bi-sdad/catchment")


pacman::p_load(sf, tidyverse, tmap, accessibility, catchment)








Package
Role




sf
Importing and reprojecting the hexagon and eldercare layers


tidyverse
Reshaping the origin-destination table and joining results


tmap
Mapping each measure


accessibility
cost_to_closest(), the distance to the nearest facility


catchment
catchment_ratio() and catchment_weight(), the whole floating catchment family




SpatialAcc, which carried the hands-on exercise, is not loaded. Every floating catchment variant below is a call to one function, catchment_ratio(), with a different weighting argument, and that is what makes it practical to set the variants side by side.


Hands-on 练习所依赖的 SpatialAcc 这里不加载。下面每一种移动搜寻域变体都只是对同一个函数 catchment_ratio() 的调用，区别只在权重参数，这正是把几种变体并排比较变得可行的原因。


tmap_mode("plot")

title: In-class Exercise 7: Floating Catchment Methods for Accessibility
section: Inputs Carried Over from Hands-on Exercise 7
text:
Inputs Carried Over from Hands-on Exercise 7

Importing the two layers, reprojecting them to EPSG:3414, attaching the placeholder capacity and demand fields, and pivoting the distance table into a matrix whose rows follow the hexagons and whose columns follow the eldercare centres were all explained in Hands-on Exercise 7. The code is repeated only so that this document runs on its own. The subzone boundary layer is not imported: no step below summarises by planning region, so it would be read and never used.


导入两个图层、重投影到 EPSG:3414、加上占位用的 capacity 与 demand 字段，以及把距离表透视成「行对应六边形、列对应乐龄中心」的矩阵，这些都已在 Hands-on 练习 7 中讲过。这里重复代码只是为了让本文档可以独立运行。分区边界图层没有导入：下文没有任何一步按规划区汇总，导入它只会读进来而从不使用。


hexagons <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial",
                    layer = "hexagons", quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 3414) %>%
  select(fid) %>%
  mutate(demand = 100)

eldercare <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial",
                     layer = "ELDERCARE", quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 3414) %>%
  select(fid) %>%
  mutate(capacity = 100)

ODMatrix <- read_csv("data/aspatial/OD_Matrix.csv",
                     show_col_types = FALSE)

distmat_km <- ODMatrix %>%
  select(origin_id, destination_id, total_cost) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = destination_id,
              values_from = total_cost) %>%
  arrange(origin_id) %>%
  select(all_of(as.character(eldercare$fid))) %>%
  as.matrix() / 1000

stopifnot(nrow(distmat_km) == nrow(hexagons),
          ncol(distmat_km) == nrow(eldercare),
          !is.unsorted(hexagons$fid))
dim(distmat_km)

[1] 3125  120



The stopifnot() line carries the one assumption every catchment_ratio() call below depends on: the i-th row of the matrix is the i-th hexagon and the j-th column is the j-th centre. The function matches by position, not by identifier, so a matrix in a different order would run without complaint and return the wrong answer. Selecting the columns by eldercare$fid makes the column order explicit rather than relying on how pivot_wider() happens to sort them.
Every hexagon has a demand of 100 and every centre a capacity of 100. Those are placeholders, and they matter for reading every number below: with uniform supply and uniform demand, each measure describes the geometry of the road network and the locations of the centres, and nothing about how many older residents live where or how large each centre is.


stopifnot() 这一行承载了下文每一次 catchment_ratio() 调用所依赖的前提：矩阵第 i 行就是第 i 个六边形，第 j 列就是第 j 个中心。该函数按位置而非按编号匹配，顺序不对的矩阵照样能跑，只是给出错误答案。按 eldercare$fid 选列，是把列顺序写明，而不是依赖 pivot_wider() 恰好怎样排序。
每个六边形的需求都是 100，每个中心的容量也都是 100。这些是占位值，对解读下文所有数字都很关键：供给与需求都均匀时，每一种测度描述的都只是路网的几何与中心的位置，而不涉及老年居民实际住在哪里、各中心实际有多大。

title: In-class Exercise 7: Floating Catchment Methods for Accessibility
section: Distance to the Nearest Eldercare Centre
text:
Distance to the Nearest Eldercare Centre

Computing the closest distance

cost_to_closest() of accessibility takes the origin-destination table in long form, with columns named from_id, to_id and the cost, plus a land-use table that says how many opportunities sit at each destination:


accessibility 的 cost_to_closest() 接受长表形式的起讫数据，列名为 from_id、to_id 与成本列，另需一张土地利用表，说明每个目的地有多少机会（opportunity）：


ODMatrix_tidied <- ODMatrix %>%
  select(from_id = origin_id,
         to_id = destination_id,
         dist = total_cost)

eldercare_lu <- eldercare %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  rename(id = fid)

dist2closest <- cost_to_closest(
  travel_matrix = ODMatrix_tidied,
  land_use_data = eldercare_lu,
  opportunity = "capacity",
  travel_cost = "dist",
  n = 1)


The land-use table is the eldercare layer, because the opportunities are at the destinations and the destinations are the centres. The lesson’s version of this call passes the hexagons instead, with demand as the opportunity column. It returns the same distances on this dataset, and the reason is a coincidence rather than a property of the method:


土地利用表用的是乐龄中心图层，因为机会位于目的地，而目的地就是中心。课上版本的这一调用传入的是六边形图层，并把 demand 当作机会列。它在这份数据上给出的距离完全相同，但原因是巧合，而不是方法本身如此：


dist_via_hexagons <- cost_to_closest(
  travel_matrix = ODMatrix_tidied,
  land_use_data = hexagons %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% rename(id = fid),
  opportunity = "demand",
  travel_cost = "dist",
  n = 1)

c(centre_ids_also_hexagon_ids = sum(eldercare$fid %in% hexagons$fid),
  same_result = identical(arrange(dist_via_hexagons, id)$dist,
                          arrange(dist2closest, id)$dist))

centre_ids_also_hexagon_ids                 same_result 
                        120                           1 



The function looks each to_id up in the id column of whatever land-use table it is given. The centres are numbered 1 to 133 and the hexagons 1 to 3,125, so every centre’s identifier also happens to be a hexagon’s, and every hexagon carries a demand of 100. Each lookup therefore lands on a non-zero value by accident. With real demand figures, where some hexagons hold no older residents, the lookup would treat the centres sharing those identifiers as having no places, and silently skip them.
As an independent check, the nearest distance is simply the row minimum of the long table:


该函数会到所给土地利用表的 id 列里查找每一个 to_id。中心编号为 1 到 133，六边形编号为 1 到 3,125，所以每个中心的编号恰好也是某个六边形的编号，而每个六边形的需求都是 100，于是每次查找都碰巧落在一个非零值上。换成真实需求数据，只要有些六边形没有老年居民，与之同号的中心就会被当成没有名额，悄无声息地被跳过。
作为独立核对，最近距离其实就是长表按起点取最小值：


brute_force <- ODMatrix_tidied %>%
  group_by(from_id) %>%
  summarise(dist = min(dist))

all.equal(arrange(dist2closest, id)$dist, brute_force$dist)

[1] TRUE



hex_acc <- hexagons %>%
  left_join(dist2closest, by = c("fid" = "id")) %>%
  rename(dist2closest = dist)

summary(hex_acc$dist2closest)

    Min.  1st Qu.   Median     Mean  3rd Qu.     Max. 
   36.93  2183.12  4064.01  6104.84  8061.08 32450.08 

c(over_2km = sum(hex_acc$dist2closest > 2000),
  over_5km = sum(hex_acc$dist2closest > 5000))

over_2km over_5km 
    2440     1281 



The median hexagon is 4.06 km by road from its nearest centre, and the most remote is 32.5 km away, a figure that turns out below to be an artefact of the distance matrix. 2,440 of the 3,125 hexagons, 78 per cent, are more than 2 km from any centre, and 1,281, 41 per cent, are more than 5 km. That second count reappears below.


中位数六边形到最近中心的路网距离为 4.06 km，最偏远的达 32.5 km；下文会看到，这个数字其实是距离矩阵的伪影。3,125 个六边形中有 2,440 个（78%）距任何中心都超过 2 km，有 1,281 个（41%）超过 5 km。后一个数字下文还会再出现。



Mapping the closest distance

Every map in this exercise is drawn the same way, so the layout is written once as a function. The class breaks are computed inside it rather than left to style = "quantile", for two reasons that the later sections make concrete: several measures have a large block of values tied at exactly zero, which collapses the lower decile breaks into one, and one measure has values so small that default legend labels print them as zero or as a negative number. zero_class = TRUE gives the zeros a class of their own and splits the positive values into seven quantile classes; otherwise the values are split into deciles. fmt() writes each break to two significant figures, in scientific notation when it is very small:


本练习的每张地图画法相同，因此把版式写成一个函数。分级断点在函数内部计算，而不是交给 style = "quantile"，原因有二，后文会具体看到：有几种测度存在大量恰为零的并列值，会让较低的几个十分位断点挤成一个；还有一种测度的取值小到默认图例会把它印成零甚至负数。zero_class = TRUE 时零值单独成一类，正值再按分位数分七类；否则按十分位分级。fmt() 把每个断点写成两位有效数字，数值极小时改用科学计数法：


mapex <- st_bbox(hexagons)

fmt <- function(x) {
  ifelse(x >= 100, formatC(round(x), format = "d", big.mark = ","),
  ifelse(x == 0 | x >= 1e-3, formatC(signif(x, 2), format = "fg", digits = 2),
         formatC(x, format = "e", digits = 1)))
}

acc_map <- function(data, var, title, zero_class = FALSE,
                    palette = "brewer.blues") {
  x <- data[[var]]
  if (zero_class) {
    breaks <- unique(c(0, quantile(x[x > 0], probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = 8))))
    labels <- c("0 (unserved)",
                paste(fmt(head(breaks[-1], -1)), "to", fmt(breaks[-(1:2)])))
  } else {
    breaks <- unique(quantile(x, probs = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)))
    labels <- paste(fmt(head(breaks, -1)), "to", fmt(breaks[-1]))
  }
  fill_scale <- tm_scale_intervals(breaks = breaks, labels = labels,
                                   values = palette)
  tm_shape(data, bbox = mapex) +
    tm_polygons(fill = var,
                col = NULL,
                fill.scale = fill_scale,
                fill.legend = tm_legend(title = var)) +
    tm_shape(eldercare) +
    tm_dots(size = 0.15, fill = "red", col = "black") +
    tm_title(title) +
    tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
    tm_compass(type = "8star", size = 2) +
    tm_scalebar() +
    tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)
}


acc_map(hex_acc, "dist2closest",
        "Road distance to the nearest eldercare centre (m)",
        palette = "-brewer.blues")









The palette is reversed here, so that dark means close, which keeps dark meaning good on every map in the exercise. Distance is short around each cluster of centres: the dense band in the south, Jurong in the west, Woodlands and Yishun in the north, and Tampines and Pasir Ris in the east. It is long in the Central Catchment Nature Reserve, which shows as a pale hole in the middle of the island, and across the far west and north-west, the eastern tip at Changi, and the southern offshore islands, which make up the top decile, partly for a reason the 2SFCA section uncovers.


这里把配色反转，让深色表示近，从而在本练习所有地图上深色都表示好。各个中心聚集处周围距离都短：南部的密集带、西部的裕廊、北部的兀兰与义顺，以及东部的淡滨尼与巴西立。距离长的地方是中央集水区自然保护区，它在岛中央显出一个浅色的空洞；还有最西部与西北部、东端的樟宜，以及南部离岸岛屿，它们构成最高的十分位，其中部分原因要到 2SFCA 一节才揭示。

title: In-class Exercise 7: Floating Catchment Methods for Accessibility
text:
Two-Step Floating Catchment Area (2SFCA)

The nearest-facility distance ignores two things: a hexagon near several centres is better served than one near a single centre, and a centre shared by many hexagons is worth less to each of them. 2SFCA accounts for both in two steps. First, each centre’s capacity is divided by the total demand within its catchment, giving a supply-to-demand ratio for the centre. Second, each hexagon sums the ratios of every centre within its catchment.


最近设施距离忽略了两件事：靠近多个中心的六边形比只靠近一个的服务更好；被许多六边形共享的中心，对每个六边形的价值更低。2SFCA 分两步同时考虑二者。第一步，把每个中心的容量除以其搜寻域内的总需求，得到该中心的供需比；第二步，每个六边形把自身搜寻域内所有中心的供需比相加。


step_weights <- list(c(5, .01), c(4, .05), c(3, .1), c(2, .4), c(1, 1))

hex_acc <- hex_acc %>%
  mutate(`2SFCA` = as.numeric(catchment_ratio(
    consumers = demand,
    providers = eldercare$capacity,
    cost = distmat_km,
    max_cost = 5)))

summary(hex_acc$`2SFCA`)

   Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
0.00000 0.00000 0.02073 0.03840 0.06007 0.93136 



max_cost = 5 sets the catchment at 5 km of road distance, and inside it every centre counts in full. The step weights are defined here for use in the sections that follow.
The result is in places per unit of demand. Its mean is 0.0384, which is exactly the total capacity of 12,000 divided by the total demand of 312,500, and that is not a coincidence: within the catchment, 2SFCA redistributes the supply rather than creating or losing any. The check in the comparison section confirms this for each variant.


max_cost = 5 把搜寻域设为 5 km 路网距离，域内每个中心都按全额计入。分段权重在此先行定义，供后续各节使用。
结果的单位是「每单位需求的名额」。其均值为 0.0384，正好等于总容量 12,000 除以总需求 312,500，这并非巧合：在搜寻域内，2SFCA 只是重新分配供给，既不凭空增加也不损失。比较一节的核对会对每种变体验证这一点。


c(zero_2SFCA = sum(hex_acc$`2SFCA` == 0),
  same_cells_as_over_5km = identical(which(hex_acc$`2SFCA` == 0),
                                     which(hex_acc$dist2closest > 5000)))

            zero_2SFCA same_cells_as_over_5km 
                  1281                      1 



1,281 hexagons score exactly zero, and they are precisely the 1,281 hexagons that are more than 5 km from their nearest centre. That is the hard catchment at work: a hexagon 4.9 km from a centre gets that centre’s full ratio, and one at 5.1 km gets nothing.
Those zeros are also why the map below uses zero_class = TRUE. With 41 per cent of the values tied at zero, the first four decile breaks would all coincide.


有 1,281 个六边形恰好为零，它们正是距最近中心超过 5 km 的那 1,281 个。这就是硬性搜寻域的效果：距某中心 4.9 km 的六边形得到该中心的全部比值，5.1 km 的则一无所得。
这些零值也是下图使用 zero_class = TRUE 的原因：41% 的取值并列为零，前四个十分位断点会全部重合。


acc_map(hex_acc, "2SFCA", "2SFCA accessibility, 5 km catchment",
        zero_class = TRUE)









The palest class is the unserved 41 per cent. Among the served hexagons, the highest ratios are in the south and the centre-east, where a hexagon’s 5 km catchment reaches twenty or more centres and their ratios add up. The north shows what the ratio adds to the distance map. Hexagons around Woodlands and Yishun sit close to a centre and were dark on the previous map, but they score in the middle classes here, because their few nearby centres are each shared by a large surrounding population.


最浅的一类就是未获服务的那 41%。在获得服务的六边形中，比值最高的在南部与中东部：那里一个六边形 5 km 的搜寻域能覆盖二十个以上的中心，它们的比值叠加起来。北部则显示了比值相对于距离地图多出的信息：兀兰与义顺一带的六边形离中心很近，在上一张图中颜色很深，但在这里只落在中间几类，因为附近为数不多的中心各自要被周围大量人口共享。


Hexagons with the same distance to every centre

The best-served hexagons in the south reach a median of 22 centres within 5 km. One hexagon, west of the centre of the island and surrounded by paler cells, is darker than any of them, and the summary above shows why it is worth looking at: the maximum 2SFCA score of 0.931 is more than four times the next highest. It turns out to be one of a group, found by checking the origin-destination table for origins whose cost is the same to every destination:


南部服务最好的六边形，5 km 内能覆盖的中心中位数为 22 个。有一个六边形位于岛中部偏西、四周都是较浅的网格，却比它们都深；上面的汇总也说明它值得一看：2SFCA 的最大值 0.931 是第二高值的四倍多。检查起讫表中「到每个目的地成本都相同」的起点，会发现它属于一整组：


constant_rows <- ODMatrix %>%
  group_by(origin_id) %>%
  summarise(distinct_costs = n_distinct(total_cost),
            distinct_network_costs = n_distinct(network_cost),
            total_cost = first(total_cost)) %>%
  filter(distinct_costs == 1)

constant_rows %>%
  summarise(hexagons = n(),
            network_cost_also_constant = all(distinct_network_costs == 1),
            within_5km = sum(total_cost < 5000),
            min_cost = min(total_cost),
            max_cost = max(total_cost))

# A tibble: 1 × 5
  hexagons network_cost_also_constant within_5km min_cost max_cost
     <int> <lgl>                           <int>    <dbl>    <dbl>
1      159 TRUE                                1    4974.   32450.



159 hexagons, 5.1 per cent of the grid, have one identical road distance to all 120 centres, and in every case the network component of the cost is identical too. No real position on a road network is equidistant from 120 destinations spread across an island. These rows are routing artefacts in the supplied matrix: for each of these origins a single network path length was produced and copied to every destination.
Only one of them falls inside the 5 km catchment. Hexagon 1067 sits at exactly 4,974 m from every centre, so 2SFCA adds up the ratios of all 120 centres for this one cell, and it becomes the best-served hexagon in Singapore:


有 159 个六边形、即 5.1% 的网格，到全部 120 个中心的路网距离完全相同，而且每一个的路网成本分量也都相同。路网上没有任何真实位置会与散布全岛的 120 个目的地等距。这些行是所给矩阵中的路径计算伪影：对这些起点，只算出了一个路网路径长度，然后复制给了每一个目的地。
其中只有一个落在 5 km 搜寻域之内。1067 号六边形到每个中心都恰好是 4,974 m，于是 2SFCA 把全部 120 个中心的比值都加到这一个网格上，它就成了全新加坡服务最好的六边形：


hex_acc %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(rank_2SFCA = rank(-`2SFCA`, ties.method = "min")) %>%
  filter(fid == 1067) %>%
  select(fid, dist2closest, `2SFCA`, rank_2SFCA)

   fid dist2closest     2SFCA rank_2SFCA
1 1067      4973.89 0.9313638          1



It ranks first under 2SFCA and nowhere near first under any method with distance decay, because a weight that falls with distance gives 120 centres at 4,974 m very little each. Its rank is 335 under E2SFCA, 149 under KD2SFCA, 1,479 under 3SFCA and 1,124 under M2SFCA. The flat catchment is what turns one bad row into the top of the map.
The other 158 are all more than 5 km away, so every measure with a catchment scores them zero whatever the true distance is. The measure they do distort is the nearest-facility distance, whose most remote cells they dominate:


它在 2SFCA 下排第一，而在任何带距离衰减的方法下都远非第一，因为随距离递减的权重给 4,974 m 处的 120 个中心每个都只有很小的分量。它在 E2SFCA 下排第 335，KD2SFCA 下第 149，3SFCA 下第 1,479，M2SFCA 下第 1,124。正是平坦的搜寻域把一行坏数据变成了地图上的最高点。
其余 158 个都在 5 km 以外，所以凡是有搜寻域的测度，不论真实距离是多少都给它们零分。真正被它们扭曲的是最近设施距离，最偏远的那些网格大多就是它们：


top_decile <- hex_acc$fid[hex_acc$dist2closest >=
                            quantile(hex_acc$dist2closest, 0.9)]

c(top_decile_hexagons = length(top_decile),
  of_which_constant_rows = sum(top_decile %in% constant_rows$origin_id),
  most_remote_is_constant_row =
    hex_acc$fid[which.max(hex_acc$dist2closest)] %in% constant_rows$origin_id)

        top_decile_hexagons      of_which_constant_rows 
                        313                         112 
most_remote_is_constant_row 
                          1 



112 of the 313 hexagons in the top decile of distance have a constant row, and so does the single most remote one, the 32.5 km cell reported earlier. That figure is the copied path length of a failed route, not a measured distance to the nearest centre. The outer classes of the distance map are therefore partly a map of where the routing failed. All 159 hexagons are kept in the sections that follow, because removing them would change the grid that every method is compared on, but neither the 32.5 km maximum nor hexagon 1067’s 2SFCA score should be reported as a result.


距离最高十分位的 313 个六边形中，有 112 个属于常数行，最偏远的那一个、即前文报告的 32.5 km 网格也是。这个数字是一条失败路径被复制的长度，而不是测得的到最近中心的距离。因此距离地图外围几类，部分其实是一张「路径计算在哪里失败」的地图。后续各节保留全部 159 个六边形，因为删去它们会改变所有方法赖以比较的网格；但无论是 32.5 km 的最大值，还是 1067 号六边形的 2SFCA 得分，都不应作为结果报告。

title: In-class Exercise 7: Floating Catchment Methods for Accessibility
text:
Enhanced 2SFCA (E2SFCA)

The first criticism of 2SFCA is that it treats a centre 500 m away and one 4.9 km away as equally useful. E2SFCA keeps the 5 km outer limit and divides the catchment into distance bands with falling weights. With step_weights as defined above, a centre within 1 km counts in full, 1 to 2 km at 0.4, 2 to 3 km at 0.1, 3 to 4 km at 0.05, and 4 to 5 km at 0.01. The same weights are applied in both steps, to the demand a centre sees and to the supply a hexagon sees.


对 2SFCA 的第一项批评是：它把 500 m 外的中心与 4.9 km 外的中心视为同样有用。E2SFCA 保留 5 km 的外边界，但把搜寻域划成权重递减的距离带。按上面定义的 step_weights，1 km 内的中心全额计入，1–2 km 计 0.4，2–3 km 计 0.1，3–4 km 计 0.05，4–5 km 计 0.01。两步使用同一套权重，既作用于中心看到的需求，也作用于六边形看到的供给。


hex_acc <- hex_acc %>%
  mutate(E2SFCA = as.numeric(catchment_ratio(
    consumers = demand,
    providers = eldercare$capacity,
    cost = distmat_km,
    weight = step_weights)))

summary(hex_acc$E2SFCA)

    Min.  1st Qu.   Median     Mean  3rd Qu.     Max. 
0.000000 0.000000 0.003798 0.038400 0.042698 0.744475 

sum(hex_acc$E2SFCA == 0)

[1] 1281



The outer limit is unchanged, so the same 1,281 hexagons score zero. What changes is the spread among the rest: the median falls from 0.0207 to 0.0038 while the mean stays at 0.0384, because the supply that 2SFCA spread evenly across the catchment is now concentrated on the hexagons nearest each centre.


外边界没变，因此同样是那 1,281 个六边形为零。变化的是其余部分的离散程度：中位数从 0.0207 降到 0.0038，均值仍为 0.0384，因为 2SFCA 在搜寻域内平均摊开的供给，现在集中到了离各中心最近的六边形上。


acc_map(hex_acc, "E2SFCA", "E2SFCA accessibility, stepped weights to 5 km",
        zero_class = TRUE)

title: In-class Exercise 7: Floating Catchment Methods for Accessibility
text:
How the Weights Differ

2SFCA, E2SFCA and KD2SFCA differ only in the weight they give a centre at a given distance. catchment_weight() is the function catchment_ratio() calls internally to build that weight matrix, so applying it to a sequence of distances draws the three weighting schemes directly:


2SFCA、E2SFCA 与 KD2SFCA 唯一的区别，在于它们给某一距离上的中心多大权重。catchment_weight() 正是 catchment_ratio() 内部用来构建权重矩阵的函数，把它作用在一串距离上，就能直接画出三种权重方案：


d <- matrix(seq(0.01, 10, by = 0.01), nrow = 1)

weights <- tibble(
  distance_km = as.numeric(d),
  `2SFCA (max_cost = 5)` = as.numeric(catchment_weight(d, max_cost = 5)),
  `E2SFCA (step_weights)` = as.numeric(catchment_weight(d, weight = step_weights)),
  `KD2SFCA (gaussian)` = as.numeric(catchment_weight(d, weight = "gaussian"))) %>%
  pivot_longer(-distance_km, names_to = "method", values_to = "weight")

ggplot(weights, aes(x = distance_km, y = weight, colour = method)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 5, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  labs(x = "Road distance (km)", y = "Weight", colour = NULL) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")









The flat line is 2SFCA, the staircase E2SFCA, and the smooth curve the Gaussian kernel. The kernel in catchment is exp(−d² / 2s²) with a default scale of s = 2 km, and it has no cutoff: its weight at 5 km is 0.044 and at 10 km still 0.0000037, small but not zero. That single difference decides what the next section finds.


平直的线是 2SFCA，阶梯是 E2SFCA，平滑曲线是高斯核。catchment 中的核为 exp(−d² / 2s²)，默认尺度 s = 2 km，并且没有截断：5 km 处权重为 0.044，10 km 处仍有 0.0000037，很小但不为零。下一节的发现就取决于这一点差别。

title: In-class Exercise 7: Floating Catchment Methods for Accessibility
text:
Kernel Density 2SFCA (KD2SFCA)

hex_acc <- hex_acc %>%
  mutate(KD2SFCA = as.numeric(catchment_ratio(
    consumers = demand,
    providers = eldercare$capacity,
    cost = distmat_km,
    weight = "gaussian")))

summary(hex_acc$KD2SFCA)

     Min.   1st Qu.    Median      Mean   3rd Qu.      Max. 
0.000e+00 2.157e-05 1.062e-02 3.840e-02 5.741e-02 3.977e-01 

c(exactly_zero = sum(hex_acc$KD2SFCA == 0),
  below_one_millionth = sum(hex_acc$KD2SFCA < 1e-6))

       exactly_zero below_one_millionth 
                  0                 673 



No hexagon scores exactly zero. Without a catchment limit every centre contributes to every hexagon, so the 1,281 hexagons that 2SFCA and E2SFCA left unserved now receive positive values instead. For many of them the value is positive only in a numerical sense: 673 hexagons, 21.5 per cent of the grid, score below one millionth, and the smallest value is of the order of 10−57. The kernel has not found service in those places. It has replaced a hard zero with a number too small to mean anything.
This is not the KD2SFCA of Hands-on Exercise 7. There, ac() of SpatialAcc was given d0 = 5, which truncates its kernel at 5 km, and it left exactly the same 1,281 hexagons at zero. The two methods share a name and a family, but one has a catchment and the other does not:


没有任何六边形恰好为零。没有搜寻域边界，每个中心都会对每个六边形有贡献，于是 2SFCA 与 E2SFCA 判为未获服务的那 1,281 个六边形，现在都得到正值。但其中很多只是数值意义上的正：673 个六边形、即 21.5% 的网格得分低于百万分之一，最小值在 10−57 的量级。核函数并没有在这些地方找到服务，它只是把一个硬性的零换成了一个小到毫无意义的数。
这并不是 Hands-on 练习 7 里的 KD2SFCA。那里给 SpatialAcc 的 ac() 传入了 d0 = 5，核在 5 km 处截断，结果恰好也是这 1,281 个六边形为零。两者同名、同属一个家族，但一个有搜寻域，一个没有：


kd_spatialacc <- as.numeric(SpatialAcc::ac(
  hexagons$demand, eldercare$capacity, distmat_km,
  d0 = 5, power = 2, family = "KD2SFCA"))

c(zero_spatialacc = sum(kd_spatialacc == 0),
  zero_catchment = sum(hex_acc$KD2SFCA == 0),
  spearman = round(cor(kd_spatialacc, hex_acc$KD2SFCA,
                       method = "spearman"), 3))

zero_spatialacc  zero_catchment        spearman 
       1281.000           0.000           0.942 



The two rank the hexagons similarly, at a Spearman correlation of 0.942, but they disagree on the one question a planner is most likely to ask, which is where the unserved areas are. A result labelled KD2SFCA is not fully specified until the kernel, its scale and its cutoff are stated.


两者对六边形的排序相近，Spearman 相关为 0.942，但在规划者最可能问的那个问题上意见相左：未获服务的区域在哪里。标为 KD2SFCA 的结果，只有写明核函数、尺度与截断距离后才算完整。


acc_map(hex_acc, "KD2SFCA", "KD2SFCA accessibility, Gaussian kernel, no cutoff")









With no ties at zero, deciles work here, and the legend shows the problem just described: the two lowest classes run from the order of 10−57 to 10−7. The map is smoother than the two before it, with no hard edge at 5 km, and it is visibly close to the nearest-distance map, which is the first hint of what the comparison section finds.


没有并列的零值，这里可以用十分位分级，图例也正好显示出上面说的问题：最低两类从 10−57 量级一直到 10−7。这张图比前两张更平滑，5 km 处没有硬边界，而且明显接近最近距离地图，这是比较一节所发现结果的第一个迹象。

title: In-class Exercise 7: Floating Catchment Methods for Accessibility
text:
Three-Step FCA (3SFCA)

2SFCA and its kernel variants share a second weakness: a hexagon within reach of three centres is counted as full demand at all three, so its demand is triple-counted. 3SFCA adds a step before the other two. Each hexagon’s weights are divided by their own total, giving a selection weight, the share of that hexagon’s demand assumed to go to each centre. In catchment_ratio() this is normalize_weight = TRUE:


2SFCA 及其核变体还有第二个共同弱点：能到达三个中心的六边形，会在三处都被按全额需求计数，即需求被重复计算了三次。3SFCA 在原有两步之前再加一步：把每个六边形的权重除以其自身权重之和，得到选择权重，即假定该六边形的需求流向各中心的份额。在 catchment_ratio() 中对应 normalize_weight = TRUE：


hex_acc <- hex_acc %>%
  mutate(`3SFCA` = as.numeric(catchment_ratio(
    consumers = demand,
    providers = eldercare$capacity,
    cost = distmat_km,
    weight = step_weights,
    normalize_weight = TRUE)))

summary(hex_acc$`3SFCA`)

    Min.  1st Qu.   Median     Mean  3rd Qu.     Max. 
0.000000 0.000000 0.005286 0.038400 0.035281 0.818821 



The lesson passes step_weights positionally as the fourth argument. That works because the fourth formal argument of catchment_ratio() is weight, but naming it removes any doubt about which argument it lands on.


课上把 step_weights 作为第四个位置参数传入。这能工作，是因为 catchment_ratio() 的第四个形参正是 weight；但写明参数名，可以消除它到底落在哪个参数上的疑问。


acc_map(hex_acc, "3SFCA", "3SFCA accessibility, stepped weights with selection",
        zero_class = TRUE)

title: In-class Exercise 7: Floating Catchment Methods for Accessibility
text:
Modified 2SFCA (M2SFCA)

The last variant addresses a property all the others share, visible in the mean of 0.0384 that each has kept. They all hand out a centre’s entire capacity among whoever is in its catchment, however far away that demand is. A centre whose only users are in the 4 to 5 km band still gives them its full 100 places, at a weight of 0.01. M2SFCA applies the distance weight again on the supply side, so that a centre that is only reachable from far away hands out correspondingly less. adjust_providers = function(w) w^2 squares the weight in the second step:


最后一种变体针对的是其余所有方法共有的一个性质，从它们都保持住的均值 0.0384 就能看出：它们都把一个中心的全部容量分给搜寻域内的人，不论这些需求有多远。一个中心若只有 4–5 km 带上的使用者，仍会以 0.01 的权重把全部 100 个名额分给他们。M2SFCA 在供给一侧再施加一次距离权重，使只能从远处到达的中心相应地分出更少。adjust_providers = function(w) w^2 在第二步把权重平方：


hex_acc <- hex_acc %>%
  mutate(M2SFCA = as.numeric(catchment_ratio(
    consumers = demand,
    providers = eldercare$capacity,
    cost = distmat_km,
    weight = step_weights,
    adjust_providers = function(w) w^2)))

summary(hex_acc$M2SFCA)

     Min.   1st Qu.    Median      Mean   3rd Qu.      Max. 
0.000e+00 0.000e+00 4.465e-05 1.361e-02 3.603e-03 5.064e-01 



acc_map(hex_acc, "M2SFCA", "M2SFCA accessibility, distance weight applied twice",
        zero_class = TRUE)














WarningThe lesson’s M2SFCA map shows 3SFCA



In the lesson’s version, the chunk that draws the M2SFCA map builds hex_M2SFCA and then passes hex_3SFCA and the column "3SFCA" to tm_shape() and tm_polygons(), under the title “M2SFCA Accessibility measures”. The displayed figure is the 3SFCA map with a different heading. The hidden code tab beside it plots the right object, so the slip is only visible when the two tabs are compared. The map above is drawn from the M2SFCA column.



The two maps would look alike in any case, because M2SFCA and 3SFCA rank the hexagons almost identically. Where they differ is in level, not in pattern, and that difference is what the next section measures.


即便如此，两张图看起来也会很像，因为 M2SFCA 与 3SFCA 对六边形的排序几乎相同。两者的差别在于水平而不在于格局，下一节测量的正是这一差别。

title: In-class Exercise 7: Floating Catchment Methods for Accessibility
text:
Comparing the Measures

Conservation of supply

If a method only redistributes the supply, then the accessibility of each hexagon multiplied by its demand, summed over the island, gives back the total capacity. The ratio of the two is therefore 1 for a method that conserves supply:


如果一种方法只是重新分配供给，那么每个六边形的可达性乘以其需求、在全岛求和，应当正好还原总容量。因此对守恒的方法而言，两者之比为 1：


methods <- c("2SFCA", "E2SFCA", "KD2SFCA", "3SFCA", "M2SFCA")

hex_acc %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(methods),
                   ~ round(sum(.x * demand) / sum(eldercare$capacity), 3)))

  2SFCA E2SFCA KD2SFCA 3SFCA M2SFCA
1     1      1       1     1  0.354



Four of the five conserve supply exactly. M2SFCA allocates 35.4 per cent of the capacity and leaves the other 64.6 per cent unassigned. That is the intended behaviour, not a defect: the missing share is the capacity M2SFCA treats as lost to distance. It does mean the M2SFCA value cannot be read as places per person in the way the others can, and putting its numbers in the same table as 2SFCA’s without that caveat would make every hexagon look roughly a third as well served.


五种方法中有四种严格守恒。M2SFCA 只分配了 35.4% 的容量，其余 64.6% 未被分配。这是有意为之而非缺陷：缺失的那部分，就是 M2SFCA 视为被距离消耗掉的容量。但这也意味着，M2SFCA 的值不能像其他方法那样读作「人均名额」；若不加说明就把它与 2SFCA 的数字放进同一张表，每个六边形看上去都只获得了约三分之一的服务。



Rank agreement

hex_acc %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(dist2closest, all_of(methods)) %>%
  cor(method = "spearman") %>%
  round(3)

             dist2closest  2SFCA E2SFCA KD2SFCA  3SFCA M2SFCA
dist2closest        1.000 -0.888 -0.951  -0.973 -0.951 -0.958
2SFCA              -0.888  1.000  0.958   0.941  0.945  0.938
E2SFCA             -0.951  0.958  1.000   0.958  0.995  0.996
KD2SFCA            -0.973  0.941  0.958   1.000  0.949  0.948
3SFCA              -0.951  0.945  0.995   0.949  1.000  0.996
M2SFCA             -0.958  0.938  0.996   0.948  0.996  1.000



The five floating catchment measures rank the hexagons very similarly, with Spearman correlations from 0.938 to 0.996. The three that share step_weights, E2SFCA, 3SFCA and M2SFCA, agree with each other at 0.995 or above, so on this data the selection weight and the second distance decay change the level of the scores far more than their order. Plain 2SFCA agrees least with the others, at 0.938 to 0.958, as its flat catchment would suggest.
Every one of them also correlates with the plain distance to the nearest centre at between −0.888 and −0.973. With uniform demand and uniform capacity, most of what the ratio measures report is how close the nearest centres are. The competition term that distinguishes them from a distance map can only show its value when demand and capacity vary, which here they do not. The choices that do move the answer on this data are the ones the comparison above isolates: whether there is a hard catchment, which decides who counts as unserved, and whether supply is conserved, which decides what the numbers mean.


五种移动搜寻域测度对六边形的排序非常相近，Spearman 相关在 0.938 到 0.996 之间。共用 step_weights 的三种，即 E2SFCA、3SFCA 与 M2SFCA，彼此相关都在 0.995 以上；也就是说，在这份数据上，选择权重和第二次距离衰减改变的主要是得分的水平，而不是顺序。基础 2SFCA 与其余方法的一致性最低，在 0.938 到 0.958 之间，这与它平坦的搜寻域相符。
它们与「到最近中心的距离」之间的相关也都在 −0.888 到 −0.973 之间。在需求与容量都均匀的情况下，比值型测度报告的大部分内容，其实就是最近的中心有多近。让它们区别于距离地图的竞争项，只有在需求与容量有差异时才能显出价值，而这里并没有。在这份数据上真正改变答案的，是上面比较所分离出的两项选择：是否设硬性搜寻域，它决定谁被算作未获服务；以及供给是否守恒，它决定这些数字的含义。

text:
Main findings主要研究结果

RESEARCH QUESTIONS, AND WHAT THEY RETURNED研究问题,及其答案



Q1 · First order, spaceQ1 · 一阶,空间

How does detection intensity vary across the regency, and is it associated with proximity to engineered drainage rather than to water in general?


探测强度在全县如何变化?它是否与人工排水的邻近度相关,而不只是泛泛地「靠水」?



Q2 · Second order, spaceQ2 · 二阶,空间

Once the large-scale intensity gradient is accounted for, do the detections still show clustering, and over what range of distances?


在扣除大尺度强度梯度之后,探测点是否仍表现出聚集?在什么距离尺度上?



Q3 · Second order, space–timeQ3 · 二阶,时空

Are detections that are close in space also close in time, beyond what each margin alone implies?


空间上靠近的探测点,在时间上是否也靠近?这种靠近的程度,是否超出两个边缘分布各自 所隐含的水平?





~39× Peak-to-mean detection intensity核密度峰值与全县平均值之比


2.1 km Estimated Thomas cluster scaleThomas 模型估计聚集尺度


1.52× Pair ratio: same day, within 1 km同日、1 km 内观测/期望点对数




Where在哪里

Detections sit closer to engineered canals and farther from natural rivers than random locations in the same window.


相对同一窗口内的随机位置,火点更靠近人工运河,而相对远离天然河流。



How怎样聚集

Spatial clustering remains after adjustment for the measured distance covariates.


在控制已测得的距离协变量之后,空间聚集依然存在。



When何时

Same-day pairs are in excess relative to date permutation, and the excess is short-range.


同日邻近点对数高于日期置换下的期望值,且这一超额是短程的。




In one line一句话

The results indicate spatial heterogeneity tied to engineered drainage, local clustering that measured geography does not explain, and short-range space–time association.


结果表明:存在与人工排水相关的空间异质性、已测得的地理条件无法解释的局部聚集, 以及短程的时空关联。

                                                                                                   01 · THE FIRE FIELD what is actually burning A B C 02 · THE OBSERVATION PROCESS Two overpasses a day not a continuous watch Cloud and smoke block the view entirely A 375 m pixel not a flame, not a perimeter Threshold and saturation “high confidence” = saturated 03 · WHAT THE ANALYSIS SEES 3,101 rows in a table  Fire A · seen on several passes  → 4 detections. Intensity is inflated  where the satellite looked more often.   Fire B · seen once  → 1 detection.   Fire C · under cloud  → 0 detections. Every intensity  is a lower bound.    01 · 真实火场 实际在燃烧的东西 A B C 02 · 观测过程 每天两次过境 不是连续监视 云与烟 会完全遮住视线 一个 375 m 像元 不是火焰,也不是火场边界 阈值与饱和 「高置信度」等于亮温饱和 03 · 分析看到的东西 表格里的 3,101 行  火 A · 被多次过境看到  → 4 条探测。卫星看得越勤的地方, 强度就被抬得越高。   火 B · 只被看到一次  → 1 条探测。   火 C · 在云下 → 0 条探测。 所有强度都只是下界。  



What this rules out这排除了什么

Daily counts are driven by overpass timing and cloud as much as by fire, so no trend claim is made and every intensity is a lower bound.


逐日计数受过境时间与云层的影响不亚于受火情影响,因此全篇不作趋势论断, 而每一个强度都只是下界。

First order asks where; second order asks whether events interact一阶问「在哪里」,二阶问「事件之间是否交互」

In a single realisation the two are confounded. Every second-order statement below is therefore made relative to an explicit null model, never to a picture.


在单次实现中,这两者是混淆的。因此下文每一项二阶论断,都是相对一个显式的零模型 作出的,不是相对一幅图。

title: Fire on Drained Peat排水泥炭地上的火
section: Canals, not water是运河,不是靠水
text:
Canals, not water是运河,不是靠水

04 · FIRST-ORDER RESULTS04 · 一阶分析结果














559 m Median distance to a canal, at detections火点至运河的中位距离


1,119 m Same, at random locations随机位置的同一距离




After multivariate adjustment多变量调整之后

Intensity falls ×0.885 per km of distance from a canal and rises ×1.196 per km from a river. The two run in opposite directions. That is what separates a drainage mechanism from simple proximity to water.


每远离运河 1 km,强度变为原来的 0.885 倍;每远离河流 1 km,强度变为 1.196 倍。两者方向相反,正是这一点把 排水机制与泛泛的「靠水」区分开。

title: Fire on Drained Peat排水泥炭地上的火
section: The bandwidth is the decision带宽才是那个决策
text:
The bandwidth is the decision带宽才是那个决策

05 · SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS05 · 敏感性分析












Narrower bandwidth较小带宽

The estimated intensity keeps local variation, so the null already reproduces the clumping. Any further clustering then becomes harder to detect.


估计强度保留了局部变化,零模型本身就能再现成团,因此额外的聚集更难被检出。



Wider bandwidth较大带宽

The estimated intensity is smoother, and for the same data the \(p\)-value falls: 0.093 → 0.080 → 0.020 → 0.003.


估计强度更平滑,而在同一份数据下 \(p\) 值随之下降: 0.093 → 0.080 → 0.020 → 0.003。




Why this matters这为什么重要

The verdict here tracks the null model, not the data. A non-significant result therefore cannot be read as evidence of no clustering. What the next slide changes is the family of null model, not its flexibility.


由于判定追踪的是零模型而不是数据,这里的「不显著」不能读作「没有聚集」的证据。 下文换掉的是零模型的族,而不是它的灵活度,问题由此得到解决。

2.1 km Estimated cluster scale估计聚集尺度



What the scale is, and is not这个尺度是什么、不是什么

It describes the spatial scale of clustering. It is not a distance of fire spread, and the fitted parent count is the model’s accounting rather than a count of fires.


它描述的是聚集的空间尺度,不是火势蔓延距离;拟合出的母点数量是模型的记账 方式,而不是火的计数。

title: Fire on Drained Peat排水泥炭地上的火
section: Where and when are dependent「哪里」与「何时」相互依赖
text:
Where and when are dependent「哪里」与「何时」相互依赖

07 · SPACE–TIME RESULTS07 · 时空分析结果















1.52× Same day, within 1 km · observed / expected同日、1 km 内 · 观测/期望



The null used here这里用的零模型

199 random permutations of the date labels, holding both marginals fixed. It uses no bandwidth and no covariates, which is why it escapes the problem on the previous slide. The null is rejected at all nine space–time thresholds.


对日期标签做 199 次随机置换,同时固定两个边缘分布。它不用带宽、 也不用协变量,这正是它能绕开上一页那个问题的原因。九组时空阈值下,零模型都被拒绝。



Caveat保留

The association may reflect an advancing fire front and multi-day smouldering, not contagion between separate ignitions.


这一关联可能反映火线推进与多日阴燃,而非彼此独立的点火之间的传染。

section: Implications for public-safety management对公共安全管理的启示
text:
Implications for public-safety management对公共安全管理的启示

08 · DISCUSSION08 · 讨论









Finding研究结果
Management implication管理建议
What would have to be established first仍需先行确认的内容




Concentration near engineered canals火点集中于人工运河附近
Prioritise survey and patrol along the drainage network优先沿渠网开展调查与巡查
Groundwater level and canal condition地下水位与渠道状况


Clustering at a few-kilometre scale数公里尺度的空间聚集
Plan surveillance at local rather than regency scale按局地尺度而非全县尺度安排监测
Whether the scale transfers to other regencies该尺度能否推广到其他县


Association at short distance and short lag短距离、短时间间隔上的关联
Concentrate short-term monitoring near recent detections在近期火点附近集中短期监测
Separating persistence from new ignition区分持续阴燃与新增点火




The boundary of this evidence这份证据的边界

These are associations within one eight-day window, not causal effects. A full fire season, plus hydrological, land-cover and canal-condition data, would be required before any of the right-hand column could be settled.


以上是单一八天窗口内的关联,不是因果效应。要确定右栏中的任何一项,都需要覆盖 完整火季,并纳入水文、土地覆盖与渠道状况数据。

title: Fire on Drained Peat排水泥炭地上的火
text:
Conclusions结论

CONCLUSIONS研究结论



What the analysis shows分析显示了什么

Detection intensity varies about 39-fold across the regency, concentrating near engineered drainage and away from natural rivers.


探测强度在全县范围内变化约 39 倍,集中于人工排水 附近,并相对远离天然河流。



What survives the null models哪些结论经得起零模型检验

Clustering at roughly 2.1 km is not explained by the measured geography, and space and time are dependent at short range.


约 2.1 km 尺度的聚集无法由已测得的地理 条件解释,而空间与时间在短程上是相互依赖的。



What it cannot bear它承担不了什么

No trend claim, no causal claim, and no count of distinct fires. The window is eight days and the detections are an observation process, not the fire field.


不作趋势论断、不作因果论断,也不给出不同火场的计数。窗口只有八天,而探测记录是 一个观测过程,不是火场本身。




For planning对规划而言

The evidence supports where to look and how often, at local scale, along the drainage network. It does not support attributing cause, and it does not support forecasting beyond the observed window.


这份证据支持在局地尺度上、沿渠网决定去哪里看、多久看一次;它明确不支持 归因,也不支持把预测外推到观测窗口之外。

01 · WHERE, HOW IT EVOLVES, HOW IT SPREADS01 · 在哪里、如何演变、如何扩散



RQ1 · WhereRQ1 · 在哪里

Where are the significant hot spots, cold spots and outliers of armed conflict among Myanmar’s townships?


缅甸各镇区武装冲突的显著热点、冷点与异常值在哪里?



RQ2 · How it evolvesRQ2 · 如何演变

Which townships are new, persistent, sporadic or diminishing hot and cold spots, quarter by quarter?


逐季度来看,哪些镇区是新出现、持续、零星或减弱的热点与冷点?



RQ3 · How it spreadsRQ3 · 如何扩散

Does conflict spread to neighbouring townships, and does that start it or escalate it?


冲突会扩散到相邻镇区吗?它是引发冲突,还是使冲突升级?





53,805 Armed-conflict events analysed, 329 townships, 19 quarters被分析的武装冲突事件,329 个镇区,19 个季度


35 High-High townships: the Dry Zone and the south-east「高-高」镇区:干燥带与东南


2.43× Odds of escalating per unit of neighbours’ log conflict, with fixed effects邻居冲突(对数)每增加一单位的升级优势比(含固定效应)




Where在哪里

One dominant cluster in the Dry Zone where Sagaing, Magway and Mandalay meet; a weaker chain in the south-east; cold zones in the delta, Yangon and eastern Shan.


一个占主导的干燥带聚集(实皆、马圭、曼德勒交界);较弱的东南链条;冷区位于 三角洲、仰光与掸邦东部。



How it evolves如何演变

A stable core with moving edges: new hot spots on the south and east of the Dry Zone; Yangon turned cold after 2022. The off-the-shelf EHSA tool needed three corrections first.


稳定的核心,移动的边缘:干燥带南缘与东缘出现新热点;仰光在 2022 年后转为冷点。 现成的 EHSA 工具需要先做三项修正。



How it spreads如何扩散

Onset in 2021 was nationwide and simultaneous. Escalation is contagious: a township’s next quarter depends on its neighbours.


2021 年的爆发是全国同时发生的。升级则具有传染性:一个镇区下一季度的状况取决于 其邻居。

87,109 records, Jan 2021 – Sep 2025. Three armed-conflict types kept: battles, explosions/remote violence, violence against civilians, plus their fatalities.


87,109 条记录,2021 年 1 月至 2025 年 9 月。保留三类武装冲突: 战斗、爆炸/远程暴力、针对平民的暴力,以及相应的死亡人数。



MIMU townships v9.4MIMU 镇区 v9.4

330 townships; 329 analysed (Cocokyun, 126 km offshore and without a single event, excluded); two islands linked to the mainland.


330 个镇区;分析 329 个(距岸 126 km、没有任何事件的 Cocokyun 被排除);两个岛屿 与大陆相连。




Land mines cleared清除的地雷


107 conflict events known only to a city (“Mandalay – Unspecified”) and 88 known only to a district or state would each have landed on one city-centre township: excluded.
Events placed by spatial join, not by name; ACLED’s own township agrees for 99.98%.
45% of events are known only to the township, so township and quarter are the units, not points.




107 起只知道城市(「Mandalay – Unspecified」)的冲突事件, 以及 88 起只知道县或省邦的事件,本会各自落到一个城市 中心镇区:予以排除。
事件通过空间连接而非名称定位;与 ACLED 自身镇区的一致率为 99.98%。
45% 的事件只知道所在镇区,因此分析单元是镇区与季度,而不是点。

title: Geospatial Analytics for Peace面向和平的地理空间分析
text:
Analytical approach分析方法

03 · METHODS03 · 分析方法



1 · Prepare1 · 准备

Audit and screen events; join to townships; complete a 329 × 19 space-time cube with zeros where nothing happened.


审计与筛查事件;连接到镇区;构建完整的 329 × 19 时空立方体,无事件之处填零。



2 · LMSA2 · LMSA

Global Moran’s I, then local Moran’s I (clusters, outliers) and Gi* (hot, cold), 999 conditional permutations, FDR shown.


全局 Moran’s I,然后是局部 Moran’s I(聚集、异常值)与 Gi*(热、冷),999 次 条件置换,并显示 FDR 结果。



3 · EHSA3 · EHSA

Space-time Gi* per quarter, Mann-Kendall trend, Esri classes. sfdep’s tool checked against an independent implementation first.


逐季度的时空 Gi*、Mann-Kendall 趋势、Esri 类别。先用独立实现检验 sfdep 的工具。



4 · Value added4 · 附加价值

Spatial Markov chain of conflict states, fixed-effects logit and onset timing, each against a permutation null; back-tested.


冲突状态的空间马尔可夫链、固定效应 logit 与爆发时间,各自对照置换零模型; 并做回测。













Why check the tool为什么要检验工具

A hot spot map that is wrong looks exactly like one that is right. Every statistic here was reproduced independently, and each analytical choice was varied one at a time to see what moves.


一张错误的热点地图,看起来和正确的完全一样。这里的每个统计量都经过独立复现,每项 分析选择都逐一改变,以观察哪些结果会随之移动。

title: Geospatial Analytics for Peace面向和平的地理空间分析
section: How much conflict, when, and of what kind冲突有多少、何时、何种类型
text:
How much conflict, when, and of what kind冲突有多少、何时、何种类型

04 · THE NATIONAL TRAJECTORY04 · 全国走势













Conflict rose from 398 events in 2021 Q1 to 4,021 in 2023 Q4, the quarter of Operation 1027, and has stayed near 3,000 a quarter since.


冲突从 2021 年第一季度的 398 起,升至 2023 Q4 的 4,021 起(1027 行动所在季度),此后一直维持在每季度约 3,000 起。




Remote violence is now the largest category, and by 2025 the military initiated 82% of it: air strikes, drones and artillery.


远程暴力如今是最大的类别,到 2025 年其中 82% 由军方发起: 空袭、无人机与炮击。




The national series trends strongly, which is exactly what breaks the standard EHSA null model (slide 7).


全国序列趋势明显,这恰恰是标准 EHSA 零模型失效的原因(第 7 页)。

title: Geospatial Analytics for Peace面向和平的地理空间分析
section: Where: clusters and hot spots在哪里:聚集与热点
text:
Where: clusters and hot spots在哪里:聚集与热点

05 · LOCAL MEASURES OF SPATIAL ASSOCIATION05 · 局部空间关联














Clusters聚集

35 High-High townships: a solid block in the Dry Zone (Sagaing–Magway–Mandalay), which survives FDR correction, and a weaker south-eastern chain that does not.


35 个「高-高」镇区:干燥带(实皆–马圭–曼德勒)的 连片区块通过了 FDR 校正;较弱的东南链条则没有。



By type按类型

Violence against civilians is almost all Dry Zone; remote violence adds the south-east. No significant High-Low outliers.


针对平民的暴力几乎全在干燥带;远程暴力还延伸到东南。没有显著的「高-低」 异常值。



Cold冷区

52 Low-Low townships: the delta, Yangon and the eastern Shan hills. Gi* puts 318 of 329 townships on the same side.


52 个「低-低」镇区:三角洲、仰光与掸邦东部山地。Gi* 把 329 个镇区中的 318 个放在同一侧。

title: Geospatial Analytics for Peace面向和平的地理空间分析
section: How the clusters moved聚集如何移动
text:
How the clusters moved聚集如何移动

06 · LOCAL MORAN’S I, YEAR BY YEAR06 · 逐年局部 Moran’s I













2021–2023: the Dry Zone cluster grows and holds; Moran’s I peaks at 0.54.


2021–2023: 干燥带聚集扩大并保持;Moran’s I 在 0.54 达到峰值。




2024: new fronts in Rakhine and northern Shan; the Dry Zone core thins as the rest of the country catches up.


2024: 若开与掸邦北部开辟新前线;随着全国其他地区追赶上来,干燥带核心变得稀疏。




2025: clusters split between the Kayin border, the uplands where Mandalay meets northern Shan, and a remnant of the core. The eastern Shan cold zone never moves.


2025: 聚集分散在克伦边境、曼德勒–掸邦北部交界山地与老核心残余三处。掸邦东部 冷区从未移动。

title: Geospatial Analytics for Peace面向和平的地理空间分析
section: Checking the emerging hot spot tool检验新兴热点分析工具
text:
Checking the emerging hot spot tool检验新兴热点分析工具

07 · THREE DEFECTS IN sfdep 0.2.5, AND ONE TRAP07 · sfdep 0.2.5 的三个缺陷与一个陷阱












1 · Wrong township1 · 张冠李戴

Unless the polygons are sorted by id, 99% of townships get another township’s result.


除非多边形按编号排序,否则 99% 的 镇区会拿到另一个镇区的结果。



2 · Pooled null2 · 混合零模型

2021 Q1: 193 “significant” cold spots against 8 with a same-quarter null.


2021 年第一季度:193 个「显著」冷点,而同季度 零模型下只有 8 个。



3 · Class rule3 · 分类规则

“Intensifying hot spot” ignores the sign: a township cold in 18 of 19 quarters was labelled one.


「增强热点」规则忽略符号:一个 19 个季度中 18 个为冷点的镇区被贴上了这个标签。



4 · Chance4 · 偶然

~84 “sporadic hot spots” arise by chance alone; the count of hot quarters matters more than the label.


约 84 个 「零星热点」单凭偶然就会出现;热季度数比标签更重要。

title: Geospatial Analytics for Peace面向和平的地理空间分析
section: Emerging hot spots, corrected修正后的新兴热点
text:
Emerging hot spots, corrected修正后的新兴热点

08 · EMERGING HOT SPOT ANALYSIS08 · 新兴热点分析














Hot热点

Chronic core: Myaing, Pakokku, Yesagyo, Salingyi and Singu hot every quarter since late 2021, plus 23 sporadic hot spots hot in 11+ quarters, Monywa among them. New edge: Chauk, Nyaung-U, Meiktila, Kyaukse, Pyinoolwin, south and east of the core.


长期核心:敏建、木各具、耶沙久、沙林基与新古自 2021 年底以来每季度都是热点;另有 23 个零星热点在 11 个 以上季度为热点,包括蒙育瓦。新边缘:核心以南、以东的稍埠、良乌、密铁拉、皎施、眉谬。



Cold冷点

28 consecutive and 5 persistent cold spots (chance: about 2 and 0). Eastern Shan and Wa: cold throughout. Yangon: cold since 2022, after the urban resistance was suppressed.


28 个连续与 5 个持续冷点(偶然情况下约为 2 与 0)。掸邦东部与佤地区:始终是冷点。仰光:2022 年后 转冷,源于城市抵抗被镇压。



Watch注意

Three of the five townships with the most events (Kawkareik, Kale, Hpakant) show no pattern: a hot spot map is not a list of the most violent places.


事件最多的五个镇区中有三个(高加力、葛礼、帕敢)显示无模式:热点地图不是最暴力 地点的名单。

title: Geospatial Analytics for Peace面向和平的地理空间分析
section: Does conflict spread?冲突会扩散吗?
text:
Does conflict spread?冲突会扩散吗?

09 · VALUE-ADDED: SPATIAL MARKOV CHAIN AND EARLY WARNING09 · 附加价值:空间马尔可夫链与预警














Escalation is contagious升级具有传染性

A quiet township beside intense fighting is about twice as likely to see conflict next quarter. With township and quarter fixed effects the odds ratio is 2.43 (95% CI 2.04–2.90).


与激烈战斗相邻的平静镇区,下一季度出现冲突的可能性约为两倍。加入镇区与季度 固定效应后,优势比为 2.43(95% CI 2.04–2.90)。



Onset was not爆发则不然

First onsets are no more clustered than chance (p = 0.11): 2021 was a nationwide outbreak. Since 2023, every new onset bordered an active township.


首次爆发不比偶然更聚集(p = 0.11):2021 年是全国性的 爆发。2023 年以来,每一次新爆发都与活跃镇区相邻。



Back-tested回测

Fitted to 2024, tested on 2025: the neighbourhood lifts AUC from 0.71 to 0.83. 20 edge townships are flagged for 2025 Q4.


用截至 2024 年的数据拟合、在 2025 年检验:邻域信息使 AUC 从 0.71 提高到 0.83。 为 2025 年第四季度标出了 20 个边缘镇区。

title: Geospatial Analytics for Peace面向和平的地理空间分析
text:
Limitations and implications局限与启示

10 · FOR PEACE-BUILDING AND PUBLIC SAFETY10 · 面向和平建设与公共安全








Finding研究结果
Implication启示




Escalation spreads to neighbours, and the edge is predictable a quarter ahead升级会向邻居扩散,边缘可以提前一个季度预测
Pre-position protection, aid and monitoring in edge townships before violence arrives; refresh every quarter在暴力到来之前,于边缘镇区预置保护、援助与监测;每季度更新


Violence against civilians is moving south of the Dry Zone and into western Bago针对平民的暴力正向干燥带以南与勃固西部移动
Extend documentation and humanitarian access south of the Sagaing core把记录工作与人道准入延伸到实皆核心以南


Remote violence is the largest category and mostly the military’s远程暴力是最大的类别,且主要来自军方
Plan early warning, shelter and medical capacity for a risk map wider than the front line按照一张比前线更宽的风险地图,规划预警、避难与医疗能力


Eastern Shan is cold throughout; Yangon became cold by suppression掸邦东部始终是冷点;仰光则因镇压而变冷
The first may suit local ceasefires and returns; the second is not a settlement前者或许适合地方停火与返乡;后者不是和解




Limitations局限

Recorded, not all, events: reporting is thinnest where cold spots are. Counts, not risk: no population figure survives three million displacements. Results depend on township, quarter and queen contiguity, and the diffusion results are observational.


被记录的事件,而非全部事件:冷点所在之处恰是报道最薄弱的地方。计数,而非风险: 三百万人流离失所之后,不存在可用的人口数据。结果取决于镇区、季度与 queen 邻接, 扩散结果是观察性的。
